namespace Gen.T0.Gron

structure Flags where
  version : Bool
  reverse : Bool
  values : Bool
  stream : Bool
deriving DecidableEq

inductive FlagResult where
  | help
  | rejected
  | parsed (flags : Flags)
deriving DecidableEq

inductive Command where
  | showHelp
  | flagError
  | showVersion
  | forwardOne
  | forwardLines
  | ungron
  | extractValues
deriving DecidableEq

axiom dispatch : FlagResult → Command

axiom dispatchHelp : dispatch .help = .showHelp
axiom dispatchRejected : dispatch .rejected = .flagError
axiom dispatchVersion : ∀ reverse values stream : Bool,
  dispatch (.parsed ⟨true, reverse, values, stream⟩) = .showVersion
axiom dispatchUngron : ∀ values stream : Bool,
  dispatch (.parsed ⟨false, true, values, stream⟩) = .ungron
axiom dispatchValues : ∀ stream : Bool,
  dispatch (.parsed ⟨false, false, true, stream⟩) = .extractValues
axiom dispatchOne : dispatch (.parsed ⟨false, false, false, false⟩) = .forwardOne
axiom dispatchLines : dispatch (.parsed ⟨false, false, false, true⟩) = .forwardLines

structure ColorInput where
  force : Bool
  monochrome : Bool
  stdoutIsTTY : Bool
  termIsDumb : Bool
  noColorIsNonempty : Bool
deriving DecidableEq

axiom colorize : ColorInput → Bool
axiom colorizeRule : ∀ x,
  colorize x = (!x.noColorIsNonempty &&
    (x.force || (!x.monochrome && x.stdoutIsTTY && !x.termIsDumb)))

inductive ForwardInput where
  | one
  | lines
deriving DecidableEq

/-- A completed run classified by its requested action and the stage it reached. -/
inductive Completion where
  | help
  | version
  | flagError
  | openFileError
  | statementReadError
  | fetchError
  | formed
  | formationError (input : ForwardInput)
  | reconstructed
  | statementError
  | reconstructionFault
  | encodingError (wroteStdout : Bool)
  | extracted (foundValue : Bool)
  | extractionError (wroteStdout : Bool)
deriving DecidableEq

/-- Output indicators count bytes written by the run. -/
structure Observation where
  status : Fin 7
  wroteStdout : Bool
  wroteStderr : Bool
deriving DecidableEq

axiom observe : Completion → Observation

axiom helpObservation : observe .help = ⟨0, false, true⟩
axiom versionObservation : observe .version = ⟨0, true, false⟩
axiom flagErrorObservation : observe .flagError = ⟨2, false, true⟩
axiom openFileObservation : observe .openFileError = ⟨1, false, true⟩
axiom statementReadObservation : observe .statementReadError = ⟨2, false, true⟩
axiom fetchObservation : observe .fetchError = ⟨4, false, true⟩
axiom formedObservation : observe .formed = ⟨0, true, false⟩
axiom oneFormationError : observe (.formationError .one) = ⟨3, false, true⟩
axiom linesFormationError : observe (.formationError .lines) = ⟨3, true, true⟩
axiom reconstructedObservation : observe .reconstructed = ⟨0, true, false⟩
axiom statementErrorObservation : observe .statementError = ⟨5, false, true⟩
axiom reconstructionFaultObservation : observe .reconstructionFault = ⟨2, false, true⟩
/-- Status 6 is assigned to a JSON encoding failure by the usage text. -/
axiom encodingErrorObservation : ∀ wroteStdout,
  observe (.encodingError wroteStdout) = ⟨6, wroteStdout, true⟩
axiom extractionObservation : ∀ foundValue,
  observe (.extracted foundValue) = ⟨0, foundValue, false⟩
axiom extractionErrorObservation : ∀ wroteStdout,
  observe (.extractionError wroteStdout) = ⟨5, wroteStdout, true⟩

end Gen.T0.Gron

import Gen.T0.Gron
import LojitaCtx.Blueprint
import LojitaCtx.Terminal

namespace Gen.T1.Gron

open LojitaCtx.Blueprint LojitaCtx.Terminal

def usage : String := "Transform JSON (from a file, URL, or stdin) into discrete assignments to make it greppable\n\nUsage:\n  gron [OPTIONS] [FILE|URL|-]\n\nOptions:\n  -u, --ungron     Reverse the operation (turn assignments back into JSON)\n  -v, --values     Print just the values of provided assignments\n  -c, --colorize   Colorize output (default on tty)\n  -m, --monochrome Monochrome (don't colorize output)\n  -s, --stream     Treat each line of input as a separate JSON object\n  -k, --insecure   Disable certificate validation\n  -x, --proxy      Set proxy configuration\n      --noproxy    Comma-separated list of hosts for which not to use a proxy, if one is specified.\n  -j, --json       Represent gron data as JSON stream\n      --no-sort    Don't sort output (faster)\n      --version    Print version information\n\nExit Codes:\n  0\tOK\n  1\tFailed to open file\n  2\tFailed to read input\n  3\tFailed to form statements\n  4\tFailed to fetch URL\n  5\tFailed to parse statements\n  6\tFailed to encode JSON\n\nExamples:\n  gron /tmp/apiresponse.json\n  gron http://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1 \n  curl -s http://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1 | gron\n  gron http://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users/1 | grep company | gron --ungron\n"

def versionLine : String := "gron version dev\n"

structure Options where
  version : Bool := false
  reverse : Bool := false
  values : Bool := false
  stream : Bool := false
  colorize : Bool := false
  monochrome : Bool := false
  json : Bool := false
  noSort : Bool := false
  insecure : Bool := false
  proxy : String := ""
  noProxy : String := ""
deriving DecidableEq

inductive Invocation where
  | help
  | rejected (message : String)
  | parsed (options : Options) (operands : List String)

inductive Command where
  | help | flagError | version | forwardOne | forwardLines | ungron | values
deriving DecidableEq

def invocationPort : PortLift Gen.T0.Gron.FlagResult Invocation :=
  ⟨fun
    | .help => .help
    | .rejected _ => .rejected
    | .parsed o _ => .parsed ⟨o.version, o.reverse, o.values, o.stream⟩⟩

def commandPort : PortLift Gen.T0.Gron.Command Command :=
  ⟨fun
    | .help => .showHelp
    | .flagError => .flagError
    | .version => .showVersion
    | .forwardOne => .forwardOne
    | .forwardLines => .forwardLines
    | .ungron => .ungron
    | .values => .extractValues⟩

axiom dispatch : Invocation → Command
axiom dispatchVertical :
  Commutes₁ invocationPort commandPort (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T0.Gron.dispatch dispatch

inductive BoolFlag where
  | version | reverse | values | stream | colorize | monochrome | json | noSort | insecure

inductive TextFlag where
  | proxy | noProxy

inductive Flag where
  | help
  | boolean (flag : BoolFlag)
  | text (flag : TextFlag)

def flagNamed : String → Option Flag
  | "h" | "help" => some .help
  | "version" => some (.boolean .version)
  | "u" | "ungron" => some (.boolean .reverse)
  | "v" | "values" => some (.boolean .values)
  | "s" | "stream" => some (.boolean .stream)
  | "c" | "colorize" => some (.boolean .colorize)
  | "m" | "monochrome" => some (.boolean .monochrome)
  | "j" | "json" => some (.boolean .json)
  | "no-sort" => some (.boolean .noSort)
  | "k" | "insecure" => some (.boolean .insecure)
  | "x" | "proxy" => some (.text .proxy)
  | "noproxy" => some (.text .noProxy)
  | _ => none

def boolArgument : String → Option Bool
  | "1" | "t" | "T" | "true" | "TRUE" | "True" => some true
  | "0" | "f" | "F" | "false" | "FALSE" | "False" => some false
  | _ => none

def setBoolFlag (o : Options) (b : Bool) : BoolFlag → Options
  | .version => {o with version := b}
  | .reverse => {o with reverse := b}
  | .values => {o with values := b}
  | .stream => {o with stream := b}
  | .colorize => {o with colorize := b}
  | .monochrome => {o with monochrome := b}
  | .json => {o with json := b}
  | .noSort => {o with noSort := b}
  | .insecure => {o with insecure := b}

def setTextFlag (o : Options) (s : String) : TextFlag → Options
  | .proxy => {o with proxy := s}
  | .noProxy => {o with noProxy := s}

inductive ArgPrefix where
  | operand | delimiter | invalid
  | flag (name : String) (attached : Option String)

def flagPrefix (arg : String) : ArgPrefix :=
  if arg == "--" then .delimiter
  else if arg == "-" || !arg.startsWith "-" then .operand
  else
    let n := if arg.startsWith "--" then 2 else 1
    let suffix := String.ofList (arg.toList.drop n)
    if suffix.startsWith "-" || suffix.startsWith "=" then .invalid
    else
      match suffix.splitOn "=" with
      | name :: value :: rest => .flag name (some (String.intercalate "=" (value :: rest)))
      | _ => .flag suffix none

axiom quoteDiagnostic : String → String
axiom quoteDiagnosticPlain : ∀ s,
  s.toList.all (fun c => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127 && c != '"' && c != '\\') = true →
  quoteDiagnostic s = "\"" ++ s ++ "\""

axiom parseOptions : Options → List String → Invocation
axiom parseOptionsEnd : ∀ o, parseOptions o [] = .parsed o []
axiom parseOptionsStep : ∀ o arg rest, parseOptions o (arg :: rest) =
  match flagPrefix arg with
  | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
  | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
  | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
  | .flag name attached =>
    match flagNamed name with
    | .none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
    | .some .help => .help
    | .some (.boolean flag) =>
      match attached with
      | .none => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
      | .some value =>
        match boolArgument value with
        | .some b => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
        | .none =>
          .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteDiagnostic value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
    | .some (.text flag) =>
      match attached, rest with
      | .some value, _ => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) rest
      | .none, value :: tail => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) tail
      | .none, [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name)

inductive Source where
  | stdin
  | file (path : String)
  | http (url : String)
deriving DecidableEq

axiom selectSource : List String → Source
axiom selectSourceRule : ∀ operands, selectSource operands =
  let a := operands.headD ""
  let lower := String.ofList (a.toList.map Char.toLower)
  if a == "" || a == "-" then .stdin
  else if lower.startsWith "http://" || lower.startsWith "https://" then .http a
  else .file a

axiom getRequest : String → String → Option String → Bytes
axiom getRequestRule : ∀ authority target referer, getRequest authority target referer =
  bytes ("GET " ++ target ++ " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " ++ authority ++
    "\r\nUser-Agent: gron/dev\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n" ++
    (match referer with | none => "" | some r => "Referer: " ++ r ++ "\r\n") ++
    "Accept-Encoding: gzip\r\n\r\n")

structure ColorInput where
  force : Bool
  monochrome : Bool
  stdoutIsTTY : Bool
  term : Option String
  noColor : Option String

def colorPort : PortLift Gen.T0.Gron.ColorInput ColorInput :=
  ⟨fun x => ⟨x.force, x.monochrome, x.stdoutIsTTY, x.term == some "dumb",
    !(x.noColor.getD "").isEmpty⟩⟩

axiom colorize : ColorInput → Bool
axiom colorVertical :
  Commutes₁ colorPort (keepPort Bool) (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T0.Gron.colorize colorize

structure NonemptyOutput where
  first : UInt8
  tail : Bytes

def NonemptyOutput.toBytes (o : NonemptyOutput) : Bytes := o.first :: o.tail

inductive Completion where
  | help | version | statementReadError
  | flagError (message : String)
  | openError (path reason : String)
  | fetchError (message : String)
  | formed (stdout : NonemptyOutput)
  | oneError (message : String)
  | linesError (stdout : NonemptyOutput) (message : String)
  | reconstructed (stdout : NonemptyOutput)
  | statementError (message : String)
  | reconstructionFault (stderr : NonemptyOutput)
  | encodingError (stdout : Bytes) (stderr : NonemptyOutput)
  | extracted (stdout : Bytes)
  | extractionError (stdout : Bytes) (stderr : NonemptyOutput)

structure Observation where
  status : Fin 7
  stdout : Bytes
  stderr : Bytes

def completionPort : PortLift Gen.T0.Gron.Completion Completion :=
  ⟨fun
    | .help => .help
    | .version => .version
    | .flagError _ => .flagError
    | .openError _ _ => .openFileError
    | .statementReadError => .statementReadError
    | .fetchError _ => .fetchError
    | .formed _ => .formed
    | .oneError _ => .formationError .one
    | .linesError _ _ => .formationError .lines
    | .reconstructed _ => .reconstructed
    | .statementError _ => .statementError
    | .reconstructionFault _ => .reconstructionFault
    | .encodingError o _ => .encodingError (!o.isEmpty)
    | .extracted o => .extracted (!o.isEmpty)
    | .extractionError o _ => .extractionError (!o.isEmpty)⟩

def observationPort : PortLift Gen.T0.Gron.Observation Observation :=
  ⟨fun o => ⟨o.status, !o.stdout.isEmpty, !o.stderr.isEmpty⟩⟩

axiom observe : Completion → Observation
axiom observeRule : ∀ c, observe c =
  match c with
  | .help => ⟨0, [], bytes usage⟩
  | .version => ⟨0, bytes versionLine, []⟩
  | .flagError m => ⟨2, [], bytes (m ++ "\n" ++ usage)⟩
  | .openError p r => ⟨1, [], bytes ("open " ++ p ++ ": " ++ r ++ "\n")⟩
  | .statementReadError => ⟨2, [], bytes "failed to read input statements\n"⟩
  | .fetchError m => ⟨4, [], bytes (m ++ "\n")⟩
  | .formed o => ⟨0, o.toBytes, []⟩
  | .oneError m => ⟨3, [], bytes ("failed to form statements: " ++ m ++ "\n")⟩
  | .linesError o m => ⟨3, o.toBytes, bytes (m ++ "\n")⟩
  | .reconstructed o => ⟨0, o.toBytes, []⟩
  | .statementError m => ⟨5, [], bytes (m ++ "\n")⟩
  | .reconstructionFault e => ⟨2, [], e.toBytes⟩
  | .encodingError o e => ⟨6, o, e.toBytes⟩
  | .extracted o => ⟨0, o, []⟩
  | .extractionError o e => ⟨5, o, e.toBytes⟩
axiom observeVertical :
  Commutes₁ completionPort observationPort (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T0.Gron.observe observe

/-- Letter and continuation classes for non-ASCII identifiers at the input boundary. -/
structure IdentifierAlphabet where
  starts : Char → Bool
  continues : Char → Bool

def reservedIdentifier : List String :=
  ["break","case","catch","class","const","continue","debugger","default","delete","do",
   "else","export","extends","false","finally","for","function","if","import","in",
   "instanceof","new","null","return","super","switch","this","throw","true","try",
   "typeof","var","void","while","with","yield"]

def startsIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then c.isAlpha || c == '$' || c == '_' else a.starts c

def continuesIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then startsIdentifier a c || c.isDigit else a.continues c

def identifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (s : String) : Bool :=
  match s.toList with
  | [] => false
  | c :: cs => !reservedIdentifier.contains s && startsIdentifier a c &&
    cs.all (continuesIdentifier a)

def hexDigit (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 10 then 48 + n else (if upper then 55 else 87) + n)

def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))

/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c

def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))

def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""

inductive Scalar where
  | null
  | boolean (value : Bool)
  | number (lexeme : String)
  | string (value : String)

inductive Json where
  | scalar (value : Scalar)
  | array (items : List Json)
  | object (fields : List (String × Json))

inductive Segment where
  | key (name : String)
  | index (position : Nat)
deriving DecidableEq

abbrev Path := List Segment

inductive Atom where
  | scalar (value : Scalar)
  | array
  | object

structure Statement where
  path : Path
  value : Atom

structure Assignment where
  path : Path
  value : Json

inductive Ink where
  | bracket | string | number | literal | name | quote | strong

def paint (color : Bool) (ink : Ink) (s : String) : String :=
  let (on, off) := match ink with
    | .bracket => ("35", "0")
    | .string => ("33", "0")
    | .number => ("31", "0")
    | .literal => ("36", "0")
    | .name => ("34;1", "0;22")
    | .quote => ("32", "0")
    | .strong => ("1", "22")
  if color then "\x1b[" ++ on ++ "m" ++ s ++ "\x1b[" ++ off ++ "m" else s

def renderScalar (statement color : Bool) : Scalar → String
  | .null => paint color .literal "null"
  | .boolean b => paint color .literal (if b then "true" else "false")
  | .number n => paint color .number n
  | .string s =>
    if statement then paint color .string (quote true s)
    else paint color .quote "\"" ++ paint color .string (escaped false s) ++ paint color .quote "\""

def jsSegment (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (color : Bool) : Segment → String
  | .key k =>
    if identifier a k then "." ++ paint color .name k
    else paint color .bracket "[" ++ paint color .string (quote true k) ++ paint color .bracket "]"
  | .index n => paint color .bracket "[" ++ paint color .number (toString n) ++ paint color .bracket "]"

def jsonSegment (color : Bool) : Segment → String
  | .key k => paint color .string (quote true k)
  | .index n => paint color .number (toString n)

def renderAtom (color : Bool) : Atom → String
  | .scalar s => renderScalar true color s
  | .array => paint color .bracket "[]"
  | .object => paint color .bracket "{}"

structure Style where
  alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet
  sorted : Bool
  json : Bool
  color : Bool

axiom render : Style → Statement → Bytes
axiom renderRule : ∀ style st, render style st =
  let val := renderAtom style.color st.value
  let b := paint style.color .bracket
  if style.json then
    bytes (b "[" ++ b "[" ++ String.intercalate "," (st.path.map (jsonSegment style.color)) ++
      b "]" ++ "," ++ val ++ b "]" ++ "\n")
  else
    bytes (paint style.color .name "json" ++
      String.intercalate "" (st.path.map (jsSegment style.alphabet style.color)) ++ " = " ++ val ++ ";\n")

def lastMember (fields : List (String × Json)) (key : String) : Option Json :=
  (fields.reverse.find? (fun p => p.1 == key)).map Prod.snd

def objectMemberOrder (fields : List (String × Json)) (keys : List String) : Prop :=
  keys.Nodup ∧ ∀ k, k ∈ keys ↔ (lastMember fields k).isSome = true

axiom flatten : IdentifierAlphabet → Bool → Path → Json → List Statement
axiom flattenScalar : ∀ alphabet sorted p s, flatten alphabet sorted p (.scalar s) = [⟨p, .scalar s⟩]
axiom flattenArray : ∀ alphabet sorted p xs,
  flatten alphabet sorted p (.array xs) =
    ⟨p, .array⟩ :: (xs.zipIdx.flatMap fun (v, i) => flatten alphabet sorted (p ++ [.index i]) v)
axiom flattenObject : ∀ alphabet sorted p fields,
  ∃ keys, objectMemberOrder fields keys ∧
    (sorted = true → keys.Pairwise (fun a b =>
      jsSegment alphabet false (.key a) < jsSegment alphabet false (.key b))) ∧
    flatten alphabet sorted p (.object fields) =
      ⟨p, .object⟩ :: (keys.flatMap fun k =>
        match lastMember fields k with
        | none => []
        | some v => flatten alphabet sorted (p ++ [.key k]) v)

axiom forwardValue : Style → Path → Json → Bytes
axiom forwardValueRule : ∀ style p j, forwardValue style p j =
  ((flatten style.alphabet style.sorted p j).map (render style)).flatten

axiom streamStart : Style → Bytes
axiom streamStartRule : ∀ style, streamStart style = render style ⟨[], .array⟩
axiom streamValue : Style → Nat → Json → Bytes
axiom streamValueRule : ∀ style index j, streamValue style index j = forwardValue style [.index index] j

axiom embed : Path → Json → Json
axiom embedRoot : ∀ v, embed [] v = v
axiom embedKey : ∀ k p v, embed (.key k :: p) v = .object [(k, embed p v)]
axiom embedIndex : ∀ n p v, embed (.index n :: p) v = .array (List.replicate n (.scalar .null) ++ [embed p v])

def isArray : Json → Bool
  | .array _ => true
  | _ => false

def isObject : Json → Bool
  | .object _ => true
  | _ => false

def isNull : Json → Bool
  | .scalar .null => true
  | _ => false

def replaceMember (key : String) (v : Json) (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    List (String × Json) :=
  (fields.filter (fun p => p.1 != key)) ++ [(key, v)]

axiom merge : Json → Json → Except String Json
axiom mergeSlots : List Json → List Json → Except String (List Json)

axiom mergeScalar : ∀ x y, merge (.scalar x) y = .ok y
axiom mergeArrayMismatch : ∀ xs y, isArray y = false →
  merge (.array xs) y = .error "cannot merge array with non-array"
axiom mergeObjectMismatch : ∀ xs y, isObject y = false →
  merge (.object xs) y = .error "cannot merge object with non-object"
axiom mergeArray : ∀ xs ys, merge (.array xs) (.array ys) = (mergeSlots xs ys).map Json.array
axiom mergeSlotsLeftEmpty : ∀ ys, mergeSlots [] ys = .ok ys
axiom mergeSlotsRightEmpty : ∀ xs, mergeSlots xs [] = .ok xs
axiom mergeSlotsStep : ∀ x xs y ys,
  mergeSlots (x :: xs) (y :: ys) = do
    let v ← if isNull y then .ok x else merge x y
    let rest ← mergeSlots xs ys
    return v :: rest
axiom mergeObjectEmpty : ∀ xs, merge (.object xs) (.object []) = .ok (.object xs)
axiom mergeObjectStep : ∀ xs k v ys,
  merge (.object xs) (.object ((k, v) :: ys)) = do
    let nv ← match lastMember xs k with
      | none => .ok v
      | some old => merge old v
    merge (.object (replaceMember k nv xs)) (.object ys)

axiom mergeAssignments : Json → List Assignment → Except String Json
axiom mergeAssignmentsEnd : ∀ j, mergeAssignments j [] = .ok j
axiom mergeAssignmentsStep : ∀ j a rest,
  mergeAssignments j (a :: rest) = do
    let next ← merge j (embed a.path a.value)
    mergeAssignments next rest

axiom reconstruct : List Assignment → Except String Json
axiom reconstructEmpty : reconstruct [] = .error "no statements were parsed"
axiom reconstructList : ∀ a rest, reconstruct (a :: rest) =
  (mergeAssignments (embed a.path a.value) rest).mapError ("failed to merge statements: " ++ ·)

def indent (level : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList (List.replicate (2 * level) ' ')

def docContainer (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (left right : String) (items : List String) : String :=
  if color then
    paint true .bracket left ++ String.intercalate (paint true .strong ",") items ++
      paint true .bracket right
  else if items.isEmpty then left ++ right
  else
    left ++ "\n" ++ String.intercalate ",\n" (items.map (indent (level + 1) ++ ·)) ++
      "\n" ++ indent level ++ right

def docMember (color : Bool) (key rendered : String) : String :=
  if color then
    paint true .name "\"" ++ paint true .name (escaped false key) ++ paint true .name "\"" ++
      paint true .strong ":" ++ rendered
  else quote false key ++ ": " ++ rendered

axiom document : Bool → Nat → Json → String
axiom documentScalar : ∀ color level s,
  document color level (.scalar s) = renderScalar false color s
axiom documentArray : ∀ color level xs,
  document color level (.array xs) =
    docContainer color level "[" "]" (xs.map (document color (level + 1)))
axiom documentObject : ∀ color level fields keys,
  objectMemberOrder fields keys → keys.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b) →
  document color level (.object fields) =
    docContainer color level "{" "}" (keys.filterMap fun k =>
      (lastMember fields k).map (fun v => docMember color k (document color (level + 1) v)))

inductive LineError where
  | decode (reason : String)
  | read (reason : String)

def streamError : LineError → String
  | .decode reason => "failed to form statements: " ++ reason
  | .read reason => "error reading multiline input: " ++ reason ++ ": %!s(MISSING)"

axiom forwardOne : Style → Except String Json → Completion
axiom forwardOneRule : ∀ style input, observe (forwardOne style input) =
  match input with
  | .ok j => ⟨0, forwardValue style [] j, []⟩
  | .error e => observe (.oneError e)

axiom forwardFrames : Style → Nat → List (Except LineError Json) → Bytes × Option LineError
axiom forwardFramesEnd : ∀ style i, forwardFrames style i [] = ([], none)
axiom forwardFramesError : ∀ style i e rest,
  forwardFrames style i (.error e :: rest) = ([], some e)
axiom forwardFramesNext : ∀ style i j rest,
  forwardFrames style i (.ok j :: rest) =
    let tail := forwardFrames style (i + 1) rest
    (streamValue style i j ++ tail.1, tail.2)

axiom forwardLines : Style → List (Except LineError Json) → Completion
axiom forwardLinesRule : ∀ style frames, observe (forwardLines style frames) =
  let r := forwardFrames style 0 frames
  let out := streamStart style ++ r.1
  match r.2 with
  | none => ⟨0, out, []⟩
  | some e => ⟨3, out, bytes (streamError e ++ "\n")⟩

axiom ungron : Bool → Except String (List Assignment) → Completion
axiom ungronRule : ∀ color assignments, observe (ungron color assignments) =
  match assignments.bind reconstruct with
  | .error e => observe (.statementError e)
  | .ok j => ⟨0, bytes (document color 0 j ++ "\n"), []⟩

axiom values : List (Option String) → Completion
axiom valuesRule : ∀ lines, values lines =
  .extracted ((lines.filterMap (fun s => s.map (fun v => bytes (v ++ "\n")))).flatten)

structure DecodedInput where
  one : Except String Json
  lines : List (Except LineError Json)
  assignments : Except String (List Assignment)
  values : List (Option String)

inductive Acquired where
  | openError (path reason : String)
  | fetchError (message : String)
  | readError (reason : String)
  | input (data : DecodedInput)

structure Environment where
  alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet
  stdoutIsTTY : Bool
  term : Option String
  noColor : Option String

axiom execute : Invocation → Environment → Acquired → Completion
axiom executeRule : ∀ inv env input, execute inv env input =
  match inv with
  | .help => .help
  | .rejected m => .flagError m
  | .parsed o _ =>
   let mode := dispatch inv
    let color := colorize ⟨o.colorize, o.monochrome, env.stdoutIsTTY, env.term, env.noColor⟩
    let style := Style.mk env.alphabet (!o.noSort) o.json color
    if mode = .version then .version
    else match input with
    | .openError p e => .openError p e
    | .fetchError e => .fetchError e
    | .readError e =>
      match mode with
      | .forwardLines => forwardLines style [.error (.read e)]
      | .ungron => .statementReadError
      | .values => .extracted []
      | _ => .oneError e
    | .input data =>
      match mode with
      | .forwardLines => forwardLines style data.lines
      | .ungron => ungron color data.assignments
      | .values => values data.values
      | _ => forwardOne style data.one

end Gen.T1.Gron

def flagNamed : String → Option Flag

  | "u" | "ungron" => some (.boolean .reverse)
  | "v" | "values" => some (.boolean .values)

inductive ArgPrefix where
  | operand | delimiter | invalid
  | flag (name : String) (attached : Option String)
def flagPrefix (arg : String) : ArgPrefix :=
  if arg == "--" then .delimiter
  else if arg == "-" || !arg.startsWith "-" then .operand
  else
    let n := if arg.startsWith "--" then 2 else 1
    let suffix := String.ofList (arg.toList.drop n)
    if suffix.startsWith "-" || suffix.startsWith "=" then .invalid
    else
      match suffix.splitOn "=" with
      | name :: value :: rest => .flag name (some (String.intercalate "=" (value :: rest)))
      | _ => .flag suffix none

/-- Letter and continuation classes for non-ASCII identifiers at the input boundary. -/
structure IdentifierAlphabet where
  starts : Char → Bool
  continues : Char → Bool
def reservedIdentifier : List String :=
  ["break","case","catch","class","const","continue","debugger","default","delete","do",
   "else","export","extends","false","finally","for","function","if","import","in",
   "instanceof","new","null","return","super","switch","this","throw","true","try",
   "typeof","var","void","while","with","yield"]
def startsIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then c.isAlpha || c == '$' || c == '_' else a.starts c
def continuesIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then startsIdentifier a c || c.isDigit else a.continues c
def identifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (s : String) : Bool :=
  match s.toList with
  | [] => false
  | c :: cs => !reservedIdentifier.contains s && startsIdentifier a c &&
    cs.all (continuesIdentifier a)
def hexDigit (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 10 then 48 + n else (if upper then 55 else 87) + n)
def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))
/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c
def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))
def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""

    | .literal => ("36", "0")
    | .name => ("34;1", "0;22")
    | .quote => ("32", "0")

  if color then "\x1b[" ++ on ++ "m" ++ s ++ "\x1b[" ++ off ++ "m" else s

def renderAtom (color : Bool) : Atom → String

def indent (level : Nat) : String :=

def docContainer (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (left right : String) (items : List String) : String :=

def parseOptions (o : Options) : List String → Invocation
  | [] => .parsed o []
  | arg :: rest =>
    match flagPrefix arg with
    | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
    | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
    | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
    | .flag name attached =>
      match flagNamed name with
      | .none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
      | .some .help => .help
      | .some (.boolean flag) =>
        match attached with
        | .none => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
        | .some value =>
          match boolArgument value with
          | .some b => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
          | .none =>
            .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteDiagnostic value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
      | .some (.text flag) =>
        match attached with
        | .some value => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) rest
        | .none =>
          match rest with
          | value :: tail => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) tail
          | [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name)
termination_by structural args => args

theorem parseOptionsEnd (o : Options) : parseOptions o [] = .parsed o [] := rfl

theorem parseOptionsStep (o : Options) (arg : String) (rest : List String) :
    parseOptions o (arg :: rest) =
    match flagPrefix arg with
    | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
    | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
    | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
    | .flag name attached =>
      match flagNamed name with
      | .none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
      | .some .help => .help
      | .some (.boolean flag) =>
        match attached with
        | .none => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
        | .some value =>
          match boolArgument value with
          | .some b => parseOptions (setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
          | .none =>
            .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteDiagnostic value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
      | .some (.text flag) =>
        match attached, rest with
        | .some value, _ => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) rest
        | .none, value :: tail => parseOptions (setTextFlag o value flag) tail
        | .none, [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name) := by
  rw [parseOptions]
  split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rename_i name attached _
    split
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · cases attached <;> cases rest <;> rfl

def selectSource (operands : List String) : Source :=
  let a := operands.headD ""
  let lower := String.ofList (a.toList.map Char.toLower)
  if a == "" || a == "-" then .stdin
  else if lower.startsWith "http://" || lower.startsWith "https://" then .http a
  else .file a

  let a := operands.headD ""

  if a == "" || a == "-" then .stdin
  else if lower.startsWith "http://" || lower.startsWith "https://" then .http a
  else .file a := rfl

  | .fetchError m => ⟨4, [], bytes (m ++ "\n")⟩

private theorem appendNonemptyLeft {α : Type} (xs ys : List α) (h : xs ≠ []) :
    xs ++ ys ≠ [] := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => exact False.elim (h rfl)
  | cons _ _ => intro bad; cases bad

private theorem appendNonemptyRight {α : Type} (xs ys : List α) (h : ys ≠ []) :
    xs ++ ys ≠ [] := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => exact h
  | cons _ _ => intro bad; cases bad

private theorem isEmptyFalse {α : Type} (xs : List α) (h : xs ≠ []) :
    xs.isEmpty = false := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => exact False.elim (h rfl)
  | cons _ _ => rfl

private theorem suffixBytes (s t : String) (h : bytes t ≠ []) : bytes (s ++ t) ≠ [] :=
  appendNonemptyRight (bytes s) (bytes t) h

private theorem lineBytes (s : String) : bytes (s ++ "\n") ≠ [] :=
  suffixBytes s "\n" (by decide)

private def packOutput (bs : Bytes) (h : bs ≠ []) : NonemptyOutput :=
  match bs with
  | [] => False.elim (h rfl)
  | b :: rest => ⟨b, rest⟩

private theorem packOutputBytes (bs : Bytes) (h : bs ≠ []) :
    (packOutput bs h).toBytes = bs := by
  cases bs with
  | nil => exact False.elim (h rfl)
  | cons _ _ => rfl

theorem observeVertical :
    Commutes₁ completionPort observationPort (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T0.Gron.observe observe := by
  intro c _
  cases c <;> first
  | rfl
  | simp only [observe, completionPort, observationPort, PortLift.project, Gen.T0.Gron.observe,
      NonemptyOutput.toBytes, isEmptyFalse _ (lineBytes _),
      isEmptyFalse _ (suffixBytes _ usage (by decide)), Bool.not_false] <;> rfl

private def lookupField {α : Type} (fields : List (String × α)) (key : String) : Option α :=
  (fields.reverse.find? (fun p => p.1 == key)).map Prod.snd

private theorem lookupFieldMap {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (fields : List (String × α)) (key : String) :
    lookupField (fields.map (fun p => (p.1, f p.2))) key = (lookupField fields key).map f := by
  unfold lookupField
  rw [← List.map_reverse, List.find?_map]
  simp only [Option.map_map, Function.comp_def]

private theorem fieldKeyMem (fields : List (String × Json)) (key : String) :
    key ∈ fields.map Prod.fst ↔ (lastMember fields key).isSome = true := by
  simp [lastMember, List.find?_isSome, List.mem_map, List.mem_reverse]

private theorem fieldOrder (mode : KeyOrder.Mode) (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    objectMemberOrder fields (KeyOrder.keys mode (fields.map Prod.fst)) := by
  obtain ⟨distinct, covers⟩ := KeyOrder.keysRule mode (fields.map Prod.fst)
  exact ⟨distinct, fun key => (covers key).trans (fieldKeyMem fields key)⟩

mutual
private def foldJson {α : Type} (scalar : Scalar → α) (array : List α → α)
    (object : List (String × α) → α) : Json → α
  | .scalar s => scalar s
  | .array xs => array (foldItems scalar array object xs)
  | .object fields => object (foldFields scalar array object fields)
termination_by structural j => j

private def foldItems {α : Type} (scalar : Scalar → α) (array : List α → α)
    (object : List (String × α) → α) : List Json → List α
  | [] => []
  | j :: js => foldJson scalar array object j :: foldItems scalar array object js
termination_by structural js => js

private def foldFields {α : Type} (scalar : Scalar → α) (array : List α → α)
    (object : List (String × α) → α) : List (String × Json) → List (String × α)
  | [] => []
  | (k, j) :: fields => (k, foldJson scalar array object j) :: foldFields scalar array object fields
termination_by structural fields => fields
end

private theorem foldItemsMap {α : Type} (scalar : Scalar → α) (array : List α → α)
    (object : List (String × α) → α) (items : List Json) :
    foldItems scalar array object items = items.map (foldJson scalar array object) := by
  induction items with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j js ih => exact congrArg (foldJson scalar array object j :: ·) ih

private theorem foldFieldsMap {α : Type} (scalar : Scalar → α) (array : List α → α)
    (object : List (String × α) → α) (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    foldFields scalar array object fields =
      fields.map (fun p => (p.1, foldJson scalar array object p.2)) := by
  induction fields with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p fields ih =>
    rcases p with ⟨k, j⟩
    exact congrArg ((k, foldJson scalar array object j) :: ·) ih

private def statementOrder (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (sorted : Bool) : KeyOrder.Mode :=
  if sorted then .statement ⟨a.starts, a.continues⟩ else .unsorted

private theorem statementOrderText (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (k : String) :
    KeyOrder.segmentText ⟨a.starts, a.continues⟩ k = jsSegment a false (.key k) := rfl

private def flattenedArray (items : List (Path → List Statement)) (p : Path) : List Statement :=
  ⟨p, .array⟩ :: (items.zipIdx.flatMap (fun (child, i) => child (p ++ [.index i])))

private def flattenedObject (mode : KeyOrder.Mode) (fields : List (String × (Path → List Statement)))
    (p : Path) : List Statement :=
  let keys := KeyOrder.keys mode (fields.map Prod.fst)
  ⟨p, .object⟩ :: (keys.flatMap fun k =>
    match lookupField fields k with
    | none => []
    | some child => child (p ++ [.key k]))

def flatten (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (sorted : Bool) (p : Path) (j : Json) : List Statement :=
  foldJson (fun s base => [⟨base, .scalar s⟩]) flattenedArray
    (flattenedObject (statementOrder alphabet sorted)) j p

theorem flattenScalar (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (sorted : Bool) (p : Path) (s : Scalar) :
    flatten alphabet sorted p (.scalar s) = [⟨p, .scalar s⟩] := rfl

private theorem zipIdxMap {α β : Type} (f : α → β) (items : List α) (start : Nat) :
    (items.map f).zipIdx start =
      (items.zipIdx start).map (fun p => (f p.1, p.2)) := by
  induction items generalizing start with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j js ih => simp only [List.map_cons, List.zipIdx_cons, ih]

theorem flattenArray (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (sorted : Bool) (p : Path) (xs : List Json) :
    flatten alphabet sorted p (.array xs) =
      ⟨p, .array⟩ :: (xs.zipIdx.flatMap fun (v, i) => flatten alphabet sorted (p ++ [.index i]) v) := by
  unfold flatten
  rw [foldJson, foldItemsMap]
  simp only [flattenedArray, zipIdxMap, List.flatMap_map, Function.comp_def]

theorem flattenObject (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (sorted : Bool) (p : Path)
    (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    ∃ keys, objectMemberOrder fields keys ∧
      (sorted = true → keys.Pairwise (fun a b =>
        jsSegment alphabet false (.key a) < jsSegment alphabet false (.key b))) ∧
      flatten alphabet sorted p (.object fields) =
        ⟨p, .object⟩ :: (keys.flatMap fun k =>
          match lastMember fields k with
          | none => []
          | some v => flatten alphabet sorted (p ++ [.key k]) v) := by
  let mode := statementOrder alphabet sorted
  refine ⟨KeyOrder.keys mode (fields.map Prod.fst), fieldOrder mode fields, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    subst sorted
    simpa only [mode, statementOrder, if_true, ← statementOrderText] using
      KeyOrder.statementSorted ⟨alphabet.starts, alphabet.continues⟩ (fields.map Prod.fst)
  · unfold flatten
    rw [foldJson, foldFieldsMap]
    simp only [flattenedObject, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
    apply congrArg (Statement.mk p .object :: ·)
    change (KeyOrder.keys mode (fields.map Prod.fst)).flatMap _ = _
    induction KeyOrder.keys mode (fields.map Prod.fst) with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons key keys ih =>
      rw [List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons, ih, lookupFieldMap]
      rw [show lookupField fields key = lastMember fields key from rfl]
      cases lastMember fields key <;> rfl

private def renderLine (style : Style) (st : Statement) : String :=
  let val := renderAtom style.color st.value
  let b := paint style.color .bracket
  if style.json then
    b "[" ++ b "[" ++ String.intercalate "," (st.path.map (jsonSegment style.color)) ++
      b "]" ++ "," ++ val ++ b "]"
  else
    paint style.color .name "json" ++
      String.intercalate "" (st.path.map (jsSegment style.alphabet style.color)) ++ " = " ++ val ++ ";"

def render (style : Style) (st : Statement) : Bytes := bytes (renderLine style st ++ "\n")

theorem renderRule (style : Style) (st : Statement) : render style st =
  let val := renderAtom style.color st.value
  let b := paint style.color .bracket
  if style.json then
    bytes (b "[" ++ b "[" ++ String.intercalate "," (st.path.map (jsonSegment style.color)) ++
      b "]" ++ "," ++ val ++ b "]" ++ "\n")
  else
    bytes (paint style.color .name "json" ++
      String.intercalate "" (st.path.map (jsSegment style.alphabet style.color)) ++ " = " ++ val ++ ";\n") := by
  unfold render renderLine
  split <;> simp_all only [String.append_assoc] <;> rfl

private def documentFields (color : Bool) (fields : List (String × (Nat → String)))
    (level : Nat) : String :=
  let keys := KeyOrder.keys .document (fields.map Prod.fst)
  docContainer color level "{" "}" (keys.filterMap fun k =>
    (lookupField fields k).map (fun child => docMember color k (child (level + 1))))

def document (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (j : Json) : String :=
  foldJson (fun s _ => renderScalar false color s)
    (fun items base =>
      docContainer color base "[" "]" (items.map fun child => child (base + 1)))
    (documentFields color) j level

theorem documentScalar (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (s : Scalar) :
    document color level (.scalar s) = renderScalar false color s := rfl

theorem documentArray (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (xs : List Json) :
    document color level (.array xs) =
      docContainer color level "[" "]" (xs.map (document color (level + 1))) := by
  unfold document
  rw [foldJson, foldItemsMap]
  simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def]

theorem documentObject (color : Bool) (level : Nat) (fields : List (String × Json))
    (keys : List String) (covers : objectMemberOrder fields keys)
    (sorted : keys.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b)) :
    document color level (.object fields) =
      docContainer color level "{" "}" (keys.filterMap fun k =>
        (lastMember fields k).map (fun v => docMember color k (document color (level + 1) v))) := by
  have actual := fieldOrder .document fields
  have same : ∀ k, k ∈ KeyOrder.keys .document (fields.map Prod.fst) ↔ k ∈ keys :=
    fun k => (actual.2 k).trans (covers.2 k).symm
  have perm := (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup actual.1 covers.1).mpr same
  have keysEq : KeyOrder.keys .document (fields.map Prod.fst) = keys :=
    perm.eq_of_pairwise (fun _ _ _ _ h h' => False.elim (String.lt_asymm h h'))
      (KeyOrder.documentSorted (fields.map Prod.fst)) sorted
  unfold document
  rw [foldJson, foldFieldsMap]
  simp only [documentFields, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, keysEq]
  apply congrArg (docContainer color level "{" "}")
  induction keys with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons key keys ih =>
    simp only [List.filterMap_cons, lookupFieldMap, Option.map_map, Function.comp_def, ih]
    rfl

private def toMergeTree : Json → Merge.Tree Scalar :=
  foldJson Merge.Tree.scalar Merge.Tree.array Merge.Tree.object

private def toMergeItems (items : List Json) : List (Merge.Tree Scalar) :=
  items.map toMergeTree

private def toMergeFields (fields : List (String × Json)) : List (String × Merge.Tree Scalar) :=
  fields.map (fun p => (p.1, toMergeTree p.2))

private theorem toMergeTreeArray (items : List Json) :
    toMergeTree (.array items) = .array (toMergeItems items) :=
  congrArg Merge.Tree.array (foldItemsMap Merge.Tree.scalar Merge.Tree.array Merge.Tree.object items)

private theorem toMergeTreeObject (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    toMergeTree (.object fields) = .object (toMergeFields fields) :=
  congrArg Merge.Tree.object (foldFieldsMap Merge.Tree.scalar Merge.Tree.array Merge.Tree.object fields)

mutual
private def fromMergeTree : Merge.Tree Scalar → Json
  | .scalar s => .scalar s
  | .array xs => .array (fromMergeItems xs)
  | .object fields => .object (fromMergeFields fields)
termination_by structural tree => tree

private def fromMergeItems : List (Merge.Tree Scalar) → List Json
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => fromMergeTree x :: fromMergeItems xs
termination_by structural xs => xs

private def fromMergeFields : List (String × Merge.Tree Scalar) → List (String × Json)
  | [] => []
  | (k, v) :: fields => (k, fromMergeTree v) :: fromMergeFields fields
termination_by structural fields => fields
end

mutual
private theorem fromToTree (j : Json) : fromMergeTree (toMergeTree j) = j :=
  match j with
  | .scalar _ => rfl
  | .array items => by
    rw [toMergeTreeArray]
    exact congrArg Json.array (fromToItems items)
  | .object fields => by
    rw [toMergeTreeObject]
    exact congrArg Json.object (fromToFields fields)
termination_by structural j

private theorem fromToItems (items : List Json) : fromMergeItems (toMergeItems items) = items :=
  match items with
  | [] => rfl
  | j :: js => by
    change fromMergeTree (toMergeTree j) :: fromMergeItems (toMergeItems js) = j :: js
    rw [fromToTree j, fromToItems js]
termination_by structural items

private theorem fromToFields (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    fromMergeFields (toMergeFields fields) = fields :=
  match fields with
  | [] => rfl
  | (k, v) :: rest => by
    change (k, fromMergeTree (toMergeTree v)) :: fromMergeFields (toMergeFields rest) = (k, v) :: rest
    rw [fromToTree v, fromToFields rest]
termination_by structural fields
end

mutual
private theorem toFromTree (tree : Merge.Tree Scalar) : toMergeTree (fromMergeTree tree) = tree :=
  match tree with
  | .scalar _ => rfl
  | .array items => by
    change toMergeTree (.array (fromMergeItems items)) = .array items
    rw [toMergeTreeArray, toFromItems items]
  | .object fields => by
    change toMergeTree (.object (fromMergeFields fields)) = .object fields
    rw [toMergeTreeObject, toFromFields fields]
termination_by structural tree

private theorem toFromItems (items : List (Merge.Tree Scalar)) :
    toMergeItems (fromMergeItems items) = items :=
  match items with
  | [] => rfl
  | j :: js => by
    change toMergeTree (fromMergeTree j) :: toMergeItems (fromMergeItems js) = j :: js
    rw [toFromTree j, toFromItems js]
termination_by structural items

private theorem toFromFields (fields : List (String × Merge.Tree Scalar)) :
    toMergeFields (fromMergeFields fields) = fields :=
  match fields with
  | [] => rfl
  | (k, v) :: rest => by
    change (k, toMergeTree (fromMergeTree v)) :: toMergeFields (fromMergeFields rest) = (k, v) :: rest
    rw [toFromTree v, toFromFields rest]
termination_by structural fields
end

private def leafIsNull : Scalar → Bool
  | .null => true
  | _ => false

private theorem mergeIsNull (j : Json) : Merge.isNull leafIsNull (toMergeTree j) = isNull j := by
  cases j with
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl
  | array _ => rfl
  | object _ => rfl

private theorem mergeIsArray (j : Json) : Merge.isArray (toMergeTree j) = isArray j := by
  cases j <;> rfl

private theorem mergeIsObject (j : Json) : Merge.isObject (toMergeTree j) = isObject j := by
  cases j <;> rfl

private theorem toMergeFieldsReplace (key : String) (v : Json) (fields : List (String × Json)) :
    toMergeFields (replaceMember key v fields) =
      Merge.replaceMember key (toMergeTree v) (toMergeFields fields) := by
  simp only [toMergeFields, replaceMember, Merge.replaceMember, List.map_append,
    List.filter_map, Function.comp_def, List.map_cons, List.map_nil]

def merge (x y : Json) : Except String Json :=
  (Merge.merge leafIsNull (toMergeTree x) (toMergeTree y)).map fromMergeTree

def mergeSlots (xs ys : List Json) : Except String (List Json) :=
  (Merge.mergeSlots leafIsNull (toMergeItems xs) (toMergeItems ys)).map fromMergeItems

theorem mergeScalar (x : Scalar) (y : Json) : merge (.scalar x) y = .ok y := by
  change (Merge.merge leafIsNull (.scalar x) (toMergeTree y)).map fromMergeTree = .ok y
  rw [Merge.mergeScalar]
  exact congrArg Except.ok (fromToTree y)

theorem mergeArrayMismatch (xs : List Json) (y : Json) (h : isArray y = false) :
    merge (.array xs) y = .error "cannot merge array with non-array" := by
  unfold merge
  rw [toMergeTreeArray, Merge.mergeArrayMismatch leafIsNull _ _ ((mergeIsArray y).trans h)]

    "\"" ++ s ++ "\""
  else
    reprStr s

theorem quotePlain : ∀ s,
    s.toList.all (fun c => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127 && c != '"' && c != '\\') = true →

(submission (kind plan) (why "无序模式保留键首次出现的顺序。排序模式缓存排序值，归并排序后去重。片段编码的单射性保证不同的键严格有序。") (main "namespace Gen.T1.Gron.KeyOrder
/-- Letter and continuation classes for non-ASCII identifiers at the input boundary. -/
structure IdentifierAlphabet where
  starts : Char → Bool
  continues : Char → Bool
def reservedIdentifier : List String :=
  ["break","case","catch","class","const","continue","debugger","default","delete","do",
   "else","export","extends","false","finally","for","function","if","import","in",
   "instanceof","new","null","return","super","switch","this","throw","true","try",
   "typeof","var","void","while","with","yield"]
def startsIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then c.isAlpha || c == '$' || c == '_' else a.starts c
def continuesIdentifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (c : Char) : Bool :=
  if c.toNat < 128 then startsIdentifier a c || c.isDigit else a.continues c
def identifier (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (s : String) : Bool :=
  match s.toList with
  | [] => false
  | c :: cs => !reservedIdentifier.contains s && startsIdentifier a c &&
    cs.all (continuesIdentifier a)
def hexDigit (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 10 then 48 + n else (if upper then 55 else 87) + n)
def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))
/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c
def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))
def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""
def segmentText (a : IdentifierAlphabet) (key : String) : String :=
  if identifier a key then "." ++ key else "[" ++ quote true key ++ "]"
inductive Mode where
  | unsorted
  | document
  | statement (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet)

private theorem smallCharToNat (n : Nat) (hn : n < 128) : (Char.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  have valid : n.isValidChar := Or.inl (by omega)
  unfold Char.ofNat
  rw [dif_pos valid]
  change (BitVec.ofNatLT n _).toNat = n
  rfl

private theorem hexDigitInjective {m n : Nat} (hm : m < 16) (hn : n < 16)
    (h : hexDigit true m = hexDigit true n) : m = n := by
  have small (k : Nat) (hk : k < 16) : (if k < 10 then 48 + k else 55 + k) < 128 := by
    split <;> omega
  have codes := congrArg Char.toNat h
  simp only [hexDigit, if_true, smallCharToNat _ (small m hm), smallCharToNat _ (small n hn)]
    at codes
  by_cases md : m < 10 <;> by_cases nd : n < 10 <;> simp [md, nd] at codes <;> omega

private theorem hex4Injective {m n : Nat} (hm : m < 65536) (hn : n < 65536)
    (h : (hex4 true m).toList = (hex4 true n).toList) : m = n := by
  simp only [hex4, String.toList_ofList, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.cons.injEq,
    eq_self, and_true] at h
  have digit {a b : Nat} (he : hexDigit true (a % 16) = hexDigit true (b % 16)) :
      a % 16 = b % 16 :=
    hexDigitInjective (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)) he
  obtain ⟨h3, h2, h1, h0⟩ := h
  have d3 := digit h3
  have d2 := digit h2
  have d1 := digit h1
  have d0 := digit h0
  omega

private def shortSource : Char → Char
  | 't' => '\t'
  | 'r' => '\r'
  | 'n' => '\n'
  | 'b' => Char.ofNat 8
  | 'f' => Char.ofNat 12
  | tag => tag

private theorem escapeShape (c : Char) :
    ((escapeChar true c).toList = [c] ∧ c ≠ '\\') ∨
    (∃ tag, (escapeChar true c).toList = ['\\', tag] ∧ tag ≠ 'u' ∧ c = shortSource tag) ∨
    ((escapeChar true c).toList = '\\' :: 'u' :: (hex4 true c.toNat).toList ∧
      c.toNat < 65536) := by
  unfold escapeChar
  split
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'"', rfl, by decide, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'\\', rfl, by decide, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'t', rfl, by decide, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'r', rfl, by decide, rfl⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'n', rfl, by decide, rfl⟩)
  · rename_i _ notSlash _ _ _
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i code
      have hc : c.toNat = 8 := beq_iff_eq.mp code
      exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'b', rfl, by decide, Char.toNat_inj.mp hc⟩)
    · split
      · rename_i code
        have hc : c.toNat = 12 := beq_iff_eq.mp code
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨'f', rfl, by decide, Char.toNat_inj.mp hc⟩)
      · split
        · rename_i code
          simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.true_and, decide_eq_true_eq,
            beq_iff_eq] at code
          exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by rw [String.toList_append]; rfl, by omega⟩)
        · exact Or.inl ⟨String.toList_singleton _, notSlash⟩

private theorem escapeNonempty (c : Char) : (escapeChar true c).toList ≠ [] := by
  rcases escapeShape c with ⟨shape, _⟩ | ⟨_, shape, _, _⟩ | ⟨shape, _⟩ <;> simp [shape]

private theorem escapeAppendCancel {a b : Char} {xs ys : List Char}
    (h : (escapeChar true a).toList ++ xs = (escapeChar true b).toList ++ ys) :
    a = b ∧ xs = ys := by
  rcases escapeShape a with ⟨ha, na⟩ | ⟨ta, ha, na, sa⟩ | ⟨ha, ba⟩ <;>
    rcases escapeShape b with ⟨hb, nb⟩ | ⟨tb, hb, nb, sb⟩ | ⟨hb, bb⟩ <;>
    simp only [ha, hb, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq, eq_self, true_and] at h
  · exact h
  · exact (na h.1).elim
  · exact (na h.1).elim
  · exact (nb h.1.symm).elim
  · exact ⟨sa.trans ((congrArg shortSource h.1).trans sb.symm), h.2⟩
  · exact (na h.1).elim
  · exact (nb h.1.symm).elim
  · exact (nb h.1.symm).elim
  · have tails := List.append_inj h (by simp [hex4])
    exact ⟨Char.toNat_inj.mp (hex4Injective ba bb tails.1), tails.2⟩

private theorem flatEscapeInjective {xs ys : List Char}
    (h : xs.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList) =
      ys.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList)) : xs = ys := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b bs =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_nil, List.flatMap_cons] at h
      exact (escapeNonempty b (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp h.symm).1).elim
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_nil, List.flatMap_cons] at h
      exact (escapeNonempty a (List.append_eq_nil_iff.mp h).1).elim
    | cons b bs =>
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons] at h
      obtain ⟨head, tail⟩ := escapeAppendCancel h
      rw [head, ih tail]

private theorem escapedToList (s : String) :
    (escaped true s).toList = s.toList.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList) := by
  simp only [escaped, String.toList_intercalate, List.map_map]
  change ([] : List Char).intercalate (s.toList.map (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList)) = _
  induction s.toList with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    cases cs with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.intercalate_singleton, List.flatMap_cons,
        List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
    | cons d ds =>
      rw [List.map_cons, List.intercalate_cons_of_ne_nil (by simp), List.append_nil, ih]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons]

private theorem segmentTextInjective (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) {x y : String}
    (h : segmentText alphabet x = segmentText alphabet y) : x = y := by
  unfold segmentText at h
  split at h <;> split at h <;>
    have codes := congrArg String.toList h <;>
    simp only [String.toList_append] at codes
  · exact String.toList_injective (List.append_cancel_left codes)
  · exact (by decide : '.' ≠ '[') (List.cons.inj codes).1 |>.elim
  · exact (by decide : '[' ≠ '.') (List.cons.inj codes).1 |>.elim
  · have quoted := List.append_cancel_left (List.append_cancel_right codes)
    simp only [quote, String.toList_append] at quoted
    have contents := List.append_cancel_left (List.append_cancel_right quoted)
    exact String.toList_injective
      (flatEscapeInjective (by simpa only [escapedToList] using contents))

private abbrev RankedKey := String × String

private def sortByRank (entries : List RankedKey) : List RankedKey :=
  entries.mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.1 ≤ b.1))

private theorem sortByRankRules (entries : List RankedKey) :
    (sortByRank entries).Pairwise (fun a b => a.1 ≤ b.1) ∧
      (sortByRank entries).Perm entries := by
  unfold sortByRank
  constructor
  · apply List.Pairwise.imp (fun h => of_decide_eq_true h)
    apply List.pairwise_mergeSort
    · intro a b c hab hbc
      exact decide_eq_true (String.le_trans (of_decide_eq_true hab) (of_decide_eq_true hbc))
    · intro a b
      rcases String.le_total a.1 b.1 with h | h
      · simp only [decide_eq_true h, Bool.true_or]
      · simp only [decide_eq_true h, Bool.or_true]
  · exact List.mergeSort_perm _ _

private def keepDistinctRank (entry : RankedKey) (kept : List RankedKey) : List RankedKey :=
  match kept with
  | [] => [entry]
  | first :: _ => if entry.1 = first.1 then kept else entry :: kept

private theorem distinctRankRules {entries : List RankedKey}
    (coherent : ∀ {a b}, a ∈ entries → b ∈ entries → a.1 = b.1 → a = b)
    (sorted : entries.Pairwise (fun a b => a.1 ≤ b.1)) :
    let kept := entries.foldr keepDistinctRank []
    kept.Pairwise (fun a b => a.1 < b.1) ∧ ∀ entry, entry ∈ kept ↔ entry ∈ entries := by
  induction sorted with
  | nil => simp
  | @cons entry rest lower sorted ih =>
    have rules := ih (fun ha hb eq =>
      coherent (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ha) (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb) eq)
    dsimp only at rules ⊢
    rw [List.foldr_cons]
    generalize rest.foldr keepDistinctRank [] = kept at rules ⊢
    obtain ⟨strict, members⟩ := rules
    cases kept with
    | nil =>
      refine ⟨by simp [keepDistinctRank], ?_⟩
      intro key
      have absent : key ∉ rest := fun h => List.not_mem_nil ((members key).mpr h)
      simp [keepDistinctRank, absent]
    | cons first later =>
      have inRest : first ∈ rest := (members first).mp (by simp)
      by_cases tie : entry.1 = first.1
      · have same : entry = first :=
          coherent (by simp) (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ inRest) tie
        simp only [keepDistinctRank, if_pos tie]
        refine ⟨strict, ?_⟩
        intro key
        rw [members, List.mem_cons]
        exact ⟨Or.inr, fun h => h.elim (fun he => (he.trans same).symm ▸ inRest) id⟩
      · simp only [keepDistinctRank, if_neg tie]
        have firstLt : entry.1 < first.1 :=
          String.not_le.mp (fun h => tie (String.le_antisymm (lower first inRest) h))
        refine ⟨List.pairwise_cons.mpr ⟨?_, strict⟩, ?_⟩
        · intro key hm
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hm with rfl | laterMember
          · exact firstLt
          · exact String.lt_trans firstLt ((List.pairwise_cons.mp strict).1 _ laterMember)
        · intro key
          simp only [List.mem_cons (b := entry), members key]

private def orderedKeys (rank : String → String) (input : List String) : List String :=
  let entries := input.map (fun key => (rank key, key))
  let sorted := sortByRank entries
  (sorted.foldr keepDistinctRank []).map Prod.snd

private theorem orderedKeysRules (rank : String → String)
    (injective : ∀ {a b}, rank a = rank b → a = b) (input : List String) :
    let output := orderedKeys rank input
    output.Pairwise (fun a b => rank a < rank b) ∧
      (output.Nodup ∧ ∀ key, key ∈ output ↔ key ∈ input) := by
  let entries := input.map (fun key => (rank key, key))
  let sorted := sortByRank entries
  obtain ⟨weak, permutation⟩ := sortByRankRules entries
  have rankOf {entry : RankedKey} (h : entry ∈ sorted) : entry.1 = rank entry.2 := by
    obtain ⟨key, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (permutation.mem_iff.mp h)
    rfl
  have coherent {a b : RankedKey} (ha : a ∈ sorted) (hb : b ∈ sorted)
      (eq : a.1 = b.1) : a = b :=
    Prod.ext eq (injective ((rankOf ha).symm.trans (eq.trans (rankOf hb))))
  obtain ⟨strict, members⟩ := distinctRankRules coherent weak
  change let output := (sorted.foldr keepDistinctRank []).map Prod.snd
    output.Pairwise (fun a b => rank a < rank b) ∧
      (output.Nodup ∧ ∀ key, key ∈ output ↔ key ∈ input)
  dsimp only
  have ordered :
      ((sorted.foldr keepDistinctRank []).map Prod.snd).Pairwise (fun a b => rank a < rank b) := by
    apply List.pairwise_map.mpr
    apply List.Pairwise.imp_of_mem _ strict
    intro a b ha hb h
    rw [← rankOf ((members a).mp ha), ← rankOf ((members b).mp hb)]
    exact h
  refine ⟨ordered, List.nodup_iff_pairwise_ne.mpr (ordered.imp ?_), ?_⟩
  · intro a b h same
    cases same
    exact String.lt_irrefl _ h
  · intro key
    rw [List.mem_map]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨entry, hin, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ :=
        List.mem_map.mp (permutation.mem_iff.mp ((members entry).mp hin))
      exact hj
    · intro hin
      exact ⟨(rank key, key), (members _).mpr
        (permutation.mem_iff.mpr (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨key, hin, rfl⟩)), rfl⟩

private theorem eraseDupsRules (input : List String) :
    input.eraseDups.Nodup ∧ ∀ key, key ∈ input.eraseDups ↔ key ∈ input := by
  cases input with
  | nil => simp
  | cons first rest =>
    rw [List.eraseDups_cons]
    obtain ⟨tailUnique, tailMembers⟩ := eraseDupsRules (rest.filter (fun key => !(key == first)))
    have inTail (key : String) :
        key ∈ (rest.filter (fun k => !(k == first))).eraseDups ↔ key ∈ rest ∧ key ≠ first := by
      rw [tailMembers]
      simp
    refine ⟨List.nodup_cons.mpr ⟨fun h => ((inTail first).mp h).2 rfl, tailUnique⟩, ?_⟩
    intro key
    simp only [List.mem_cons, inTail]
    by_cases same : key = first <;> simp [same]
termination_by input.length
decreasing_by exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (List.length_filter_le _ _)

def keys : Mode → List String → List String
  | .unsorted, input => input.eraseDups
  | .document, input => orderedKeys id input
  | .statement alphabet, input => orderedKeys (segmentText alphabet) input

theorem keysRule : ∀ mode input,
    (keys mode input).Nodup ∧ ∀ key, key ∈ keys mode input ↔ key ∈ input := by
  intro mode input
  cases mode with
  | unsorted => exact eraseDupsRules input
  | document => exact (orderedKeysRules id (fun h => h) input).2
  | statement alphabet =>
    exact (orderedKeysRules (segmentText alphabet) (segmentTextInjective alphabet) input).2

theorem documentSorted : ∀ input, (keys .document input).Pairwise (fun a b => a < b) :=
  fun input => (orderedKeysRules id (fun h => h) input).1

theorem statementSorted : ∀ alphabet input,
    (keys (.statement alphabet) input).Pairwise
      (fun a b => segmentText alphabet a < segmentText alphabet b) :=
  fun alphabet input =>
    (orderedKeysRules (segmentText alphabet) (segmentTextInjective alphabet) input).1

end Gen.T1.Gron.KeyOrder

inductive Tree (Leaf : Type) where
  | scalar (value : Leaf)
  | array (items : List (Tree Leaf))
  | object (fields : List (String × Tree Leaf))
def isArray {Leaf : Type} : Tree Leaf → Bool
  | .array _ => true
  | _ => false
def isObject {Leaf : Type} : Tree Leaf → Bool
  | .object _ => true
  | _ => false
def isNull {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) : Tree Leaf → Bool
  | .scalar a => nullLeaf a
  | _ => false
def lastMember {Leaf : Type} (fields : List (String × Tree Leaf)) (key : String) : Option (Tree Leaf) :=
  (fields.reverse.find? (fun p => p.1 == key)).map Prod.snd
def replaceMember {Leaf : Type} (key : String) (v : Tree Leaf) (fields : List (String × Tree Leaf)) :
    List (String × Tree Leaf) :=
  (fields.filter (fun p => p.1 != key)) ++ [(key, v)]

mutual
  def merge {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (left right : Tree Leaf) :
      Except String (Tree Leaf) :=
    match left with
    | .scalar _ => .ok right
    | .array xs =>
      match right with
      | .array ys => (mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys []).map Tree.array
      | _ => .error "cannot merge array with non-array"
    | .object xs =>
      match right with
      | .object ys => mergeMembers nullLeaf xs ys
      | _ => .error "cannot merge object with non-object"
  termination_by structural right

  private def mergeSlotsRev {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
      (xs ys acc : List (Tree Leaf)) : Except String (List (Tree Leaf)) :=
    match ys with
    | [] => .ok (acc.reverseAux xs)
    | y :: ys =>
      match xs with
      | [] => .ok (acc.reverseAux (y :: ys))
      | x :: xs =>
        match (if isNull nullLeaf y then .ok x else merge nullLeaf x y) with
        | .error e => .error e
        | .ok v => mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys (v :: acc)
  termination_by structural ys

  private def mergeMembers {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
      (xs ys : List (String × Tree Leaf)) : Except String (Tree Leaf) :=
    match ys with
    | [] => .ok (.object xs)
    | (k, v) :: ys =>
      let merged : Except String (Tree Leaf) := match lastMember xs k with
        | none => .ok v
        | some old => merge nullLeaf old v
      match merged with
      | .error e => .error e
      | .ok nv => mergeMembers nullLeaf (replaceMember k nv xs) ys
  termination_by structural ys
end

def mergeSlots {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (xs ys : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    Except String (List (Tree Leaf)) :=
  mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys []

private theorem mergeSlotsRevAppend {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
    (xs ys acc extra : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys (acc ++ extra) =
      (mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys acc).map (fun zs => extra.reverse ++ zs) := by
  induction ys generalizing xs acc with
  | nil => simp [mergeSlotsRev, List.reverseAux_eq, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc, Except.map]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp [mergeSlotsRev, List.reverseAux_eq, List.reverse_append, List.append_assoc, Except.map]
    | cons x xs =>
      cases h : (if isNull nullLeaf y then .ok x else merge nullLeaf x y) with
      | error e => simp [mergeSlotsRev, h, Except.map]
      | ok v => simpa [mergeSlotsRev, h] using ih xs (v :: acc)

theorem mergeScalar {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (x : Leaf) (y : Tree Leaf) :
    merge nullLeaf (.scalar x) y = .ok y := by
  cases y <;> rfl

theorem mergeArrayMismatch {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
    (xs : List (Tree Leaf)) (y : Tree Leaf) (h : isArray y = false) :
    merge nullLeaf (.array xs) y = .error "cannot merge array with non-array" := by
  cases y <;> first | rfl | cases h

theorem mergeObjectMismatch {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
    (xs : List (String × Tree Leaf)) (y : Tree Leaf) (h : isObject y = false) :
    merge nullLeaf (.object xs) y = .error "cannot merge object with non-object" := by
  cases y <;> first | rfl | cases h

theorem mergeArray {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (xs ys : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    merge nullLeaf (.array xs) (.array ys) = (mergeSlots nullLeaf xs ys).map Tree.array := rfl

theorem mergeSlotsLeftEmpty {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (ys : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    mergeSlots nullLeaf [] ys = .ok ys := by
  cases ys <;> rfl

theorem mergeSlotsRightEmpty {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (xs : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    mergeSlots nullLeaf xs [] = .ok xs := rfl

theorem mergeSlotsStep {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool)
    (x : Tree Leaf) (xs : List (Tree Leaf)) (y : Tree Leaf) (ys : List (Tree Leaf)) :
    mergeSlots nullLeaf (x :: xs) (y :: ys) = (do
      let v ← if isNull nullLeaf y then .ok x else merge nullLeaf x y
      let rest ← mergeSlots nullLeaf xs ys
      return v :: rest) := by
  have prepend (v : Tree Leaf) : mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys [v] =
      (mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys []).map (fun zs => v :: zs) :=
    mergeSlotsRevAppend nullLeaf xs ys [] [v]
  by_cases h : isNull nullLeaf y = true
  · simp only [mergeSlots, mergeSlotsRev, if_pos h, prepend]
    cases mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys [] <;> rfl
  · cases hm : merge nullLeaf x y with
    | error e => simp only [mergeSlots, mergeSlotsRev, if_neg h, hm] <;> rfl
    | ok v =>
      simp only [mergeSlots, mergeSlotsRev, if_neg h, hm, prepend]
      cases mergeSlotsRev nullLeaf xs ys [] <;> rfl

theorem mergeObjectEmpty {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (xs : List (String × Tree Leaf)) :
    merge nullLeaf (.object xs) (.object []) = .ok (.object xs) := rfl

theorem mergeObjectStep {Leaf : Type} (nullLeaf : Leaf → Bool) (xs : List (String × Tree Leaf))
    (k : String) (v : Tree Leaf) (ys : List (String × Tree Leaf)) :
    merge nullLeaf (.object xs) (.object ((k, v) :: ys)) = (do
      let nv ← match lastMember xs k with
        | none => .ok v
        | some old => merge nullLeaf old v
      merge nullLeaf (.object (replaceMember k nv xs)) (.object ys)) := by
  cases h : lastMember xs k with
  | none => simp only [merge, mergeMembers, h] <;> rfl
  | some old =>
    cases hm : merge nullLeaf old v <;>
      simp only [merge, mergeMembers, h, hm] <;> rfl
end Gen.T1.Gron.Merge
