import Gen.T1.Gron
import LojitaCtx.Blueprint
import LojitaCtx.CharClass
import LojitaCtx.Cli
import LojitaCtx.HttpLaws
import LojitaCtx.ToolLaws

namespace Gen.T2.Gron
open LojitaCtx.Blueprint LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open LojitaCtx.PosixChannel (evalScanner)
open LojitaCtx.NetSandbox (encodeHttpResp)
open Gen.T1.Gron (Options Invocation Command Flag BoolFlag TextFlag Source Style Environment
  Json Scalar Assignment Segment Path LineError Completion Observation Acquired DecodedInput)

structure Launch where
  name : String
  args : List String

def pathBase (name : String) : String :=
  ((name.splitOn "/").filter (fun s => !s.isEmpty)).getLastD ""

def applyProgramName (name : String) : Invocation → Invocation
  | .parsed o operands =>
    .parsed {o with reverse := o.reverse || pathBase name == "ungron"} operands
  | .help => .help
  | .rejected m => .rejected m

def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := Gen.T1.Gron.hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n

def quoteFlag (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map goEscape) ++ "\""

axiom parseFlags : Options → List String → Invocation
axiom parseFlagsEnd : ∀ o, parseFlags o [] = .parsed o []
axiom parseFlagsStep : ∀ o arg rest, parseFlags o (arg :: rest) =
  match Gen.T1.Gron.flagPrefix arg with
  | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
  | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
  | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
  | .flag name attached =>
    match Gen.T1.Gron.flagNamed name with
    | none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
    | some .help => .help
    | some (.boolean flag) =>
      match attached with
      | none => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
      | some value =>
        match Gen.T1.Gron.boolArgument value with
        | some b => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
        | none =>
          .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteFlag value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
    | some (.text flag) =>
      match attached, rest with
      | some value, _ => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) rest
      | none, value :: tail => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) tail
      | none, [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name)

def invocationPort : PortLift Invocation Launch :=
  ⟨fun p => applyProgramName p.name (parseFlags {} p.args)⟩

axiom dispatch : Launch → Command
axiom dispatchVertical :
  Commutes₁ invocationPort (keepPort Command) (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch dispatch

structure Config where
  invocation : Invocation
  command : Command
  source : Option Source
  style : Style

axiom alphabet : Gen.T1.Gron.IdentifierAlphabet
axiom alphabetLetter : ∀ c, LojitaCtx.CharClass.alpha c = true → alphabet.starts c = true
axiom alphabetContinueLetter : ∀ c, alphabet.starts c = true → alphabet.continues c = true

def letterNumber (c : Char) : Bool :=
  ([(5870, 5872), (8544, 8578), (8581, 8584), (12295, 12295), (12321, 12329),
    (12344, 12346), (42726, 42735), (65856, 65908), (66369, 66369), (66378, 66378),
    (66513, 66517), (74752, 74862)] : List (Nat × Nat)).any
    (fun (low, high) => low ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat ≤ high)

axiom alphabetLetterNumber : ∀ c, letterNumber c = true → alphabet.starts c = true
axiom alphabetNoJoinControls : ∀ c,
  8204 ≤ c.toNat → c.toNat ≤ 8205 → alphabet.continues c = false

def styleOf (o : Options) (tty : Bool) (term noColor : Option String) : Style :=
  ⟨alphabet, !o.noSort, o.json, Gen.T1.Gron.colorize ⟨o.colorize, o.monochrome, tty, term, noColor⟩⟩

axiom configure : Launch → Bool → Option String → Option String → Config
axiom configureRule : ∀ p tty term noColor, configure p tty term noColor =
  let inv := invocationPort.project p
  let cmd := dispatch p
  match inv with
  | .parsed o operands =>
    ⟨inv, cmd, if o.version then none else some (Gen.T1.Gron.selectSource operands),
      styleOf o tty term noColor⟩
  | _ => ⟨inv, cmd, none, styleOf {} tty term noColor⟩

def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13

def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true

def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true

def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)


def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16

def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n

inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :
      JsonStringPart [92, b] c
  | unicode (digits : Bytes) (c : Char) (h : jsonHexCode digits c.toNat) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))

def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)

structure JsonElement where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : Json

structure JsonMember where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes
  element : JsonElement

def JsonElement.wire (x : JsonElement) : Bytes := x.leading ++ x.spelling ++ x.trailing

def JsonMember.wire (x : JsonMember) : Bytes :=
  x.leading ++ x.keySpelling ++ x.keyPadding ++ [58] ++ x.element.wire

inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : JsonSpelling depth (bytes "null") (.scalar .null)
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (.scalar (.boolean b))
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes n) (.scalar (.number n))
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      JsonSpelling depth wire (.scalar (.string s))
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List JsonElement) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, JsonSpelling depth item.spelling item.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map JsonElement.wire) ++ [93])
        (.array (items.map JsonElement.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List JsonMember) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, JsonSpelling depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map JsonMember.wire) ++ [125])
        (.object (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))

def jsonContainer (j : Json) : Bool := Gen.T1.Gron.isArray j || Gen.T1.Gron.isObject j

axiom JsonScan : Type
axiom jsonScanner : ByteScanner JsonScan (Except String Json)

def oneInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Except String Json) × InChan :=
  evalScanner jsonScanner ch

def decodeJson (bs : Bytes) : Except String Json :=
  ((oneInput (closedPipe bs)).1.value?).getD (.error "EOF")

axiom jsonEmpty : ∀ bs, bs.all jsonSpace = true → decodeJson bs = .error "EOF"
axiom jsonLiteralTail : ∀ pad tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "null" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar .null) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "true" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean true)) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "false" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean false))
axiom jsonWellFormed : ∀ depth pad wire j, depth ≤ 10000 → pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  JsonSpelling depth wire j → decodeJson (pad ++ wire) = .ok j
axiom jsonContainerReady : ∀ depth pad wire tail j closed waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = true →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = (.emit (.ok j), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
axiom jsonScalarWait : ∀ depth pad wire j waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = false →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩)

axiom jsonUnpairedSurrogate : ∀ pad digits tail cp, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonHexCode digits cp → 55296 ≤ cp → cp ≤ 57343 →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34, 92, 117] ++ digits ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (String.singleton (Char.ofNat 65533))))

def jsonStarter (b : UInt8) : Bool :=
  [34, 45, 91, 102, 110, 116, 123].contains b || (48 ≤ b.toNat && b.toNat ≤ 57)

axiom jsonRawString : ∀ pad payload tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  (∀ b ∈ payload, 32 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b ≠ 34 ∧ b ≠ 92) →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34] ++ payload ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (decodeUtf8Lossy payload)))

def quoteByte (b : UInt8) : String :=
  if b == 39 then "'\\''" else if b == 34 then "'\"'"
  else "'" ++ goEscape (Char.ofNat b.toNat) ++ "'"

axiom jsonBadStart : ∀ pad b tail closed waited, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonSpace b = false → jsonStarter b = false → b.toNat < 128 →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ (b :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " looking for beginning of value")),
      ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)

def stripCR (line : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  if line.getLast? == some 13 then line.dropLast else line

def splitLines (input : Bytes) : List Bytes :=
  if input.isEmpty then []
  else
    let parts := List.splitOn 10 input
    if input.getLast? == some 10 then parts.dropLast else parts

def lineInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Option Bytes) × InChan :=
  evalScanner LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner ch

def linePayload (line : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  stripCR (if line.getLast? == some 10 then line.dropLast else line)

def streamRecords (input : Bytes) : List (Except LineError Json) :=
  (splitLines input).map (fun line => (decodeJson (stripCR line)).mapError LineError.decode)

inductive StatementFormat where
  | javascript
  | json
deriving DecidableEq

def jsPath (root : String) (p : Path) : String :=
  root ++ String.intercalate "" (p.map (Gen.T1.Gron.jsSegment alphabet false))

def material (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : Json :=
  match a with
  | .scalar s => .scalar s
  | .array => .array []
  | .object => .object []

def validAtom : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => jsonNumber s
  | _ => True

def jsAssignment (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : String :=
  jsPath root p ++ " = " ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ ";"

def jsAssignmentWithSpaces (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom)
    (before after : String) : String :=
  jsPath root p ++ before ++ "=" ++ after ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ ";"

def statementPath (root : String) (p : Path) : Path :=
  if root == "json" then p else .key root :: p

inductive ReverseLine where
  | skip
  | record (assignment : Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)

axiom reverseLine : StatementFormat → Bytes → ReverseLine
axiom reverseJSBlank : ∀ line, line.all jsonSpace = true → reverseLine .javascript line = .skip
axiom reverseJSONBlank : ∀ line, line.all jsonSpace = true →
  reverseLine .json line = .reject "unexpected end of JSON input"
axiom reverseJSStatement : ∀ root p a before after suffix, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808) →
  validAtom a → before.toList.all (· == ' ') = true → after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true →
  suffix.contains 10 = false →
  reverseLine .javascript (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces root p a before after) ++ suffix) =
    .record ⟨statementPath root p, material a⟩

def exactJsonStatementAtom : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => s = "-0" ∨ ∃ i : Int,
      -9007199254740992 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 9007199254740992 ∧ s = toString i
  | _ => True

def jsonAssignment (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : Bytes :=
  let sep := String.intercalate "," (p.map (Gen.T1.Gron.jsonSegment false))
  bytes ("[[" ++ sep ++ "]," ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ "]")

axiom reverseJSONStatement : ∀ p a,
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9007199254740992) → exactJsonStatementAtom a →
  reverseLine .json (jsonAssignment p a) = .record ⟨p, material a⟩

inductive ReverseRecords where
  | parsed (assignments : List Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)

axiom collectReverse : StatementFormat → List Bytes → ReverseRecords
axiom collectReverseEnd : ∀ format, collectReverse format [] = .parsed []
axiom collectReverseStep : ∀ format line rest,
  collectReverse format (line :: rest) =
  match reverseLine format (stripCR line) with
  | .skip => collectReverse format rest
  | .reject e => .reject e
  | .badIndex i => .badIndex i
  | .record a =>
    match collectReverse format rest with
    | .parsed xs => .parsed (a :: xs)
    | .reject e => .reject e
    | .badIndex i => .badIndex i

def reverseRecords (format : StatementFormat) (input : Bytes) : ReverseRecords :=
  collectReverse format (splitLines input)

def valuesLimit : Nat := 65536

axiom ValueScan : Type
axiom valuesScanner : ByteScanner ValueScan (Option (Except Unit Bytes))

def valuesInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Option (Except Unit Bytes)) × InChan :=
  evalScanner valuesScanner ch

axiom valuesNewline : ∀ line tail closed waited,
  line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line ++ (10 :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
axiom valuesTooLong : ∀ headBytes tail closed waited,
  headBytes.contains 10 = false → headBytes.length = valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨headBytes ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (some (.error ())), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
axiom valuesOpen : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩)
axiom valuesEnd : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line, true, waited⟩ =
    (.ended (if line.isEmpty then none else some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨[], true, waited⟩)

inductive ValueLine where
  | skip
  | emit (value : Bytes)
  | reject

axiom valueLine : Bytes → ValueLine
axiom valueNoEquals : ∀ line, line.contains 61 = false → valueLine line = .skip
axiom valueStatement : ∀ root p a, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808) →
  validAtom a →
  valueLine (bytes (jsAssignment root p a)) =
    match a with
    | .array | .object => .skip
    | .scalar (.string s) => .emit (bytes s)
    | .scalar v => .emit (bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.renderScalar true false v))
axiom valueIndent : ∀ root n, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  jsonNumber n →
  valueLine (bytes (" " ++ jsAssignment root [] (.scalar (.number n)))) = .reject

structure ValueRecords where
  items : List (Option Bytes)
  malformed : Option Bytes

axiom collectValues : List Bytes → ValueRecords
axiom collectValuesEnd : collectValues [] = ⟨[], none⟩
axiom collectValuesStep : ∀ line rest, collectValues (line :: rest) =
  if valuesLimit ≤ line.length then ⟨[], none⟩
  else
    let token := stripCR line
    match valueLine token with
    | .reject => ⟨[], some token⟩
    | .skip =>
      let later := collectValues rest
      ⟨none :: later.items, later.malformed⟩
    | .emit v =>
      let later := collectValues rest
      ⟨some v :: later.items, later.malformed⟩

def valueRecords (input : Bytes) : ValueRecords := collectValues (splitLines input)

def valueOut (records : ValueRecords) : Bytes :=
  (records.items.filterMap (fun x => x.map (fun bs => bs ++ [10]))).flatten

def valueError (line : Bytes) : Gen.T1.Gron.NonemptyOutput :=
  ⟨102, bytes "ailed to parse '" ++ line ++ bytes "' as gron statement\n"⟩

inductive ByteInput where
  | openError (path reason : String)
  | fetchError (message : String)
  | readError (reason : String)
  | one (data : Bytes)
  | stream (data : Bytes)
  | reverse (format : StatementFormat) (data : Bytes)
  | values (data : Bytes)

def acquiredFile (path : String) (fail : FsError) : ByteInput :=
  match fail with
  | .fsIsDirectory => .readError ("read " ++ path ++ ": is a directory")
  | .fsIoError => .readError ("read " ++ path ++ ": input/output error")
  | .fsInvalidPath => .openError path "no such file or directory"
  | _ => .openError path (describeFsError fail)

def byteInput (command : Command) (options : Options) (input : Bytes) : ByteInput :=
  match command with
  | .forwardLines => .stream input
  | .ungron => .reverse (if options.json then .json else .javascript) input
  | .values => .values input
  | _ => .one input

def defaults : DecodedInput := ⟨.error "EOF", [], .ok [], []⟩

def decodedPort : PortLift Acquired ByteInput :=
  ⟨fun i => match i with
    | .openError p r => .openError p r
    | .fetchError m => .fetchError m
    | .readError m => .readError m
    | .one input => .input { defaults with one := decodeJson input }
    | .stream input => .input { defaults with lines := streamRecords input }
    | .reverse format input =>
      let decoded := match reverseRecords format input with
        | .parsed records => .ok records
        | .reject m => .error m
        | .badIndex _ => .error "array index out of range"
      .input { defaults with assignments := decoded }
    | .values input =>
      .input { defaults with values := (valueRecords input).items.map (fun x => x.bind decodeUtf8) }⟩

def ordinary (inv : Invocation) (input : ByteInput) : Prop :=
  match Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv, input with
  | .ungron, .reverse format data =>
    match reverseRecords format data with
    | .badIndex _ => False
    | _ => True
  | .values, .values data =>
    let records := valueRecords data
    records.malformed = none ∧
      ∀ bs, some bs ∈ records.items → ∃ s : String, bytes s = bs ∧ decodeUtf8 bs = some s
  | _, _ => True

axiom executeBytes : Invocation → Environment → ByteInput → Completion
axiom executeVertical :
  Commutes₃ (keepPort Invocation) (keepPort Environment) decodedPort (keepPort Completion)
    (fun inv _ input => ordinary inv input) Eq Gen.T1.Gron.execute executeBytes

axiom executeValueBytes : ∀ inv env data, Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv = .values →
  executeBytes inv env (.values data) =
    let records := valueRecords data
    match records.malformed with
    | none => .extracted (valueOut records)
    | some line => .extractionError (valueOut records) (valueError line)

axiom executeIndexFault : ∀ inv env format data i, Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv = .ungron →
  reverseRecords format data = .badIndex i →
  let o := Gen.T1.Gron.observe (executeBytes inv env (.reverse format data))
  o.status = 2 ∧ o.stdout = [] ∧
    ∃ tail, o.stderr = bytes ("panic: runtime error: index out of range [" ++ toString i ++ "]\n") ++ tail

def httpTimeoutMs : Nat := 30000
def redirectLimit : Nat := 10

structure HttpOrigin where
  tls : Bool
  host : String
  port : Nat
  authority : String
  target : String
  url : String
  authorization : Option String

structure HttpAttempt where
  tls : Bool
  insecure : Bool
  host : String
  port : Nat
  serverName : String
  authority : String
  target : String
  url : String
  referer : Option String
  authorization : Option String
  proxyAuthorization : Option String
  tunnel : Bytes

def httpScheme (tls : Bool) : String := if tls then "https://" else "http://"

def hostText (host : String) : Prop :=
  host ≠ "" ∧ host.toList.all (fun c => c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || c == '.' || c == '-')) = true

def targetText (target : String) : Prop :=
  target.startsWith "/" = true ∧
  target.toList.all (fun c =>
    c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".contains c)) = true

axiom parseHttpOrigin : String → Except String HttpOrigin
axiom parseHttpOriginPort : ∀ tls host port target, hostText host → 0 < port → port ≤ 65535 →
  targetText target →
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
  parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩
axiom parseHttpOriginDefaultPort : ∀ tls host, hostText host →
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ host
  parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, if tls then 443 else 80, host, "/", url, none⟩

axiom resolveLocation : HttpOrigin → String → Except String HttpOrigin
axiom resolveLocationAbsolute : ∀ previous tls host port target, hostText host →
  0 < port → port ≤ 65535 → targetText target →
  (((target.splitOn "?").headD "").splitOn "/").all (fun s => s != "." && s != "..") = true →
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
  resolveLocation previous url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩

axiom prepareAttempt : Options → HttpOrigin → Option String → HttpAttempt
axiom prepareDirect : ∀ o origin referer, o.proxy = "" →
  prepareAttempt o origin referer =
    ⟨origin.tls, o.insecure, origin.host, origin.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      origin.target, origin.url, referer, origin.authorization, none, []⟩
axiom prepareProxy : ∀ o origin proxy referer, o.proxy ≠ "" →
  parseHttpOrigin o.proxy = .ok proxy → origin.tls = false → proxy.tls = false →
  proxy.authorization = none →
  prepareAttempt o origin referer =
    ⟨false, o.insecure, proxy.host, proxy.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      httpScheme false ++ origin.authority ++ origin.target, origin.url, referer,
      origin.authorization, none, []⟩

def header (name : String) : Option String → String
  | none => ""
  | some s => name ++ ": " ++ s ++ "\r\n"

axiom requestBytes : HttpAttempt → Bytes
axiom requestBytesRule : ∀ request, requestBytes request = bytes
  ("GET " ++ request.target ++ " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " ++ request.authority ++
    "\r\nUser-Agent: gron/dev\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n" ++
    header "Authorization" request.authorization ++
    header "Proxy-Authorization" request.proxyAuthorization ++ header "Referer" request.referer ++
    "Accept-Encoding: gzip\r\n\r\n")

def getError (url reason : String) : String := "Get " ++ quoteFlag url ++ ": " ++ reason

def socketAddress (request : HttpAttempt) : String :=
  (if request.host.contains ':' && !request.host.startsWith "[" then
    "[" ++ request.host ++ "]" else request.host) ++ ":" ++ toString request.port

axiom exchangeFailure : HttpAttempt → NetError → String
axiom connectionRefused : ∀ request, exchangeFailure request .netConnRefused =
  getError request.url ("dial tcp " ++ socketAddress request ++ ": connect: connection refused")
axiom clientTimeout : ∀ request, exchangeFailure request .netTimedOut =
  getError request.url "context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"

structure HttpBody where
  payload : Bytes
  readError : Option String

structure HttpResponse where
  status : Nat
  location : Option String
  body : HttpBody

def bodyAllowed (status : Nat) : Bool :=
  200 ≤ status && status != 204 && status != 304

def redirectStatus (status : Nat) : Bool := [301, 302, 303, 307, 308].contains status

def redirectTarget (response : HttpResponse) : Option String :=
  if redirectStatus response.status then response.location.filter (fun s => !s.isEmpty) else none

inductive HttpNext where
  | consume (body : HttpBody)
  | redirect (location : String)
  | failure (message : String)

def responseNext (requests : Nat) (response : HttpResponse) : HttpNext :=
  match redirectTarget response with
  | none => .consume response.body
  | some location =>
    if redirectLimit ≤ requests then .failure (getError location "stopped after 10 redirects")
    else .redirect location

def asciiReason (text : String) : Prop :=
  text.toList.all (fun c => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127) = true

axiom decodeResponse : Bytes → Except String HttpResponse
axiom decodePlainResponse : ∀ status reason payload, 200 ≤ status → status ≤ 999 →
  asciiReason reason →
  decodeResponse (encodeHttpResp status reason [] payload) =
    .ok ⟨status, none, ⟨if bodyAllowed status then payload else [], none⟩⟩
axiom decodeLocationResponse : ∀ status reason loc payload, redirectStatus status = true →
  asciiReason reason → asciiReason loc →
  decodeResponse (encodeHttpResp status reason [("Location", loc)] payload) =
    .ok ⟨status, some (String.ofList ((loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.dropWhile
      (fun c => c == ' ') |>.reverse)), ⟨if bodyAllowed status then payload else [], none⟩⟩

end Gen.T2.Gron

(submission (kind plan) (why "各子包独立定义输入和输出表示。根模块转换这些表示，并证明 T1 的派发与执行交换律") (main "import Gen.T1.Gron

import LojitaCtx.CharClass
import LojitaCtx.Cli
import LojitaCtx.HttpLaws
import LojitaCtx.ToolLaws

import Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder
import Gen.T2.Gron.Decode

namespace Gen.T2.Gron
open LojitaCtx.Blueprint LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open LojitaCtx.PosixChannel (evalScanner)
open LojitaCtx.NetSandbox (encodeHttpResp)
open Gen.T1.Gron (Options Invocation Command Flag BoolFlag TextFlag Source Style Environment
  Json Scalar Assignment Segment Path LineError Completion Observation Acquired DecodedInput)

structure Launch where
  name : String
  args : List String
def pathBase (name : String) : String :=
  ((name.splitOn "/").filter (fun s => !s.isEmpty)).getLastD ""
def applyProgramName (name : String) : Invocation → Invocation
  | .parsed o operands =>
    .parsed {o with reverse := o.reverse || pathBase name == "ungron"} operands
  | .help => .help
  | .rejected m => .rejected m
def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := Gen.T1.Gron.hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n
def quoteFlag (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map goEscape) ++ "\""
def parseFlags (o : Options) : List String → Invocation
  | [] => .parsed o []
  | arg :: rest =>
    match Gen.T1.Gron.flagPrefix arg with
    | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
    | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
    | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
    | .flag name attached =>
      match Gen.T1.Gron.flagNamed name with
      | none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
      | some .help => .help
      | some (.boolean flag) =>
        match attached with
        | none => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
        | some value =>
          match Gen.T1.Gron.boolArgument value with
          | some b => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
          | none =>
            .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ Diagnostic.quote value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
      | some (.text flag) =>
        match attached with
        | some value => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) rest
        | none =>
          match rest with
          | value :: tail => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) tail
          | [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name)
termination_by structural args => args
theorem parseFlagsEnd : ∀ o, parseFlags o [] = .parsed o [] := fun _ => rfl
theorem parseFlagsStep : ∀ o arg rest, parseFlags o (arg :: rest) =
  match Gen.T1.Gron.flagPrefix arg with
  | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
  | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
  | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
  | .flag name attached =>
    match Gen.T1.Gron.flagNamed name with
    | none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
    | some .help => .help
    | some (.boolean flag) =>
      match attached with
      | none => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
      | some value =>
        match Gen.T1.Gron.boolArgument value with
        | some b => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
        | none =>
          .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteFlag value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
    | some (.text flag) =>
      match attached, rest with
      | some value, _ => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) rest
      | none, value :: tail => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) tail
      | none, [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name) := by
  intro o arg rest
  rw [parseFlags]
  simp only [Diagnostic.quoteRule]
  split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rename_i name attached _
    split
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · cases attached <;> cases rest <;> rfl
def invocationPort : PortLift Invocation Launch :=
  ⟨fun p => applyProgramName p.name (parseFlags {} p.args)⟩
def dispatch (p : Launch) : Command := Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch (invocationPort.project p)
theorem dispatchVertical :
  Commutes₁ invocationPort (keepPort Command) (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch dispatch :=
  fun _ _ => rfl
structure Config where
  invocation : Invocation
  command : Command
  source : Option Source
  style : Style
def alphabet : Gen.T1.Gron.IdentifierAlphabet :=
  ⟨KeyOrder.starts, KeyOrder.continues⟩
theorem alphabetLetter : ∀ c, LojitaCtx.CharClass.alpha c = true → alphabet.starts c = true :=
  KeyOrder.startsLetter
theorem alphabetContinueLetter : ∀ c, alphabet.starts c = true → alphabet.continues c = true :=
  KeyOrder.continuesStart
def letterNumber (c : Char) : Bool :=
  ([(5870, 5872), (8544, 8578), (8581, 8584), (12295, 12295), (12321, 12329),
    (12344, 12346), (42726, 42735), (65856, 65908), (66369, 66369), (66378, 66378),
    (66513, 66517), (74752, 74862)] : List (Nat × Nat)).any
    (fun (low, high) => low ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat ≤ high)
theorem alphabetLetterNumber : ∀ c, letterNumber c = true → alphabet.starts c = true :=
  KeyOrder.startsLetterNumber
theorem alphabetNoJoinControls : ∀ c,
  8204 ≤ c.toNat → c.toNat ≤ 8205 → alphabet.continues c = false :=
  KeyOrder.excludesJoinControls
def styleOf (o : Options) (tty : Bool) (term noColor : Option String) : Style :=
  ⟨alphabet, !o.noSort, o.json, Gen.T1.Gron.colorize ⟨o.colorize, o.monochrome, tty, term, noColor⟩⟩
def configure (p : Launch) (tty : Bool) (term noColor : Option String) : Config :=
  let inv := invocationPort.project p
  let cmd := Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv
  match inv with
  | .parsed o operands =>
    ⟨inv, cmd, if o.version then none else some (Gen.T1.Gron.selectSource operands),
      styleOf o tty term noColor⟩
  | _ => ⟨inv, cmd, none, styleOf {} tty term noColor⟩
theorem configureRule : ∀ p tty term noColor, configure p tty term noColor =
  let inv := invocationPort.project p
  let cmd := dispatch p
  match inv with
  | .parsed o operands =>
    ⟨inv, cmd, if o.version then none else some (Gen.T1.Gron.selectSource operands),
      styleOf o tty term noColor⟩
  | _ => ⟨inv, cmd, none, styleOf {} tty term noColor⟩ := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16
def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n
inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :
      JsonStringPart [92, b] c
  | unicode (digits : Bytes) (c : Char) (h : jsonHexCode digits c.toNat) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))
def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)
structure JsonElement where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : Json
structure JsonMember where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes

inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : JsonSpelling depth (bytes "null") (.scalar .null)
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (.scalar (.boolean b))
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes n) (.scalar (.number n))
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      JsonSpelling depth wire (.scalar (.string s))
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List JsonElement) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, JsonSpelling depth item.spelling item.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map JsonElement.wire) ++ [93])
        (.array (items.map JsonElement.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List JsonMember) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, JsonSpelling depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map JsonMember.wire) ++ [125])
        (.object (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))

private def childElement (item : JsonElement) : Decode.JsonElement :=

private def childMember (item : JsonMember) : Decode.JsonMember :=
  ⟨item.leading, item.keySpelling, item.key, item.keyPadding, childElement item.element⟩
private theorem childStringPart {wire : Bytes} {c : Char} (h : JsonStringPart wire c) :
    Decode.JsonStringPart wire c := by
  cases h with
  | verbatim c ok => exact .verbatim c ok
  | simple b c ok => exact .simple b c ok
  | unicode digits c ok => exact .unicode digits c ok
  | surrogatePair high low h l hi lo => exact .surrogatePair high low h l hi lo
private theorem childString {wire : Bytes} {s : String} (h : jsonString wire s) :
    Decode.jsonString wire s := by
  obtain ⟨parts, good, wireEq, textEq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨parts, fun pair hp => childStringPart (good pair hp), wireEq, textEq⟩
private theorem childSpelling {depth : Nat} {wire : Bytes} {j : Json}
    (h : JsonSpelling depth wire j) : Decode.JsonSpelling depth wire (toDecodeJson j) := by
  induction h with
  | null d => exact .null d
  | boolean d b => exact .boolean d b
  | number d n valid => exact .number d n valid
  | string d wire s valid => exact .string d wire s (childString valid)
  | array d pad items spaces padding _ ih =>
    have childPadding : ∀ item ∈ items.map childElement,
        item.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all Decode.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inItems, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact padding original inItems
    have childValid : ∀ item ∈ items.map childElement,
        Decode.JsonSpelling d item.spelling item.value := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inItems, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact ih original inItems
    have wires : (items.map childElement).map Decode.JsonElement.wire = items.map JsonElement.wire := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have vals : (items.map childElement).map Decode.JsonElement.value =
        (items.map JsonElement.value).map toDecodeJson := by
      simp only [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have result := Decode.JsonSpelling.array d pad (items.map childElement) spaces childPadding childValid
    rw [wires, vals] at result
    rw [toDecodeArray]
    exact result
  | object d pad members spaces padding _ ih =>
    have childPadding : ∀ item ∈ members.map childMember,
        item.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧
        Decode.jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all Decode.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inMembers, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      obtain ⟨leading, keyPad, key, valuePad, trailing⟩ := padding original inMembers
      exact ⟨leading, keyPad, childString key, valuePad, trailing⟩
    have childValid : ∀ item ∈ members.map childMember,
        Decode.JsonSpelling d item.element.spelling item.element.value := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inMembers, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact ih original inMembers
    have wires : (members.map childMember).map Decode.JsonMember.wire = members.map JsonMember.wire := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have vals : ((members.map childMember).map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))) =
        (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))).map
          (fun p => (p.1, toDecodeJson p.2)) := by
      simp only [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have result := Decode.JsonSpelling.object d pad (members.map childMember) spaces childPadding childValid
    rw [wires, vals] at result
    rw [toDecodeObject]
    exact result

def jsonScanner : ByteScanner JsonScan (Except String Json) where

private def fromDecodeOutcome : ReadOutcome (Except String Decode.Json) → ReadOutcome (Except String Json)

private theorem jsonScannerMap (state : JsonScan) (input : Bytes) (closed waited : Bool) :
    LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.runScannerFrom jsonScanner state input closed waited =
      let r := LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.runScannerFrom Decode.jsonScanner state input closed waited
      (fromDecodeOutcome r.1, r.2) := by
  induction input generalizing state with
  | nil => cases closed <;> rfl
  | cons b rest ih =>
    simp only [LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.runScannerFrom]
    cases step : Decode.jsonScanner.onByte state b with
    | more next =>
      have same : jsonScanner.onByte state b = .more next := by simp [jsonScanner, step]
      simpa only [same, step] using ih next
    | done result =>
      have same : jsonScanner.onByte state b = .done (fromDecodeResult result) := by
        simp [jsonScanner, step]
      simp only [same, step, fromDecodeOutcome]

  intro depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound spaces valid container

    .record ⟨statementPath root p, material a⟩ := by
  intro root p a before after suffix identifier bounds valid pre post noNewline
  have h := Merge.reverseJSStatement mergeAlphabet root (toMergePath p) (toMergeAtom a)
    before after suffix ((mergeIdentifier root).trans identifier) (toMergeIndexBounds p _ bounds)
    (by simpa only [mergeValidAtom] using valid) pre post noNewline
  rw [mergeAssignmentSpacesRule] at h
  change fromMergeLine (Merge.reverseLine mergeAlphabet
    (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces root p a before after) ++ suffix)) = _
  rw [h]
  change ReverseLine.record ⟨(Merge.statementPath root (toMergePath p)).map fromMergeSegment,
    fromMergeJson (Merge.material (toMergeAtom a))⟩ = _
  rw [mergeStatementPathRule, fromMergeMaterial]
def exactJsonStatementAtom : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => s = "-0" ∨ ∃ i : Int,
      -9007199254740992 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 9007199254740992 ∧ s = toString i
  | _ => True
def jsonAssignment (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : Bytes :=
  let sep := String.intercalate "," (p.map (Gen.T1.Gron.jsonSegment false))
  bytes ("[[" ++ sep ++ "]," ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ "]")
private theorem decodeJsonSegment (segment : Segment) :
    Decode.jsonSegment (toDecodeSegment segment) = Gen.T1.Gron.jsonSegment false segment := by
  cases segment <;> rfl
private theorem decodeJsonAssignmentRule (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) :
    Decode.jsonAssignment (toDecodePath p) (toDecodeAtom a) = jsonAssignment p a := by
  simp only [Decode.jsonAssignment, jsonAssignment, toDecodePath, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    decodeJsonSegment, decodeAtomRule]
private theorem decodeExactAtom (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) :
    Decode.exactJsonStatementAtom (toDecodeAtom a) = exactJsonStatementAtom a := by
  cases a with
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl
  | array => rfl
  | object => rfl

theorem reverseJSONStatement : ∀ p a,
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9007199254740992) → exactJsonStatementAtom a →
  reverseLine .json (jsonAssignment p a) = .record ⟨p, material a⟩ := by
  intro p a bounds exactAtom
  have h := Decode.reverseJSONStatement (toDecodePath p) (toDecodeAtom a) (toDecodeIndexBounds p _ bounds)
    (by simpa only [decodeExactAtom] using exactAtom)
  rw [decodeJsonAssignmentRule] at h
  change fromDecodeLine (Decode.reverseLine (jsonAssignment p a)) = _
  rw [h]
  change ReverseLine.record ⟨(toDecodePath p).map fromDecodeSegment,
    fromDecodeJson (Decode.material (toDecodeAtom a))⟩ = _
  rw [fromDecodePathTo, fromDecodeMaterial]
inductive ReverseRecords where
  | parsed (assignments : List Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)
private def collectReverseFrom (format : StatementFormat) (lines : List Bytes) (acc : List Assignment) :
    ReverseRecords :=
  match lines with
  | [] => .parsed acc.reverse
  | line :: rest =>
    match reverseLine format (stripCR line) with
    | .skip => collectReverseFrom format rest acc
    | .record a => collectReverseFrom format rest (a :: acc)
    | .reject e => .reject e
    | .badIndex i => .badIndex i
termination_by structural lines
private theorem collectReversePrefix (format : StatementFormat) (lines : List Bytes)
    (acc : List Assignment) :
    collectReverseFrom format lines acc =
      match collectReverseFrom format lines [] with
      | .parsed xs => .parsed (acc.reverse ++ xs)
      | .reject e => .reject e
      | .badIndex i => .badIndex i := by
  induction lines generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [collectReverseFrom]
  | cons line rest ih =>
    cases h : reverseLine format (stripCR line) with
    | skip => simpa only [collectReverseFrom, h] using ih acc
    | record a =>
      simp only [collectReverseFrom, h]
      rw [ih (a :: acc), ih [a]]
      cases collectReverseFrom format rest [] <;> simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]
    | reject e => simp only [collectReverseFrom, h]
    | badIndex i => simp only [collectReverseFrom, h]
def collectReverse (format : StatementFormat) (lines : List Bytes) : ReverseRecords :=
  collectReverseFrom format lines []
theorem collectReverseEnd : ∀ format, collectReverse format [] = .parsed [] := fun _ => rfl
theorem collectReverseStep : ∀ format line rest,
  collectReverse format (line :: rest) =
  match reverseLine format (stripCR line) with
  | .skip => collectReverse format rest
  | .reject e => .reject e
  | .badIndex i => .badIndex i
  | .record a =>
    match collectReverse format rest with
    | .parsed xs => .parsed (a :: xs)
    | .reject e => .reject e
    | .badIndex i => .badIndex i := by
  intro format line rest
  unfold collectReverse
  rw [collectReverseFrom]
  cases reverseLine format (stripCR line) with
  | skip => rfl
  | record a =>
    simpa only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] using
      collectReversePrefix format rest [a]
  | reject e => rfl
  | badIndex i => rfl
def reverseRecords (format : StatementFormat) (input : Bytes) : ReverseRecords :=
  collectReverse format (splitLines input)
def valuesLimit : Nat := 65536
def ValueScan : Type := Values.ValueScan
def valuesScanner : ByteScanner ValueScan (Option (Except Unit Bytes)) := Values.valuesScanner
def valuesInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Option (Except Unit Bytes)) × InChan :=
  evalScanner valuesScanner ch
theorem valuesNewline : ∀ line tail closed waited,
  line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line ++ (10 :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) :=
  Values.valuesNewline
theorem valuesTooLong : ∀ headBytes tail closed waited,
  headBytes.contains 10 = false → headBytes.length = valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨headBytes ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (some (.error ())), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) :=
  Values.valuesTooLong
theorem valuesOpen : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩) :=
  Values.valuesOpen
theorem valuesEnd : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
  valuesInput ⟨line, true, waited⟩ =
    (.ended (if line.isEmpty then none else some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨[], true, waited⟩) :=
  Values.valuesEnd
inductive ValueLine where
  | skip
  | emit (value : Bytes)
  | reject
private def fromMergeValue : Merge.ValueLine → ValueLine
  | .skip => .skip
  | .emit v => .emit v
  | .reject => .reject
def valueLine (line : Bytes) : ValueLine := fromMergeValue (Merge.valueLine mergeAlphabet line)
theorem valueNoEquals : ∀ line, line.contains 61 = false → valueLine line = .skip :=
  fun line noEquals => congrArg fromMergeValue (Merge.valueNoEquals mergeAlphabet line noEquals)
theorem valueStatement : ∀ root p a, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808) →
  validAtom a →
  valueLine (bytes (jsAssignment root p a)) =
    match a with
    | .array | .object => .skip
    | .scalar (.string s) => .emit (bytes s)
    | .scalar v => .emit (bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.renderScalar true false v)) := by
  intro root p a identifier bounds valid
  have h := Merge.valueStatement mergeAlphabet root (toMergePath p) (toMergeAtom a)
    ((mergeIdentifier root).trans identifier) (toMergeIndexBounds p _ bounds)
    (by simpa only [mergeValidAtom] using valid)
  rw [mergeAssignmentRule] at h
  change fromMergeValue (Merge.valueLine mergeAlphabet (bytes (jsAssignment root p a))) = _
  rw [h]
  cases a with
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl
  | array => rfl
  | object => rfl
theorem valueIndent : ∀ root n, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  jsonNumber n →
  valueLine (bytes (" " ++ jsAssignment root [] (.scalar (.number n)))) = .reject := by
  intro root n identifier valid
  have h := Merge.valueIndent mergeAlphabet root n ((mergeIdentifier root).trans identifier) valid
  change Merge.valueLine mergeAlphabet (bytes (" " ++
    Merge.jsAssignment mergeAlphabet root (toMergePath []) (toMergeAtom (.scalar (.number n))))) = .reject at h
  rw [mergeAssignmentRule] at h
  exact congrArg fromMergeValue h
structure ValueRecords where
  items : List (Option Bytes)
  malformed : Option Bytes
private def collectValuesFrom (lines : List Bytes) (acc : List (Option Bytes)) : ValueRecords :=
  match lines with
  | [] => ⟨acc.reverse, none⟩
  | line :: rest =>
    if valuesLimit ≤ line.length then ⟨acc.reverse, none⟩
    else
      let token := stripCR line
      match valueLine token with
      | .reject => ⟨acc.reverse, some token⟩
      | .skip => collectValuesFrom rest (none :: acc)
      | .emit v => collectValuesFrom rest (some v :: acc)
termination_by structural lines
private theorem collectValuesPrefix (lines : List Bytes) (acc : List (Option Bytes)) :
    collectValuesFrom lines acc =
      let later := collectValuesFrom lines []
      ⟨acc.reverse ++ later.items, later.malformed⟩ := by
  induction lines generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [collectValuesFrom]
  | cons line rest ih =>
    simp only [collectValuesFrom]
    split
    · simp only [List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
    · split
      · simp only [List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
      · rw [ih (none :: acc), ih [none]]
        simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
      · rename_i v _
        rw [ih (some v :: acc), ih [some v]]
        simp only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
def collectValues (lines : List Bytes) : ValueRecords := collectValuesFrom lines []
theorem collectValuesEnd : collectValues [] = ⟨[], none⟩ := rfl
theorem collectValuesStep : ∀ line rest, collectValues (line :: rest) =
  if valuesLimit ≤ line.length then ⟨[], none⟩
  else
    let token := stripCR line
    match valueLine token with
    | .reject => ⟨[], some token⟩
    | .skip =>
      let later := collectValues rest
      ⟨none :: later.items, later.malformed⟩
    | .emit v =>
      let later := collectValues rest
      ⟨some v :: later.items, later.malformed⟩ := by
  intro line rest
  unfold collectValues
  rw [collectValuesFrom]
  split
  · rfl
  · dsimp only
    cases valueLine (stripCR line) with
    | skip =>
      simpa only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] using
        collectValuesPrefix rest [none]
    | emit v =>
      simpa only [List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] using
        collectValuesPrefix rest [some v]
    | reject => rfl
def valueRecords (input : Bytes) : ValueRecords := collectValues (splitLines input)
def valueOut (records : ValueRecords) : Bytes :=
  (records.items.filterMap (fun x => x.map (fun bs => bs ++ [10]))).flatten
def valueError (line : Bytes) : Gen.T1.Gron.NonemptyOutput :=
  ⟨102, bytes "ailed to parse '" ++ line ++ bytes "' as gron statement\n"⟩

inductive ByteInput where
  | openError (path reason : String)
  | fetchError (message : String)
  | readError (reason : String)
  | one (data : Bytes)
  | stream (data : Bytes)
  | reverse (format : StatementFormat) (data : Bytes)
  | values (data : Bytes)
def acquiredFile (path : String) (fail : FsError) : ByteInput :=
  match fail with
  | .fsIsDirectory => .readError ("read " ++ path ++ ": is a directory")
  | .fsIoError => .readError ("read " ++ path ++ ": input/output error")
  | .fsInvalidPath => .openError path "no such file or directory"
  | _ => .openError path (describeFsError fail)
def byteInput (command : Command) (options : Options) (input : Bytes) : ByteInput :=
  match command with
  | .forwardLines => .stream input
  | .ungron => .reverse (if options.json then .json else .javascript) input
  | .values => .values input
  | _ => .one input
def defaults : DecodedInput := ⟨.error "EOF", [], .ok [], []⟩
def decodedPort : PortLift Acquired ByteInput :=
  ⟨fun i => match i with
    | .openError p r => .openError p r
    | .fetchError m => .fetchError m
    | .readError m => .readError m
    | .one input => .input { defaults with one := decodeJson input }
    | .stream input => .input { defaults with lines := streamRecords input }
    | .reverse format input =>
      let decoded := match reverseRecords format input with
        | .parsed records => .ok records
        | .reject m => .error m
        | .badIndex _ => .error "array index out of range"
      .input { defaults with assignments := decoded }
    | .values input =>
      .input { defaults with values := (valueRecords input).items.map (fun x => x.bind decodeUtf8) }⟩
def ordinary (inv : Invocation) (input : ByteInput) : Prop :=
  match Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv, input with
  | .ungron, .reverse format data =>
    match reverseRecords format data with
    | .badIndex _ => False
    | _ => True
  | .values, .values data =>
    let records := valueRecords data
    records.malformed = none ∧
      ∀ bs, some bs ∈ records.items → ∃ s : String, bytes s = bs ∧ decodeUtf8 bs = some s
  | _, _ => True
private def indexFaultOutput (i : Int) : Gen.T1.Gron.NonemptyOutput :=
  ⟨112, bytes ("anic: runtime error: index out of range [" ++ toString i ++ "]\n")⟩
def executeBytes (inv : Invocation) (env : Environment) (input : ByteInput) : Completion :=
  match Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv, input with
  | .ungron, .reverse format data =>
    match reverseRecords format data with
    | .parsed records => Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (.input { defaults with assignments := .ok records })
    | .reject m => Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (.input { defaults with assignments := .error m })
    | .badIndex i => .reconstructionFault (indexFaultOutput i)
  | .values, .values data =>
    let records := valueRecords data
    match records.malformed with
    | none => .extracted (valueOut records)
    | some line => .extractionError (valueOut records) (valueError line)
  | _, _ => Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (decodedPort.project input)
private theorem valueEncoding (items : List (Option Bytes))
    (utf8 : ∀ bs, some bs ∈ items → ∃ s : String, bytes s = bs ∧ decodeUtf8 bs = some s) :
    (items.filterMap (fun x => x.map (fun bs => bs ++ [10]))).flatten =
      ((items.map (fun x => x.bind decodeUtf8)).filterMap (fun s => s.map (fun v => bytes (v ++ "\n")))).flatten := by
  induction items with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons item tail ih =>
    have tailUtf8 : ∀ bs, some bs ∈ tail → ∃ s : String, bytes s = bs ∧ decodeUtf8 bs = some s :=
      fun bs mem => utf8 bs (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ mem)
    cases item with
    | none => simpa [List.filterMap_cons, Option.bind, Option.map] using ih tailUtf8
    | some bs =>
      obtain ⟨s, wire, decoded⟩ := utf8 bs (List.mem_cons_self)
      subst bs
      have appendLine : bytes s ++ [10] = bytes (s ++ "\n") := rfl
      simp [List.filterMap_cons, Option.bind, Option.map, decoded, appendLine]
      simpa [Option.bind, Option.map] using ih tailUtf8
private theorem executeDecodedValues (inv : Invocation) (env : Environment)
    (v : List (Option String)) (mode : Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv = .values) :
    Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (.input { defaults with values := v }) = Gen.T1.Gron.values v := by
  cases inv with
  | help => cases mode
  | rejected _ => cases mode
  | parsed o args =>
    rw [Gen.T1.Gron.executeRule]
    simp [mode]
theorem executeVertical :
  Commutes₃ (keepPort Invocation) (keepPort Environment) decodedPort (keepPort Completion)
    (fun inv _ input => ordinary inv input) Eq Gen.T1.Gron.execute executeBytes := by
  intro inv env input good
  change executeBytes inv env input = Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (decodedPort.project input)
  cases mode : Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv <;> cases input <;> simp only [executeBytes, mode]
  · rename_i format data
    simp only [ordinary, mode] at good
    cases h : reverseRecords format data with
    | parsed records => simp only [decodedPort, PortLift.project, h]
    | reject message => simp only [decodedPort, PortLift.project, h]
    | badIndex i => exact False.elim (by simpa only [h] using good)
  · rename_i data
    obtain ⟨clean, utf8⟩ := show (valueRecords data).malformed = none ∧
        ∀ bs, some bs ∈ (valueRecords data).items → ∃ s : String, bytes s = bs ∧ decodeUtf8 bs = some s by
      simpa only [ordinary, mode] using good
    rw [clean]
    change Completion.extracted (valueOut (valueRecords data)) =
      Gen.T1.Gron.execute inv env (.input { defaults with
        values := (valueRecords data).items.map (fun x => x.bind decodeUtf8) })
    rw [executeDecodedValues inv env _ mode, Gen.T1.Gron.valuesRule]
    exact congrArg Completion.extracted (valueEncoding _ utf8)
theorem executeValueBytes : ∀ inv env data, Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv = .values →
  executeBytes inv env (.values data) =
    let records := valueRecords data
    match records.malformed with
    | none => .extracted (valueOut records)
    | some line => .extractionError (valueOut records) (valueError line) := by
  intro inv env data mode
  simp only [executeBytes, mode]
theorem executeIndexFault : ∀ inv env format data i, Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv = .ungron →
  reverseRecords format data = .badIndex i →
  let o := Gen.T1.Gron.observe (executeBytes inv env (.reverse format data))
  o.status = 2 ∧ o.stdout = [] ∧
    ∃ tail, o.stderr = bytes ("panic: runtime error: index out of range [" ++ toString i ++ "]\n") ++ tail := by
  intro inv env format data i mode fault
  simp only [executeBytes, mode, fault]
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, [], ?_⟩
  have sameText :
      "panic: runtime error: index out of range [" ++ toString i ++ "]\n" =
        "p" ++ ("anic: runtime error: index out of range [" ++ toString i ++ "]\n") :=
    calc
      _ = ("p" ++ "anic: runtime error: index out of range [") ++ toString i ++ "]\n" := rfl
      _ = _ := by simp only [String.append_assoc]
  rw [sameText, List.append_nil]
  rfl

def httpTimeoutMs : Nat := 30000
def redirectLimit : Nat := 10
structure HttpOrigin where
  tls : Bool
  host : String
  port : Nat
  authority : String
  target : String
  url : String
  authorization : Option String
structure HttpAttempt where
  tls : Bool
  insecure : Bool
  host : String
  port : Nat
  serverName : String
  authority : String
  target : String
  url : String
  referer : Option String
  authorization : Option String
  proxyAuthorization : Option String
  tunnel : Bytes
def httpScheme (tls : Bool) : String := if tls then "https://" else "http://"
def hostText (host : String) : Prop :=
  host ≠ "" ∧ host.toList.all (fun c => c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || c == '.' || c == '-')) = true
def targetText (target : String) : Prop :=
  target.startsWith "/" = true ∧
  target.toList.all (fun c =>
    c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".contains c)) = true
private def toHttpOrigin (o : HttpOrigin) : Http.HttpOrigin :=
  ⟨o.tls, o.host, o.port, o.authority, o.target, o.url, o.authorization⟩
private def fromHttpOrigin (o : Http.HttpOrigin) : HttpOrigin :=
  ⟨o.tls, o.host, o.port, o.authority, o.target, o.url, o.authorization⟩
def parseHttpOrigin (url : String) : Except String HttpOrigin :=
  (Http.parseHttpOrigin url).map fromHttpOrigin
theorem parseHttpOriginPort : ∀ tls host port target, hostText host → 0 < port → port ≤ 65535 →
  targetText target →
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
  parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩ :=
  fun tls host port target hostOK pos bound targetOK =>
    congrArg (fun r => r.map fromHttpOrigin)
      (Http.parseHttpOriginPort tls host port target hostOK pos bound targetOK)
theorem parseHttpOriginDefaultPort : ∀ tls host, hostText host →
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ host
  parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, if tls then 443 else 80, host, "/", url, none⟩ :=
  fun tls host hostOK =>
    congrArg (fun r => r.map fromHttpOrigin) (Http.parseHttpOriginDefaultPort tls host hostOK)
def resolveLocation (previous : HttpOrigin) (location : String) : Except String HttpOrigin :=
  (Http.resolveLocation (toHttpOrigin previous) location).map fromHttpOrigin
theorem resolveLocationAbsolute : ∀ previous tls host port target, hostText host →
  0 < port → port ≤ 65535 → targetText target →
  (((target.splitOn "?").headD "").splitOn "/").all (fun s => s != "." && s != "..") = true →
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
  resolveLocation previous url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩ :=
  fun previous tls host port target hostOK pos bound targetOK normalized =>
    congrArg (fun r => r.map fromHttpOrigin)
      (Http.resolveLocationAbsolute (toHttpOrigin previous) tls host port target hostOK pos bound
        targetOK normalized)
private def fromHttpAttempt (a : Http.HttpAttempt) : HttpAttempt :=
  ⟨a.tls, a.insecure, a.host, a.port, a.serverName, a.authority, a.target, a.url, a.referer,
    a.authorization, a.proxyAuthorization, a.tunnel⟩
private def toHttpOptions (o : Options) : Http.Options :=
  ⟨o.insecure, o.proxy, o.noProxy⟩
def prepareAttempt (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String) : HttpAttempt :=
  fromHttpAttempt (Http.prepareAttempt (toHttpOptions o) (toHttpOrigin origin) referer)
theorem prepareDirect : ∀ o origin referer, o.proxy = "" →
  prepareAttempt o origin referer =
    ⟨origin.tls, o.insecure, origin.host, origin.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      origin.target, origin.url, referer, origin.authorization, none, []⟩ :=
  fun o origin referer direct =>
    congrArg fromHttpAttempt (Http.prepareDirect (toHttpOptions o) (toHttpOrigin origin) referer direct)
theorem prepareProxy : ∀ o origin proxy referer, o.proxy ≠ "" →
  parseHttpOrigin o.proxy = .ok proxy → origin.tls = false → proxy.tls = false →
  proxy.authorization = none →
  prepareAttempt o origin referer =
    ⟨false, o.insecure, proxy.host, proxy.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      httpScheme false ++ origin.authority ++ origin.target, origin.url, referer,
      origin.authorization, none, []⟩ := by
  intro o origin proxy referer configured parsed plainOrigin plainProxy noAuth
  have childParsed : Http.parseHttpOrigin o.proxy = .ok (toHttpOrigin proxy) := by
    unfold parseHttpOrigin at parsed
    cases result : Http.parseHttpOrigin o.proxy with
    | error e =>
      rw [result] at parsed
      cases parsed
    | ok value =>
      rw [result] at parsed
      have same : fromHttpOrigin value = proxy := Except.ok.inj parsed
      subst proxy
      cases value
      rfl
  exact congrArg fromHttpAttempt (Http.prepareProxy (toHttpOptions o) (toHttpOrigin origin) (toHttpOrigin proxy) referer
    configured childParsed plainOrigin plainProxy noAuth)

def header (name : String) : Option String → String
  | none => ""
  | some s => name ++ ": " ++ s ++ "\r\n"
def requestBytes (request : HttpAttempt) : Bytes := bytes
  ("GET " ++ request.target ++ " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " ++ request.authority ++
    "\r\nUser-Agent: gron/dev\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n" ++
    header "Authorization" request.authorization ++
    header "Proxy-Authorization" request.proxyAuthorization ++ header "Referer" request.referer ++
    "Accept-Encoding: gzip\r\n\r\n")
theorem requestBytesRule : ∀ request, requestBytes request = bytes
  ("GET " ++ request.target ++ " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " ++ request.authority ++
    "\r\nUser-Agent: gron/dev\r\nAccept: application/json\r\n" ++
    header "Authorization" request.authorization ++
    header "Proxy-Authorization" request.proxyAuthorization ++ header "Referer" request.referer ++
    "Accept-Encoding: gzip\r\n\r\n") := fun _ => rfl
def getError (url reason : String) : String := "Get " ++ quoteFlag url ++ ": " ++ reason
def socketAddress (request : HttpAttempt) : String :=
  (if request.host.contains ':' && !request.host.startsWith "[" then
    "[" ++ request.host ++ "]" else request.host) ++ ":" ++ toString request.port
def exchangeFailure (request : HttpAttempt) (failure : NetError) : String :=
  getError request.url
    (match failure with
    | .netConnRefused => "dial tcp " ++ socketAddress request ++ ": connect: connection refused"
    | .netTimedOut => "context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"
    | other => describeNetError other)
theorem connectionRefused : ∀ request, exchangeFailure request .netConnRefused =

def hexDigit (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 10 then 48 + n else (if upper then 55 else 87) + n)
def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))
/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c
def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))
def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""
inductive Scalar where
  | null
  | boolean (value : Bool)

def renderScalar : Scalar → String
  | .null => "null"
  | .boolean b => if b then "true" else "false"
  | .number n => n
  | .string s => quote true s
def renderAtom : Atom → String
  | .scalar s => renderScalar s

  | .object => "{}"

  | .array _ => true

def isObject : Json → Bool

def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16
def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n
inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :
      JsonStringPart [92, b] c
  | unicode (digits : Bytes) (c : Char) (h : jsonHexCode digits c.toNat) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))
def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)
structure JsonElement where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : Json
structure JsonMember where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes

def JsonElement.wire (x : JsonElement) : Bytes := x.leading ++ x.spelling ++ x.trailing
def JsonMember.wire (x : JsonMember) : Bytes :=
  x.leading ++ x.keySpelling ++ x.keyPadding ++ [58] ++ x.element.wire
inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : JsonSpelling depth (bytes "null") (.scalar .null)
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (.scalar (.boolean b))
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes n) (.scalar (.number n))
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      JsonSpelling depth wire (.scalar (.string s))
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List JsonElement) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, JsonSpelling depth item.spelling item.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map JsonElement.wire) ++ [93])
        (.array (items.map JsonElement.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List JsonMember) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, JsonSpelling depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map JsonMember.wire) ++ [125])
        (.object (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))
def jsonContainer (j : Json) : Bool := isArray j || isObject j

def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=

private theorem charEqOfNatEq {c d : Char} (h : c.toNat = d.toNat) : c = d :=
  (Char.ofNat_toNat c).symm.trans ((congrArg Char.ofNat h).trans (Char.ofNat_toNat d))

private theorem charFromNat {n : Nat} (h : n.isValidChar) : (Char.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  unfold Char.ofNat
  rw [dif_pos h]
  unfold Char.ofNatAux Char.toNat
  rfl

private theorem charFromAscii {n : Nat} (h : n < 128) : (Char.ofNat n).toNat = n :=
  charFromNat (Or.inl (by omega))

private theorem charNatValid (c : Char) : c.toNat.isValidChar := c.valid

private theorem byteFromNat {n : Nat} (h : n < 256) : (UInt8.ofNat n).toNat = n :=

private theorem bytesAppend (s t : String) : bytes (s ++ t) = bytes s ++ bytes t := by
  change (s ++ t).toByteArray.data.toList = s.toByteArray.data.toList ++ t.toByteArray.data.toList
  rw [String.toByteArray_append, ByteArray.data_append, Array.toList_append]

private theorem toByteArrayBytes (bs : Bytes) : bs.toByteArray.data.toList = bs := by
  suffices aux : ∀ a : ByteArray, (List.toByteArray.loop bs a).data.toList = a.data.toList ++ bs from
    aux .empty
  induction bs with
  | nil =>
    intro a
    change a.data.toList = a.data.toList ++ []
    rw [List.append_nil]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    intro a
    change (List.toByteArray.loop bs (a.push b)).data.toList = _
    rw [ih]
    change (a.data.push b).toList ++ bs = a.data.toList ++ b :: bs
    simp [Array.toList_push, List.append_assoc]

private theorem bytesOfList (cs : List Char) : bytes (String.ofList cs) = cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar := by
  change (String.ofList cs).toByteArray.data.toList = _
  rw [String.toByteArray_ofList]
  exact toByteArrayBytes _

private theorem bytesSingleton (c : Char) : bytes (String.singleton c) = String.utf8EncodeChar c := by
  rw [show String.singleton c = String.ofList [c] from rfl, bytesOfList]

private def hexByte (n : Nat) : UInt8 :=

private theorem asciiEncoding (c : Char) (small : c.toNat < 128) :

  unfold String.utf8EncodeChar

private theorem hexDigitEncoding {n : Nat} (h : n < 16) :

    charFromAscii small
  rw [asciiEncoding _ (val ▸ small), val]
  rfl

    unfold jsonHexValue
    rw [val]
