structure Launch where
  name : String
  args : List String
def pathBase (name : String) : String :=
  ((name.splitOn "/").filter (fun s => !s.isEmpty)).getLastD ""
def applyProgramName (name : String) : Invocation → Invocation
  | .parsed o operands =>
    .parsed {o with reverse := o.reverse || pathBase name == "ungron"} operands
  | .help => .help
  | .rejected m => .rejected m
def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := Gen.T1.Gron.hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n
def quoteFlag (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map goEscape) ++ "\""
def parseFlags (o : Options) : List String → Invocation
  | [] => .parsed o []
  | arg :: rest =>
    match Gen.T1.Gron.flagPrefix arg with
    | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
    | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
    | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
    | .flag name attached =>
      match Gen.T1.Gron.flagNamed name with
      | none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
      | some .help => .help
      | some (.boolean flag) =>
        match attached with
        | none => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
        | some value =>
          match Gen.T1.Gron.boolArgument value with
          | some b => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
          | none =>
            .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ Diagnostic.quote value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
      | some (.text flag) =>
        match attached with
        | some value => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) rest
        | none =>
          match rest with
          | value :: tail => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) tail
          | [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name)
termination_by structural args => args
theorem parseFlagsEnd : ∀ o, parseFlags o [] = .parsed o [] := fun _ => rfl
theorem parseFlagsStep : ∀ o arg rest, parseFlags o (arg :: rest) =
  match Gen.T1.Gron.flagPrefix arg with
  | .operand => .parsed o (arg :: rest)
  | .delimiter => .parsed o rest
  | .invalid => .rejected ("bad flag syntax: " ++ arg)
  | .flag name attached =>
    match Gen.T1.Gron.flagNamed name with
    | none => .rejected ("flag provided but not defined: -" ++ name)
    | some .help => .help
    | some (.boolean flag) =>
      match attached with
      | none => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o true flag) rest
      | some value =>
        match Gen.T1.Gron.boolArgument value with
        | some b => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setBoolFlag o b flag) rest
        | none =>
          .rejected ("invalid boolean value " ++ quoteFlag value ++ " for -" ++ name ++ ": parse error")
    | some (.text flag) =>
      match attached, rest with
      | some value, _ => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) rest
      | none, value :: tail => parseFlags (Gen.T1.Gron.setTextFlag o value flag) tail
      | none, [] => .rejected ("flag needs an argument: -" ++ name) := by
  intro o arg rest
  rw [parseFlags]
  simp only [Diagnostic.quoteRule]
  split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rename_i name attached _
    split
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · cases attached <;> cases rest <;> rfl
def invocationPort : PortLift Invocation Launch :=
  ⟨fun p => applyProgramName p.name (parseFlags {} p.args)⟩
def dispatch (p : Launch) : Command := Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch (invocationPort.project p)
theorem dispatchVertical :
  Commutes₁ invocationPort (keepPort Command) (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch dispatch :=
  fun _ _ => rfl
structure Config where
  invocation : Invocation
  command : Command
  source : Option Source
  style : Style
def alphabet : Gen.T1.Gron.IdentifierAlphabet :=
  ⟨KeyOrder.starts, KeyOrder.continues⟩
theorem alphabetLetter : ∀ c, LojitaCtx.CharClass.alpha c = true → alphabet.starts c = true :=
  KeyOrder.startsLetter
theorem alphabetContinueLetter : ∀ c, alphabet.starts c = true → alphabet.continues c = true :=
  KeyOrder.continuesStart
def letterNumber (c : Char) : Bool :=
  ([(5870, 5872), (8544, 8578), (8581, 8584), (12295, 12295), (12321, 12329),
    (12344, 12346), (42726, 42735), (65856, 65908), (66369, 66369), (66378, 66378),
    (66513, 66517), (74752, 74862)] : List (Nat × Nat)).any
    (fun (low, high) => low ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat ≤ high)
theorem alphabetLetterNumber : ∀ c, letterNumber c = true → alphabet.starts c = true :=
  KeyOrder.startsLetterNumber
theorem alphabetNoJoinControls : ∀ c,
  8204 ≤ c.toNat → c.toNat ≤ 8205 → alphabet.continues c = false :=
  KeyOrder.excludesJoinControls
def styleOf (o : Options) (tty : Bool) (term noColor : Option String) : Style :=
  ⟨alphabet, !o.noSort, o.json, Gen.T1.Gron.colorize ⟨o.colorize, o.monochrome, tty, term, noColor⟩⟩
def configure (p : Launch) (tty : Bool) (term noColor : Option String) : Config :=
  let inv := invocationPort.project p
  let cmd := Gen.T1.Gron.dispatch inv
  match inv with
  | .parsed o operands =>
    ⟨inv, cmd, if o.version then none else some (Gen.T1.Gron.selectSource operands),
      styleOf o tty term noColor⟩
  | _ => ⟨inv, cmd, none, styleOf {} tty term noColor⟩
theorem configureRule : ∀ p tty term noColor, configure p tty term noColor =
  let inv := invocationPort.project p
  let cmd := dispatch p
  match inv with
  | .parsed o operands =>
    ⟨inv, cmd, if o.version then none else some (Gen.T1.Gron.selectSource operands),
      styleOf o tty term noColor⟩
  | _ => ⟨inv, cmd, none, styleOf {} tty term noColor⟩ := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16
def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n
inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :
      JsonStringPart [92, b] c
  | unicode (digits : Bytes) (c : Char) (h : jsonHexCode digits c.toNat) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))
def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)
structure JsonElement where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : Json
structure JsonMember where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes
  element : JsonElement
def JsonElement.wire (x : JsonElement) : Bytes := x.leading ++ x.spelling ++ x.trailing
def JsonMember.wire (x : JsonMember) : Bytes :=
  x.leading ++ x.keySpelling ++ x.keyPadding ++ [58] ++ x.element.wire
inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : JsonSpelling depth (bytes "null") (.scalar .null)
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (.scalar (.boolean b))
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes n) (.scalar (.number n))
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      JsonSpelling depth wire (.scalar (.string s))
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List JsonElement) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, JsonSpelling depth item.spelling item.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map JsonElement.wire) ++ [93])
        (.array (items.map JsonElement.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List JsonMember) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, JsonSpelling depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map JsonMember.wire) ++ [125])
        (.object (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))
def jsonContainer (j : Json) : Bool := Gen.T1.Gron.isArray j || Gen.T1.Gron.isObject j

private def childElement (item : JsonElement) : Decode.JsonElement :=
  ⟨item.leading, item.spelling, item.trailing, item.value⟩
private def childMember (item : JsonMember) : Decode.JsonMember :=
  ⟨item.leading, item.keySpelling, item.key, item.keyPadding, childElement item.element⟩
private theorem childStringPart {wire : Bytes} {c : Char} (h : JsonStringPart wire c) :
    Decode.JsonStringPart wire c := by
  cases h with
  | verbatim c ok => exact .verbatim c ok
  | simple b c ok => exact .simple b c ok
  | unicode digits c ok => exact .unicode digits c ok
  | surrogatePair high low h l hi lo => exact .surrogatePair high low h l hi lo
private theorem childString {wire : Bytes} {s : String} (h : jsonString wire s) :
    Decode.jsonString wire s := by
  obtain ⟨parts, good, wireEq, textEq⟩ := h
  exact ⟨parts, fun pair hp => childStringPart (good pair hp), wireEq, textEq⟩
private theorem childSpelling {depth : Nat} {wire : Bytes} {j : Json}
    (h : JsonSpelling depth wire j) : Decode.JsonSpelling depth wire j := by
  induction h with
  | null d => exact .null d
  | boolean d b => exact .boolean d b
  | number d n valid => exact .number d n valid
  | string d wire s valid => exact .string d wire s (childString valid)
  | array d pad items spaces padding _ ih =>
    have childPadding : ∀ item ∈ items.map childElement,
        item.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all Decode.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inItems, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact padding original inItems
    have childValid : ∀ item ∈ items.map childElement,
        Decode.JsonSpelling d item.spelling item.value := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inItems, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact ih original inItems
    have wires : (items.map childElement).map Decode.JsonElement.wire = items.map JsonElement.wire := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have vals : (items.map childElement).map Decode.JsonElement.value = items.map JsonElement.value := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have result := Decode.JsonSpelling.array d pad (items.map childElement) spaces childPadding childValid
    rw [wires, vals] at result
    exact result
  | object d pad members spaces padding _ ih =>
    have childPadding : ∀ item ∈ members.map childMember,
        item.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧
        Decode.jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all Decode.jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all Decode.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inMembers, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      obtain ⟨leading, keyPad, key, valuePad, trailing⟩ := padding original inMembers
      exact ⟨leading, keyPad, childString key, valuePad, trailing⟩
    have childValid : ∀ item ∈ members.map childMember,
        Decode.JsonSpelling d item.element.spelling item.element.value := by
      intro item mem
      obtain ⟨original, inMembers, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
      exact ih original inMembers
    have wires : (members.map childMember).map Decode.JsonMember.wire = members.map JsonMember.wire := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have vals : ((members.map childMember).map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))) =
        members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value)) := by
      rw [List.map_map]
      rfl
    have result := Decode.JsonSpelling.object d pad (members.map childMember) spaces childPadding childValid
    rw [wires, vals] at result
    exact result

def JsonScan : Type := Decode.JsonScan
def jsonScanner : ByteScanner JsonScan (Except String Json) := Decode.jsonScanner
def oneInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Except String Json) × InChan :=
  evalScanner jsonScanner ch
def decodeJson (bs : Bytes) : Except String Json :=
  ((oneInput (closedPipe bs)).1.value?).getD (.error "EOF")
theorem jsonEmpty : ∀ bs, bs.all jsonSpace = true → decodeJson bs = .error "EOF" :=
  Decode.jsonEmpty
theorem jsonLiteralTail : ∀ pad tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "null" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar .null) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "true" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean true)) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "false" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean false)) :=
  Decode.jsonLiteralTail
theorem jsonWellFormed : ∀ depth pad wire j, depth ≤ 10000 → pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  JsonSpelling depth wire j → decodeJson (pad ++ wire) = .ok j :=
  fun depth pad wire j bound spaces valid =>
    Decode.jsonWellFormed depth pad wire j bound spaces (childSpelling valid)
theorem jsonContainerReady : ∀ depth pad wire tail j closed waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = true →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = (.emit (.ok j), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) :=
  fun depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound spaces valid container =>
    Decode.jsonContainerReady depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound spaces (childSpelling valid) container
theorem jsonScalarWait : ∀ depth pad wire j waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = false →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩) :=
  fun depth pad wire j waited bound spaces valid scalar =>
    Decode.jsonScalarWait depth pad wire j waited bound spaces (childSpelling valid) scalar
theorem jsonUnpairedSurrogate : ∀ pad digits tail cp, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonHexCode digits cp → 55296 ≤ cp → cp ≤ 57343 →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34, 92, 117] ++ digits ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (String.singleton (Char.ofNat 65533)))) :=
  Decode.jsonUnpairedSurrogate
def jsonStarter (b : UInt8) : Bool :=
  [34, 45, 91, 102, 110, 116, 123].contains b || (48 ≤ b.toNat && b.toNat ≤ 57)
theorem jsonRawString : ∀ pad payload tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  (∀ b ∈ payload, 32 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b ≠ 34 ∧ b ≠ 92) →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34] ++ payload ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (decodeUtf8Lossy payload))) :=
  Decode.jsonRawString
def quoteByte (b : UInt8) : String :=
  if b == 39 then "'\\''" else if b == 34 then "'\"'"
  else "'" ++ goEscape (Char.ofNat b.toNat) ++ "'"
theorem jsonBadStart : ∀ pad b tail closed waited, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonSpace b = false → jsonStarter b = false → b.toNat < 128 →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ (b :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " looking for beginning of value")),
      ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) :=
  Decode.jsonBadStart

def stripCR (line : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  if line.getLast? == some 13 then line.dropLast else line
def splitLines (input : Bytes) : List Bytes :=
  if input.isEmpty then []
  else
    let parts := List.splitOn 10 input
    if input.getLast? == some 10 then parts.dropLast else parts
def lineInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Option Bytes) × InChan :=
  evalScanner LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner ch
def linePayload (line : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  stripCR (if line.getLast? == some 10 then line.dropLast else line)
def streamRecords (input : Bytes) : List (Except LineError Json) :=
  (splitLines input).map (fun line => (decodeJson (stripCR line)).mapError LineError.decode)
inductive StatementFormat where
  | javascript
  | json
deriving DecidableEq
def jsPath (root : String) (p : Path) : String :=
  root ++ String.intercalate "" (p.map (Gen.T1.Gron.jsSegment alphabet false))
def material (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : Json :=
  match a with
  | .scalar s => .scalar s
  | .array => .array []
  | .object => .object []
def validAtom : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => jsonNumber s
  | _ => True
def jsAssignment (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : String :=
  jsPath root p ++ " = " ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ ";"
def jsAssignmentWithSpaces (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom)
    (before after : String) : String :=
  jsPath root p ++ before ++ "=" ++ after ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ ";"
def statementPath (root : String) (p : Path) : Path :=
  if root == "json" then p else .key root :: p
inductive ReverseLine where
  | skip
  | record (assignment : Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)
private def fromMergeLine : Merge.ReverseLine → ReverseLine
  | .skip => .skip
  | .record a => .record a
  | .reject e => .reject e
  | .badIndex i => .badIndex i
private def fromDecodeLine : Decode.ReverseLine → ReverseLine
  | .skip => .skip
  | .record a => .record a
  | .reject e => .reject e
  | .badIndex i => .badIndex i
def reverseLine : StatementFormat → Bytes → ReverseLine
  | .javascript, line => fromMergeLine (Merge.reverseLine alphabet line)
  | .json, line => fromDecodeLine (Decode.reverseLine line)
theorem reverseJSBlank : ∀ line, line.all jsonSpace = true → reverseLine .javascript line = .skip :=
  fun line spaces => congrArg fromMergeLine (Merge.reverseJSBlank alphabet line spaces)
theorem reverseJSONBlank : ∀ line, line.all jsonSpace = true →
  reverseLine .json line = .reject "unexpected end of JSON input" :=
  fun line spaces => congrArg fromDecodeLine (Decode.reverseJSONBlank line spaces)
theorem reverseJSStatement : ∀ root p a before after suffix, Gen.T1.Gron.identifier alphabet root = true →
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808) →
  validAtom a → before.toList.all (· == ' ') = true → after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true →
  suffix.contains 10 = false →
  reverseLine .javascript (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces root p a before after) ++ suffix) =
    .record ⟨statementPath root p, material a⟩ :=
  fun root p a before after suffix identifier bounds valid pre post noNewline =>
    congrArg fromMergeLine
      (Merge.reverseJSStatement alphabet root p a before after suffix identifier bounds valid pre post noNewline)
def exactJsonStatementAtom : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => s = "-0" ∨ ∃ i : Int,
      -9007199254740992 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 9007199254740992 ∧ s = toString i
  | _ => True
def jsonAssignment (p : Path) (a : Gen.T1.Gron.Atom) : Bytes :=
  let sep := String.intercalate "," (p.map (Gen.T1.Gron.jsonSegment false))
  bytes ("[[" ++ sep ++ "]," ++ Gen.T1.Gron.renderAtom false a ++ "]")

  if redirectStatus response.status then response.location.filter (fun s => !s.isEmpty) else none

  match redirectTarget response with
  | none => .consume response.body

    if redirectLimit ≤ requests then .failure (getError location "stopped after 10 redirects")

def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := Gen.T1.Gron.hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ Gen.T1.Gron.hex4 false n

def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16
def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n
inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :

      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)

      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :

inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where

  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :

      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧

        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)

      JsonSpelling (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map JsonMember.wire) ++ [125])
        (.object (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))

axiom jsonScalarWait : ∀ depth pad wire j waited, depth ≤ 10000 →

def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := Gen.T1.Gron.hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"

inductive JsonSpelling : Nat → Bytes → Json → Prop where

  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (.scalar (.boolean b))
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      JsonSpelling depth (bytes n) (.scalar (.number n))
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :

def jsonContainer (j : Json) : Bool := isArray j || isObject j

private def builders : JsonInput.Builders Json where
  nullValue := .scalar .null
  booleanValue b := .scalar (.boolean b)
  numberValue n := .scalar (.number n)
  stringValue s := .scalar (.string s)
  arrayValue := Json.array
  objectValue := Json.object

def JsonScan : Type := JsonInput.ScanState Json
def jsonScanner : ByteScanner JsonScan (Except String Json) := JsonInput.scanner builders
def oneInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Except String Json) × InChan :=
  evalScanner jsonScanner ch
def decodeJson (bs : Bytes) : Except String Json :=
  ((oneInput (closedPipe bs)).1.value?).getD (.error "EOF")

  [34, 45, 91, 102, 110, 116, 123].contains b || (48 ≤ b.toNat && b.toNat ≤ 57)
def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ hex4 false n

  else "'" ++ goEscape (Char.ofNat b.toNat) ++ "'"

private theorem inputStringPart {wire : Bytes} {c : Char} (h : JsonStringPart wire c) :
    JsonInput.JsonStringPart wire c := by
  cases h with
  | verbatim c h => exact .verbatim c h
  | simple b c h => exact .simple b c h
  | unicode digits c h => exact .unicode digits c h
  | surrogatePair high low h l hi lo => exact .surrogatePair high low h l hi lo

private theorem inputString {wire : Bytes} {s : String} (h : jsonString wire s) :
    JsonInput.jsonString wire s := by
  obtain ⟨parts, hparts, hwire, htext⟩ := h
  exact ⟨parts, fun x hx => inputStringPart (hparts x hx), hwire, htext⟩

private def inputElement (x : JsonElement) : JsonInput.Element Json :=
  ⟨x.leading, x.spelling, x.trailing, x.value, jsonContainer x.value⟩

private def inputMember (x : JsonMember) : JsonInput.Member Json :=
  ⟨x.leading, x.keySpelling, x.key, x.keyPadding, inputElement x.element⟩

private theorem inputSpelling {depth : Nat} {wire : Bytes} {j : Json}
    (h : JsonSpelling depth wire j) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer j) depth wire j := by
  induction h with
  | null depth => exact .null depth
  | boolean depth b => exact .boolean depth b
  | number depth n valid => exact .number depth n valid
  | string depth wire s valid => exact .string depth wire s (inputString valid)
  | array depth pad items spaces padding valid ih =>
    have hPadding : ∀ x ∈ items.map inputElement,
        x.leading.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true ∧ x.trailing.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨item, hitem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact padding item hitem
    have hValues : ∀ x ∈ items.map inputElement,
        JsonInput.Spelling builders x.container depth x.spelling x.value := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨item, hitem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact ih item hitem
    have spelled := JsonInput.Spelling.array (make := builders) depth pad
      (items.map inputElement) spaces hPadding hValues
    simp only [List.map_map] at spelled
    exact spelled
  | object depth pad members spaces padding valid ih =>
    have hPadding : ∀ x ∈ members.map inputMember,
        x.leading.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true ∧ x.keyPadding.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true ∧
        JsonInput.jsonString x.keySpelling x.key ∧ x.element.leading.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true ∧
        x.element.trailing.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨item, hitem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      obtain ⟨lead, keyPad, key, valLead, valTrail⟩ := padding item hitem
      exact ⟨lead, keyPad, inputString key, valLead, valTrail⟩
    have hValues : ∀ x ∈ members.map inputMember,
        JsonInput.Spelling builders x.element.container depth x.element.spelling x.element.value := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨item, hitem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
      exact ih item hitem
    have spelled := JsonInput.Spelling.object (make := builders) depth pad
      (members.map inputMember) spaces hPadding hValues
    simp only [List.map_map] at spelled
    exact spelled

theorem jsonEmpty : ∀ bs, bs.all jsonSpace = true → decodeJson bs = .error "EOF" :=
  JsonInput.empty builders

theorem jsonLiteralTail : ∀ pad tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "null" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar .null) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "true" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean true)) ∧
  decodeJson (pad ++ bytes "false" ++ tail) = .ok (.scalar (.boolean false)) :=
  JsonInput.literalTail builders

theorem jsonWellFormed : ∀ depth pad wire j, depth ≤ 10000 → pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  JsonSpelling depth wire j → decodeJson (pad ++ wire) = .ok j := by
  intro depth pad wire j bound spaces spelling
  exact JsonInput.wellFormed builders _ depth pad wire j bound spaces (inputSpelling spelling)

theorem jsonContainerReady : ∀ depth pad wire tail j closed waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = true →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = (.emit (.ok j), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) := by
  intro depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound spaces spelling shape
  have input := inputSpelling spelling
  rw [shape] at input
  exact JsonInput.containerReady builders depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound spaces input

theorem jsonScalarWait : ∀ depth pad wire j waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → JsonSpelling depth wire j → jsonContainer j = false →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ wire, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩) := by
  intro depth pad wire j waited bound spaces spelling shape
  have input := inputSpelling spelling
  rw [shape] at input
  exact JsonInput.scalarWait builders depth pad wire j waited bound spaces input

theorem jsonUnpairedSurrogate : ∀ pad digits tail cp, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonHexCode digits cp → 55296 ≤ cp → cp ≤ 57343 →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34, 92, 117] ++ digits ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (String.singleton (Char.ofNat 65533)))) :=
  JsonInput.unpairedSurrogate builders

theorem jsonRawString : ∀ pad payload tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  (∀ b ∈ payload, 32 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b ≠ 34 ∧ b ≠ 92) →
  decodeJson (pad ++ [34] ++ payload ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (.scalar (.string (decodeUtf8Lossy payload))) :=
  JsonInput.rawString builders

theorem jsonBadStart : ∀ pad b tail closed waited, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonSpace b = false → jsonStarter b = false → b.toNat < 128 →
  oneInput ⟨pad ++ (b :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " looking for beginning of value")),
      ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) :=
  JsonInput.badStart builders

def material (a : Atom) : Json :=
  match a with
  | .scalar s => .scalar s
  | .array => .array []
  | .object => .object []
inductive ReverseLine where
  | skip
  | record (assignment : Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)
def exactJsonStatementAtom : Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => s = "-0" ∨ ∃ i : Int,
      -9007199254740992 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ 9007199254740992 ∧ s = toString i
  | _ => True
def jsonAssignment (p : Path) (a : Atom) : Bytes :=
  let sep := String.intercalate "," (p.map (jsonSegment))
  bytes ("[[" ++ sep ++ "]," ++ renderAtom a ++ "]")

private def recordView : Json → JsonRecords.View Json
  | .array items => .array items
  | .scalar (.string s) => .string s
  | .scalar (.number n) => .number n
  | _ => .other

private def toPart : Segment → JsonRecords.Part
  | .key s => .key s
  | .index n => .index n

private def ofPart : JsonRecords.Part → Segment
  | .key s => .key s
  | .index n => .index n

private def ofRecord : JsonRecords.Result Json → ReverseLine
  | .skip => .skip
  | .record p j => .record ⟨p.map ofPart, j⟩
  | .reject message => .reject message
  | .badIndex index => .badIndex index

def reverseLine (line : Bytes) : ReverseLine :=
  let scanned := oneInput (closedPipe line)
  let value := scanned.1.value?.getD (.error "EOF")
  ofRecord (JsonRecords.interpret recordView value scanned.2.pending)

theorem reverseJSONBlank : ∀ line, line.all jsonSpace = true →
  reverseLine line = .reject "unexpected end of JSON input" := by
  intro line spaces
  change ofRecord (JsonRecords.interpret recordView (decodeJson line)
    (oneInput (closedPipe line)).2.pending) = _
  rw [jsonEmpty line spaces, JsonRecords.blank]
  rfl

private theorem bytesAppend (s t : String) :
    bytes (s ++ t) = bytes s ++ bytes t := by
  change (s ++ t).toByteArray.data.toList = s.toByteArray.data.toList ++ t.toByteArray.data.toList
  simp [String.toByteArray_append, ByteArray.data_append]
private theorem bytesComma (ss : List String) :
    bytes (String.intercalate "," ss) = List.intercalate [44] (ss.map bytes) := by
  induction ss with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s ss ih =>
    cases ss with
    | nil => simp
    | cons t ts =>
      simp only [String.intercalate_cons_cons, List.map_cons, List.intercalate_cons_cons, bytesAppend] at *
      rw [← ih]
      rfl

private def segmentValue : Segment → Json
  | .key k => .scalar (.string k)
  | .index n => .scalar (.number (toString n))

private theorem segmentSpelling (s : Segment) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer (segmentValue s)) 0
      (bytes (jsonSegment s)) (segmentValue s) := by
  cases s with
  | key k => exact .string 0 _ k (JsonInput.quoteSpelling k)
  | index n => exact .number 0 _ (JsonInput.natSpelling n)

private theorem negativeZeroSpelling : JsonInput.jsonNumber "-0" :=
  ⟨['-'], ['0'], [], [], rfl, Or.inr rfl, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩

private theorem atomSpelling (a : Atom) (h : exactJsonStatementAtom a) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer (material a)) 1 (bytes (renderAtom a)) (material a) := by
  cases a with
  | array => exact .array 0 [] [] rfl (by simp) (by simp)
  | object => exact .object 0 [] [] rfl (by simp) (by simp)
  | scalar s =>
    cases s with
    | null => exact .null 1
    | boolean b => exact .boolean 1 b
    | string s => exact .string 1 _ s (JsonInput.quoteSpelling s)
    | number n =>
      apply JsonInput.Spelling.number
      rcases h with hn | ⟨i, _, _, hn⟩
      · rw [hn]
        exact negativeZeroSpelling
      · rw [hn]
        exact JsonInput.intSpelling i

private def compactElement (x : String × Json) : JsonInput.Element Json :=
  ⟨[], bytes x.1, [], x.2, jsonContainer x.2⟩

private theorem compactArray (depth : Nat) (items : List (String × Json))
    (h : ∀ x ∈ items, JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer x.2) depth (bytes x.1) x.2) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders true (depth + 1)
      (bytes ("[" ++ String.intercalate "," (items.map Prod.fst) ++ "]")) (.array (items.map Prod.snd)) := by
  have padding : ∀ x ∈ items.map compactElement,
      x.leading.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true ∧ x.trailing.all JsonInput.jsonSpace = true := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨item, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have children : ∀ x ∈ items.map compactElement,
      JsonInput.Spelling builders x.container depth x.spelling x.value := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨item, hitem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact h item hitem
  have spelled := JsonInput.Spelling.array (make := builders) depth []
    (items.map compactElement) rfl padding children
  simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    compactElement, JsonInput.Element.wire] at spelled
  simp only [bytesAppend, bytesComma, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
  exact spelled

private def pathText (p : Path) : String :=
  "[" ++ String.intercalate "," (p.map jsonSegment) ++ "]"

private theorem pathSpelling (p : Path) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders true 1 (bytes (pathText p)) (.array (p.map segmentValue)) := by
  let items := p.map (fun s => (jsonSegment s, segmentValue s))
  have children : ∀ x ∈ items,
      JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer x.2) 0 (bytes x.1) x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨s, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact segmentSpelling s
  simpa only [items, pathText, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using compactArray 0 items children

private theorem assignmentWire (p : Path) (a : Atom) :
    bytes ("[" ++ String.intercalate "," [pathText p, renderAtom a] ++ "]") = jsonAssignment p a := by
  simp only [String.intercalate_cons_cons, String.intercalate_singleton, pathText, jsonAssignment, bytesAppend]
  change [91] ++ ([91] ++ bytes (String.intercalate "," (p.map jsonSegment)) ++ [93]) ++
      [44] ++ bytes (renderAtom a) ++ [93] =
    [91, 91] ++ bytes (String.intercalate "," (p.map jsonSegment)) ++ [93, 44] ++ bytes (renderAtom a) ++ [93]
  simp [List.append_assoc]

private theorem assignmentSpelling (p : Path) (a : Atom) (h : exactJsonStatementAtom a) :
    JsonInput.Spelling builders true 2 (jsonAssignment p a) (.array [.array (p.map segmentValue), material a]) := by
  let items := [(pathText p, Json.array (p.map segmentValue)), (renderAtom a, material a)]
  have children : ∀ x ∈ items,
      JsonInput.Spelling builders (jsonContainer x.2) 1 (bytes x.1) x.2 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with eq | right
    · subst x
      exact pathSpelling p
    · have eq := List.mem_singleton.mp right
      subst x
      exact atomSpelling a h
  have spelled := compactArray 1 items children
  change JsonInput.Spelling builders true 2
    (bytes ("[" ++ String.intercalate "," [pathText p, renderAtom a] ++ "]"))
    (.array [.array (p.map segmentValue), material a]) at spelled
  rwa [assignmentWire] at spelled

private theorem pathViews (p : Path) :
    (p.map segmentValue).map recordView = (p.map toPart).map JsonRecords.partView := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s p ih =>
    cases s <;> simp only [List.map_cons, segmentValue, recordView, toPart, JsonRecords.partView, ih]

private theorem pathRoundTrip (p : Path) : (p.map toPart).map ofPart = p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s p ih => cases s <;> simp only [List.map_cons, toPart, ofPart, ih]

private theorem indexBounds (p : Path)
    (limit : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9007199254740992) :
    ∀ i, JsonRecords.Part.index i ∈ p.map toPart → i < 9007199254740992 := by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨s, hs, eq⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hi
  cases s with
  | key k => cases eq
  | index j =>
    have equal : j = i := JsonRecords.Part.index.inj eq
    exact equal ▸ limit j hs

theorem reverseJSONStatement : ∀ p a,
  (∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9007199254740992) → exactJsonStatementAtom a →
  reverseLine (jsonAssignment p a) = .record ⟨p, material a⟩ := by
  intro p a bounded exactAtom
  let path := Json.array (p.map segmentValue)
  let value := material a
  let root := Json.array [path, value]
  have read : oneInput (closedPipe (jsonAssignment p a)) = (.emit (.ok root), closedPipe []) := by
    have ready := JsonInput.containerReady builders 2 [] (jsonAssignment p a) [] root true false
      (by decide) rfl (assignmentSpelling p a exactAtom)
    simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil] at ready
    exact ready
  rw [reverseLine, read]
  change ofRecord (JsonRecords.interpret recordView (.ok root) []) = _
  rw [JsonRecords.canonical recordView root path value (p.map segmentValue) (p.map toPart) []
    rfl rfl rfl (pathViews p) (indexBounds p bounded)]
  exact congrArg (fun q => ReverseLine.record ⟨q, value⟩) (pathRoundTrip p)

end Gen.T2.Gron.Decode

  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))
def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)
def jsonStarter (b : UInt8) : Bool :=
  [34, 45, 91, 102, 110, 116, 123].contains b || (48 ≤ b.toNat && b.toNat ≤ 57)
def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ hex4 false n
def quoteByte (b : UInt8) : String :=
  if b == 39 then "'\\''" else if b == 34 then "'\"'"
  else "'" ++ goEscape (Char.ofNat b.toNat) ++ "'"
structure Builders (J : Type) where
  nullValue : J
  booleanValue : Bool → J
  numberValue : String → J
  stringValue : String → J
  arrayValue : List J → J
  objectValue : List (String × J) → J
structure Element (J : Type) where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : J
  container : Bool
structure Member (J : Type) where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes
  element : Element J
def Element.wire {J : Type} (x : Element J) : Bytes := x.leading ++ x.spelling ++ x.trailing
def Member.wire {J : Type} (x : Member J) : Bytes :=
  x.leading ++ x.keySpelling ++ x.keyPadding ++ [58] ++ x.element.wire
inductive Spelling {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : Bool → Nat → Bytes → J → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : Spelling make false depth (bytes "null") make.nullValue
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      Spelling make false depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (make.booleanValue b)
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      Spelling make false depth (bytes n) (make.numberValue n)
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      Spelling make false depth wire (make.stringValue s)
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List (Element J)) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, Spelling make item.container depth item.spelling item.value) :
      Spelling make true (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map Element.wire) ++ [93])
        (make.arrayValue (items.map Element.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List (Member J)) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, Spelling make item.element.container depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      Spelling make true (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map Member.wire) ++ [125])
        (make.objectValue (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))
axiom ScanState : Type → Type
axiom scanner {J : Type} : Builders J → ByteScanner (ScanState J) (Except String J)
def read {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Except String J) × InChan :=
  evalScanner (scanner make) ch
def decode {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (bs : Bytes) : Except String J :=
  ((read make (closedPipe bs)).1.value?).getD (.error "EOF")
axiom empty {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ bs, bs.all jsonSpace = true → decode make bs = .error "EOF"
axiom literalTail {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ pad tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  decode make (pad ++ bytes "null" ++ tail) = .ok make.nullValue ∧
  decode make (pad ++ bytes "true" ++ tail) = .ok (make.booleanValue true) ∧
  decode make (pad ++ bytes "false" ++ tail) = .ok (make.booleanValue false)
axiom wellFormed {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ container depth pad wire j,
  depth ≤ 10000 → pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  Spelling make container depth wire j → decode make (pad ++ wire) = .ok j
axiom containerReady {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ depth pad wire tail j closed waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → Spelling make true depth wire j →
  read make ⟨pad ++ wire ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = (.emit (.ok j), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
axiom scalarWait {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ depth pad wire j waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
  pad.all jsonSpace = true → Spelling make false depth wire j →
  read make ⟨pad ++ wire, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩)
axiom unpairedSurrogate {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ pad digits tail cp, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonHexCode digits cp → 55296 ≤ cp → cp ≤ 57343 →
  decode make (pad ++ [34, 92, 117] ++ digits ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (make.stringValue (String.singleton (Char.ofNat 65533)))
axiom rawString {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ pad payload tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  (∀ b ∈ payload, 32 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b ≠ 34 ∧ b ≠ 92) →
  decode make (pad ++ [34] ++ payload ++ [34] ++ tail) =
    .ok (make.stringValue (decodeUtf8Lossy payload))
axiom badStart {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ pad b tail closed waited, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
  jsonSpace b = false → jsonStarter b = false → b.toNat < 128 →
  read make ⟨pad ++ (b :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " looking for beginning of value")),
      ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
axiom quoteSpelling : ∀ s, jsonString (bytes (quote true s)) s
axiom natSpelling : ∀ n : Nat, jsonNumber (toString n)
axiom intSpelling : ∀ i : Int, jsonNumber (toString i)
end Gen.T2.Gron.Decode.JsonInput
import LojitaCtx.Terminal
namespace Gen.T2.Gron.Decode.JsonRecords
open LojitaCtx.Terminal
inductive Part where
  | key (name : String)
  | index (position : Nat)
inductive View (J : Type) where
  | array (items : List J)
  | string (text : String)
  | number (lexeme : String)
  | other
inductive Result (J : Type) where
  | skip
  | record (path : List Part) (value : J)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)
def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def partView {J : Type} : Part → View J
  | .key name => .string name
  | .index i => .number (toString i)
axiom interpret {J : Type} : (J → View J) → Except String J → Bytes → Result J
axiom blank {J : Type} : ∀ (view : J → View J) rest,
  interpret view (.error "EOF") rest = .reject "unexpected end of JSON input"
axiom canonical {J : Type} : ∀ (view : J → View J) (root path value : J)
    (items : List J) (p : List Part) (rest : Bytes),
  rest.all jsonSpace = true →
  view root = .array [path, value] →
  view path = .array items →
  items.map view = p.map partView →
  (∀ i, Part.index i ∈ p → i < 9007199254740992) →
  interpret view (.ok root) rest = .record p value
end Gen.T2.Gron.Decode.JsonRecords

open LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open LojitaCtx.PosixChannel (evalScanner runScannerFrom evalScanner_prefix_causal)
def hexDigit (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 10 then 48 + n else (if upper then 55 else 87) + n)
def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))
/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c
def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))
def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""
def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def jsonHexValue (b : UInt8) : Nat :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n && n ≤ 57 then n - 48
  else if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 70 then n - 55
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then n - 87
  else 16
def jsonHexCode (digits : Bytes) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  digits.length = 4 ∧ (∀ b ∈ digits, jsonHexValue b < 16) ∧
  digits.foldl (fun x b => x * 16 + jsonHexValue b) 0 = n
inductive JsonStringPart : Bytes → Char → Prop where
  | verbatim (c : Char) (h : 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c ≠ '"' ∧ c ≠ '\\') :
      JsonStringPart (bytes (String.singleton c)) c
  | simple (b : UInt8) (c : Char)
      (h : (b, c) ∈ ([(34, '"'), (47, '/'), (92, '\\'), (98, Char.ofNat 8), (102, Char.ofNat 12),
        (110, '\n'), (114, '\r'), (116, '\t')] : List (UInt8 × Char))) :
      JsonStringPart [92, b] c
  | unicode (digits : Bytes) (c : Char) (h : jsonHexCode digits c.toNat) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ digits) c
  | surrogatePair (high low : Bytes) (h l : Nat)
      (hi : jsonHexCode high h ∧ 55296 ≤ h ∧ h ≤ 56319)
      (lo : jsonHexCode low l ∧ 56320 ≤ l ∧ l ≤ 57343) :
      JsonStringPart ([92, 117] ++ high ++ [92, 117] ++ low)
        (Char.ofNat (65536 + (h - 55296) * 1024 + (l - 56320)))
def jsonString (wire : Bytes) (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ parts : List (Bytes × Char),
    (∀ pair ∈ parts, JsonStringPart pair.1 pair.2) ∧
    wire = [34] ++ (parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34] ∧
    s = String.ofList (parts.map Prod.snd)
def jsonStarter (b : UInt8) : Bool :=
  [34, 45, 91, 102, 110, 116, 123].contains b || (48 ≤ b.toNat && b.toNat ≤ 57)
def goEscape (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    let hex := hexDigit false
    if n == 7 then "\\a"
    else if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 11 then "\\v"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if c == ' ' || (LojitaCtx.CharClass.printable c && !LojitaCtx.CharClass.space c) then
      String.singleton c
    else if n < 128 then "\\x" ++ String.ofList [hex (n / 16), hex (n % 16)]
    else if n < 65536 then "\\u" ++ hex4 false n
    else "\\U" ++ hex4 false (n / 65536) ++ hex4 false n
def quoteByte (b : UInt8) : String :=
  if b == 39 then "'\\''" else if b == 34 then "'\"'"
  else "'" ++ goEscape (Char.ofNat b.toNat) ++ "'"
structure Builders (J : Type) where
  nullValue : J
  booleanValue : Bool → J
  numberValue : String → J
  stringValue : String → J
  arrayValue : List J → J
  objectValue : List (String × J) → J
structure Element (J : Type) where
  leading : Bytes
  spelling : Bytes
  trailing : Bytes
  value : J
  container : Bool
structure Member (J : Type) where
  leading : Bytes
  keySpelling : Bytes
  key : String
  keyPadding : Bytes
  element : Element J
def Element.wire {J : Type} (x : Element J) : Bytes := x.leading ++ x.spelling ++ x.trailing
def Member.wire {J : Type} (x : Member J) : Bytes :=
  x.leading ++ x.keySpelling ++ x.keyPadding ++ [58] ++ x.element.wire
inductive Spelling {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : Bool → Nat → Bytes → J → Prop where
  | null (depth : Nat) : Spelling make false depth (bytes "null") make.nullValue
  | boolean (depth : Nat) (b : Bool) :
      Spelling make false depth (bytes (if b then "true" else "false")) (make.booleanValue b)
  | number (depth : Nat) (n : String) (valid : jsonNumber n) :
      Spelling make false depth (bytes n) (make.numberValue n)
  | string (depth : Nat) (wire : Bytes) (s : String) (valid : jsonString wire s) :
      Spelling make false depth wire (make.stringValue s)
  | array (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (items : List (Element J)) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ items, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ items, Spelling make item.container depth item.spelling item.value) :
      Spelling make true (depth + 1) ([91] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (items.map Element.wire) ++ [93])
        (make.arrayValue (items.map Element.value))
  | object (depth : Nat) (pad : Bytes) (members : List (Member J)) (spaces : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
      (padding : ∀ item ∈ members, item.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧ item.keyPadding.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        jsonString item.keySpelling item.key ∧ item.element.leading.all jsonSpace = true ∧
        item.element.trailing.all jsonSpace = true)
      (valid : ∀ item ∈ members, Spelling make item.element.container depth item.element.spelling item.element.value) :
      Spelling make true (depth + 1) ([123] ++ pad ++ List.intercalate [44] (members.map Member.wire) ++ [125])
        (make.objectValue (members.map (fun item => (item.key, item.element.value))))

private def valueBuilders {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : Value.Builders J :=
  ⟨make.nullValue, make.booleanValue, make.numberValue, make.stringValue, make.arrayValue, make.objectValue⟩

inductive ScanState (J : Type) : Type where
  | padding
  | literal (word : String) (remaining : Bytes) (value : J)
  | reading (state : Value.State J)

private def liftDecision {J : Type} :
    ScanDecision (Value.State J) (Except String J) → ScanDecision (ScanState J) (Except String J)
  | .more state => .more (.reading state)
  | .done result => .done result

private def advance {J : Type} (make : Builders J) :
    ScanState J → UInt8 → ScanDecision (ScanState J) (Except String J)
  | .padding, b =>
    if jsonSpace b then .more .padding
    else if !jsonStarter b then
      .done (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " looking for beginning of value"))
    else if b == 110 then .more (.literal "null" (bytes "ull") make.nullValue)
    else if b == 116 then .more (.literal "true" (bytes "rue") (make.booleanValue true))
    else if b == 102 then .more (.literal "false" (bytes "alse") (make.booleanValue false))
    else .more (.reading (Value.start b))
  | .literal word remaining j, b =>
    match remaining with
    | [] => .done (.ok j)
    | expected :: rest =>
      if b == expected then .more (.literal word rest j)
      else
        .done (.error ("invalid character " ++ quoteByte b ++ " in literal " ++ word ++
          " (expecting " ++ quoteByte expected ++ ")"))
  | .reading state, b => liftDecision (Value.push (valueBuilders make) state b)

private def finish {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ScanState J → Except String J
  | .padding => .error "EOF"
  | .literal _ [] j => .ok j
  | .literal _ (_ :: _) _ => .error "unexpected EOF"
  | .reading state => Value.finish (valueBuilders make) state

def scanner {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ByteScanner (ScanState J) (Except String J) :=
  ⟨.padding, advance make, finish make⟩
def read {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Except String J) × InChan :=
  evalScanner (scanner make) ch
def decode {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (bs : Bytes) : Except String J :=
  ((read make (closedPipe bs)).1.value?).getD (.error "EOF")

private theorem stripPad {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (pad tail : Bytes) (closed waited : Bool)
    (h : pad.all jsonSpace = true) :
    read make ⟨pad ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = read make ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩ := by
  change runScannerFrom (scanner make) .padding (pad ++ tail) closed waited =
    runScannerFrom (scanner make) .padding tail closed waited
  induction pad with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b pad ih =>
    simp only [List.all_cons, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
    have stay : (scanner make).onByte .padding b = .more .padding := by
      simp [scanner, advance, h.1]
    rw [List.cons_append, runScannerFrom, stay]
    exact ih h.2

private theorem decodePad {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (pad tail : Bytes)
    (h : pad.all jsonSpace = true) :
    decode make (pad ++ tail) = decode make tail := by
  simp only [decode, closedPipe, stripPad make pad tail true false h]

private theorem runReading {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (first : UInt8)
    (state : Value.State J) (rest : Bytes) (closed waited : Bool) :
    runScannerFrom (scanner make) (.reading state) rest closed waited =
      runScannerFrom (Value.machine (valueBuilders make) first) state rest closed waited := by
  induction rest generalizing state with
  | nil => cases closed <;> rfl
  | cons b rest ih =>
    have localStep :
        (scanner make).onByte (.reading state) b = liftDecision (Value.push (valueBuilders make) state b) :=
      rfl
    have childStep :
        (Value.machine (valueBuilders make) first).onByte state b = Value.push (valueBuilders make) state b :=
      rfl
    simp only [runScannerFrom, localStep, childStep]
    cases Value.push (valueBuilders make) state b with
    | more next => exact ih next
    | done result => rfl

private theorem readFromValue {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (first : UInt8)
    (rest : Bytes) (closed waited : Bool)
    (entry : advance make .padding first = .more (.reading (Value.start first))) :
    read make ⟨first :: rest, closed, waited⟩ = Value.run (valueBuilders make) first rest closed waited := by
  change runScannerFrom (scanner make) .padding (first :: rest) closed waited = _
  rw [runScannerFrom, show (scanner make).onByte .padding first = _ from entry]
  exact runReading make first (Value.start first) rest closed waited

private theorem decodeValue {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (pad : Bytes) (first : UInt8) (rest : Bytes)
    (padding : pad.all jsonSpace = true)
    (entry : advance make .padding first = .more (.reading (Value.start first))) :
    decode make (pad ++ (first :: rest)) = Value.valueAtEnd (valueBuilders make) first rest := by
  simp only [decode, closedPipe, Value.valueAtEnd, stripPad make pad (first :: rest) true false padding,
    readFromValue make first rest true false entry]

private theorem numberEntry {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (b : UInt8)
    (first : b = 45 ∨ (48 ≤ b.toNat ∧ b.toNat ≤ 57)) :
    advance make .padding b = .more (.reading (Value.start b)) := by
  rcases first with rfl | ⟨lo, hi⟩
  · rfl
  · have different (k : UInt8) (outside : k.toNat < 48 ∨ 57 < k.toNat) : b ≠ k := by
      intro e
      rw [e] at lo hi
      omega
    have hs : jsonSpace b = false := by
      simp [jsonSpace, different 32 (by decide), different 9 (by decide),
        different 10 (by decide), different 13 (by decide)]
    have ht : jsonStarter b = true := by simp [jsonStarter, lo, hi]
    simp [advance, hs, ht, different 110 (by decide), different 116 (by decide), different 102 (by decide)]

private theorem partToValue {wire : Bytes} {c : Char} (p : JsonStringPart wire c) :
    Value.JsonStringPart wire c := by
  cases p with
  | verbatim c h => exact .verbatim c h
  | simple b c h => exact .simple b c h
  | unicode digits c h => exact .unicode digits c h
  | surrogatePair high low h l hi lo => exact .surrogatePair high low h l hi lo

private theorem stringToValue {wire : Bytes} {s : String} (p : jsonString wire s) :

  obtain ⟨parts, valid, wireEq, textEq⟩ := p
  exact ⟨parts, fun pair mem => partToValue (valid pair mem), wireEq, textEq⟩

  ⟨x.leading, x.keySpelling, x.key, x.keyPadding, valueElement x.element⟩

private theorem spellingToValue {J : Type} {make : Builders J} {container : Bool}

  induction valid with
  | null depth => exact .null depth
  | boolean depth b => exact .boolean depth b
  | number depth n h => exact .number depth n h
  | string depth wire s h => exact .string depth wire s (stringToValue h)
  | array depth pad items spaces padding valid ih =>
    have result := Value.Spelling.array (make := valueBuilders make) depth pad (items.map valueElement)
      spaces
      (by
        intro child mem
        obtain ⟨parent, parentMem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
        exact padding parent parentMem)
      (by
        intro child mem
        obtain ⟨parent, parentMem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
        exact ih parent parentMem)
    simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def] at result
    exact result
  | object depth pad members spaces padding valid ih =>
    have result := Value.Spelling.object (make := valueBuilders make) depth pad (members.map valueMember)

        obtain ⟨leading, keyPad, key, valuePad, trailing⟩ := padding parent parentMem
        exact ⟨leading, keyPad, stringToValue key, valuePad, trailing⟩)

        intro child mem
        obtain ⟨parent, parentMem, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
        exact ih parent parentMem)

private theorem scalarExact {J : Type} (make : Builders J) (depth : Nat) (pad wire : Bytes)

    read make ⟨pad ++ wire, closed, waited⟩ = Value.scalarResult j closed waited := by
  rw [stripPad make pad wire closed waited padding]

  | null depth => cases closed <;> rfl
  | boolean depth b => cases b <;> cases closed <;> rfl
  | number depth n h =>
    obtain ⟨b, rest, wireEq, first, result⟩ := Value.numberExact (valueBuilders make) n h

    have starts : ∃ rest, wire = 34 :: rest := by
      obtain ⟨parts, _, wireEq, _⟩ := h
      refine ⟨(parts.map Prod.fst).flatten ++ [34], ?_⟩

    ∃ b rest, wire = b :: rest ∧ (b = 91 ∨ b = 123) := by
  cases valid with
  | array => exact ⟨91, _, rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
  | object => exact ⟨123, _, rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩

  intro bs padding
  calc
    decode make bs = decode make [] := by simpa only [List.append_nil] using decodePad make bs [] padding
    _ = .error "EOF" := rfl

theorem literalTail {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ pad tail, pad.all jsonSpace = true →
    decode make (pad ++ bytes "null" ++ tail) = .ok make.nullValue ∧
    decode make (pad ++ bytes "true" ++ tail) = .ok (make.booleanValue true) ∧
    decode make (pad ++ bytes "false" ++ tail) = .ok (make.booleanValue false) := by
  intro pad tail padding
  simp only [List.append_assoc, decodePad make pad _ padding]
  cases tail <;> exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

theorem containerReady {J : Type} (make : Builders J) : ∀ depth pad wire tail j closed waited, depth ≤ 10000 →
    pad.all jsonSpace = true → Spelling make true depth wire j →
    read make ⟨pad ++ wire ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ = (.emit (.ok j), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) := by
  intro depth pad wire tail j closed waited bound padding valid
  obtain ⟨b, rest, rfl, starts⟩ := containerStart valid
  have entry : advance make .padding b = .more (.reading (Value.start b)) := by
    rcases starts with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  rw [List.append_assoc, stripPad make pad _ closed waited padding, List.cons_append,
    readFromValue make b (rest ++ tail) closed waited entry]
  exact evalScanner_prefix_causal (Value.machine (valueBuilders make) b) rest [] tail (.ok j) closed waited

  intro container depth pad wire j bound padding valid

  | false =>

    rw [scalarExact make depth pad wire j true false padding valid]
    rfl
  | true =>
    have ready := containerReady make depth pad wire [] j true false bound padding valid

    rw [ready]
    rfl

  rw [stripPad make pad (b :: tail) closed waited padding]
  change runScannerFrom (scanner make) .padding (b :: tail) closed waited = _

  simp [scanner, advance, space, starter]

private theorem partFromQuoteChar {wire : Bytes} {c : Char} (p : QuoteChar.JsonStringPart wire c) :

  cases p with
  | verbatim c h => exact .verbatim c h
  | simple b c h => exact .simple b c h
  | unicode digits c h => exact .unicode digits c h
  | surrogatePair high low h l hi lo => exact .surrogatePair high low h l hi lo

private theorem bytesAppend (s t : String) : bytes (s ++ t) = bytes s ++ bytes t := by
  change (s ++ t).toByteArray.data.toList = s.toByteArray.data.toList ++ t.toByteArray.data.toList
  rw [String.toByteArray_append, ByteArray.data_append, Array.toList_append]

private theorem escapedBytes (cs : List Char) :
    bytes (String.intercalate "" (cs.map (escapeChar true))) =
      (cs.map (fun c => bytes (escapeChar true c))).flatten := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    cases cs with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.flatten_cons, List.flatten_nil, List.append_nil] <;> rfl
    | cons d ds =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons, String.intercalate_cons_cons,
        String.append_empty, String.empty_append, bytesAppend] at *
      exact congrArg (bytes (escapeChar true c) ++ ·) ih

  refine ⟨s.toList.map (fun c => (bytes (escapeChar true c), c)), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩

    obtain ⟨c, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp mem
    exact partFromQuoteChar (QuoteChar.valid c)
  · simp only [quote, escaped, bytesAppend, escapedBytes, List.map_map, Function.comp_def]
    rfl
  · rw [List.map_map]
    change s = String.ofList (s.toList.map id)
    rw [List.map_id, String.ofList_toList]

  ⟨[], (toString n).toList, [], [], by simp, Or.inl rfl, Decimal.digits n, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩

  cases i with
  | ofNat n => exact natSpelling n
  | negSucc n =>
    have repr : toString (Int.negSucc n) = "-" ++ toString (n + 1) := rfl
    refine ⟨['-'], (toString (n + 1)).toList, [], [], ?_, Or.inr rfl, Decimal.digits _, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl⟩
    rw [repr, String.toList_append]
    simp
