def redirectStatus (status : Nat) : Bool := [301, 302, 303, 307, 308].contains status
def asciiReason (text : String) : Prop :=
  text.toList.all (fun c => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127) = true

private def stopped (p : α → Bool) : List α → Prop
  | [] => True
  | x :: _ => p x = false

private theorem spanLoopPrefix (p : α → Bool) (xs ys acc : List α)
    (hxs : xs.all p = true) (hys : stopped p ys) :
    List.span.loop p (xs ++ ys) acc = (acc.reverse ++ xs, ys) := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp [List.span.loop]
    | cons y ys => simp [List.span.loop, show p y = false from hys]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hx, htail⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp (show (p x && xs.all p) = true from hxs)
    simp only [List.cons_append, List.span.loop, hx, if_true]
    rw [ih (x :: acc) htail, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]
    rfl

private theorem spanPrefix (p : α → Bool) (xs ys : List α)
    (hxs : xs.all p = true) (hys : stopped p ys) :
    List.span p (xs ++ ys) = (xs, ys) :=
  spanLoopPrefix p xs ys [] hxs hys

private theorem spanAll (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (hxs : xs.all p = true) :
    List.span p xs = (xs, []) := by
  simpa only [List.append_nil] using spanPrefix p xs [] hxs True.intro

private theorem allOf (p q : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (hp : xs.all p = true)
    (imp : ∀ x, p x = true → q x = true) : xs.all q = true :=
  List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => imp x (List.all_eq_true.mp hp x hx)

private theorem notChar (c d : Char) (h : c ≠ d) : (c != d) = true := by
  simp [h]

private def digitCode (n : Nat) : Bool := 48 ≤ n && n < 58

private def readDecimal (code : α → Nat) : List α → Nat → Option Nat
  | [], acc => some acc
  | c :: cs, acc =>
    let n := code c
    if digitCode n then readDecimal code cs (10 * acc + (n - 48)) else none
termination_by structural cs _ => cs

private theorem digitFacts : ∀ n : Nat, n < 10 →
    (Nat.digitChar n).toNat = 48 + n ∧ LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.digitChar n = Nat.digitChar n
  | 0, _ | 1, _ | 2, _ | 3, _ | 4, _ | 5, _ | 6, _ | 7, _ | 8, _ | 9, _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | n + 10, h => False.elim (by omega)

private theorem digitRead (code : α → Nat) (c : α) (cs : List α) (n acc : Nat)
    (hn : n < 10) (hc : code c = 48 + n) :
    readDecimal code (c :: cs) acc = readDecimal code cs (10 * acc + n) := by
  have hcode : digitCode (48 + n) = true := by
    simp only [digitCode, Bool.and_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_eq]
    omega
  simp only [readDecimal, hc, hcode, if_true, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

private theorem readDigitsCore (emit : Char → α) (code : α → Nat)
    (hem : ∀ n, n < 10 → code (emit (Nat.digitChar n)) = 48 + n)
    (fuel n : Nat) (acc : List Char) (hn : n < fuel) :
    readDecimal code ((Nat.toDigitsCore 10 fuel n acc).map emit) 0 =
      readDecimal code (acc.map emit) n := by
  induction fuel generalizing n acc with
  | zero => omega
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hrem : n % 10 < 10 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have hparts := Nat.mod_add_div n 10
    by_cases hq : n / 10 = 0
    · rw [Nat.toDigitsCore, if_pos hq, List.map_cons, digitRead code _ _ _ _ hrem (hem _ hrem)]
      congr 1
      omega
    · rw [Nat.toDigitsCore, if_neg hq]
      have hlt : n / 10 < fuel := by omega
      rw [ih (n / 10) _ hlt, List.map_cons, digitRead code _ _ _ _ hrem (hem _ hrem)]
      congr 1
      omega

private theorem allDigitsCore (emit : Char → α) (p : α → Bool)
    (hem : ∀ n, n < 10 → p (emit (Nat.digitChar n)) = true)
    (fuel n : Nat) (acc : List Char) (ha : (acc.map emit).all p = true) :
    ((Nat.toDigitsCore 10 fuel n acc).map emit).all p = true := by
  induction fuel generalizing n acc with
  | zero => exact ha
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hrem := hem (n % 10) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide))
    rw [Nat.toDigitsCore]
    split
    · simp [hrem, ha]
    · apply ih
      simp [hrem, ha]

private theorem reprChars (n : Nat) :
    (toString n).toList = Nat.toDigitsCore 10 (n + 1) n [] := by
  change n.repr.toList = _
  simp only [Nat.repr, String.toList_ofList, Nat.toDigits]

private theorem reprRead (n : Nat) : readDecimal Char.toNat (toString n).toList 0 = some n := by
  rw [reprChars n]
  simpa [readDecimal] using readDigitsCore id Char.toNat (fun k hk => (digitFacts k hk).1)
    (n + 1) n [] (Nat.lt_succ_self n)

private theorem reprAll (p : Char → Bool) (hp : ∀ n, n < 10 → p (Nat.digitChar n) = true)
    (n : Nat) : (toString n).toList.all p = true := by
  rw [reprChars n]
  simpa using allDigitsCore id p hp (n + 1) n [] rfl

private theorem sandboxDigits (fuel n : Nat) (acc : List Char) :
    LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decCharsFuel fuel n acc = Nat.toDigitsCore 10 fuel n acc := by
  induction fuel generalizing n acc with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decCharsFuel, Nat.toDigitsCore]
    by_cases h : n < 10
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (Nat.div_eq_of_lt h), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h, (digitFacts n h).2]
    · have hq : n / 10 ≠ 0 := by omega
      rw [if_neg h, if_neg hq, (digitFacts _ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide : 0 < 10))).2]
      exact ih _ _

private theorem decBytesRead (n : Nat) :
    readDecimal UInt8.toNat (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n) 0 = some n := by
  rw [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes, sandboxDigits]
  suffices hem : ∀ k, k < 10 → (byte (Nat.digitChar k).toNat).toNat = 48 + k from
    readDigitsCore (fun c => byte c.toNat) UInt8.toNat hem (n + 1) n [] (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
  intro k hk
  rw [(digitFacts k hk).1]
  change (48 + k) % 256 = 48 + k
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

private theorem decBytesAll (p : Byte → Bool)
    (hp : ∀ n : Nat, n < 10 → p (byte (48 + n)) = true) (n : Nat) :
    (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n).all p = true := by
  rw [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes, sandboxDigits]
  apply allDigitsCore _ p
  · intro k hk
    rw [(digitFacts k hk).1]
    exact hp k hk
  · rfl

private def stripPrefix [BEq α] (test : α → α) : List α → List α → Option (List α)
  | [], xs => some xs
  | p :: ps, x :: xs => if p == test x then stripPrefix test ps xs else none
  | _ :: _, [] => none
termination_by structural ps _ => ps

private def urlScheme (cs : List Char) : Option (Bool × List Char) :=
  match stripPrefix Char.toLower "http://".toList cs with
  | some rest => some (false, rest)
  | none => (stripPrefix Char.toLower "https://".toList cs).map fun rest => (true, rest)

private theorem urlSchemePrefix (tls : Bool) (rest : List Char) :
    urlScheme ((httpScheme tls).toList ++ rest) = some (tls, rest) := by
  cases tls <;> rfl

private def hostChar (c : Char) : Bool :=
  c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || c == '.' || c == '-')

private def targetChar (c : Char) : Bool :=
  c.toNat < 128 && (c.isAlphanum || "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".contains c)

private def beforeTarget (c : Char) : Bool := c != '/' && c != '?' && c != '#'
private def beforeUserInfo (c : Char) : Bool := c != '@'
private def beforePort (c : Char) : Bool := c != ':'
private def beforeFragment (c : Char) : Bool := c != '#'

private theorem excludes (p : Char → Bool) (c d : Char) (hc : p c = true) (hd : p d = false) :
    (c != d) = true := by
  apply notChar
  intro h
  subst d
  rw [hc] at hd
  cases hd

private theorem hostBeforeTarget {c : Char} (hc : hostChar c = true) : beforeTarget c = true := by
  simp only [beforeTarget, excludes hostChar c '/' hc rfl, excludes hostChar c '?' hc rfl,
    excludes hostChar c '#' hc rfl, Bool.true_and]

private theorem digitAvoid (n : Nat) (hn : n < 10) (c : Char)
    (hc : c.toNat < 48 ∨ 58 ≤ c.toNat) : (Nat.digitChar n != c) = true := by
  apply notChar
  intro h
  have hcode := congrArg Char.toNat h
  rw [(digitFacts n hn).1] at hcode
  omega

private theorem digitsBeforeTarget (n : Nat) (hn : n < 10) : beforeTarget (Nat.digitChar n) = true := by
  simp only [beforeTarget, digitAvoid n hn '/' (.inl (by decide)),
    digitAvoid n hn '?' (.inr (by decide)), digitAvoid n hn '#' (.inl (by decide)), Bool.true_and]

private def hexValue (c : Char) : Option Nat :=
  let n := c.toLower.toNat
  if digitCode n then some (n - 48)
  else if 97 ≤ n && n ≤ 102 then some (n - 87)
  else none

private def credentialBytes : List Char → Bytes → Option Bytes
  | [], acc => some acc.reverse
  | '%' :: a :: b :: cs, acc =>
    match hexValue a, hexValue b with
    | some x, some y => credentialBytes cs (byte (16 * x + y) :: acc)
    | _, _ => none
  | '%' :: _, _ => none
  | c :: cs, acc => credentialBytes cs ((utf8Char c).reverseAux acc)
termination_by structural cs _ => cs

private def base64Char (n : Nat) : Char :=
  Char.ofNat (if n < 26 then n + 65
    else if n < 52 then n + 71
    else if n < 62 then n - 4
    else if n == 62 then 43
    else 47)

private def base64Chars : Bytes → List Char → List Char
  | a :: b :: c :: bs, acc =>
    let x := a.toNat
    let y := b.toNat
    let z := c.toNat
    base64Chars bs (base64Char (z % 64) :: base64Char ((y % 16) * 4 + z / 64) ::
      base64Char ((x % 4) * 16 + y / 16) :: base64Char (x / 4) :: acc)
  | [a, b], acc =>
    let x := a.toNat
    let y := b.toNat
    ('=' :: base64Char ((y % 16) * 4) :: base64Char ((x % 4) * 16 + y / 16) ::
      base64Char (x / 4) :: acc).reverse
  | [a], acc =>
    let x := a.toNat
    ('=' :: '=' :: base64Char ((x % 4) * 16) :: base64Char (x / 4) :: acc).reverse
  | [], acc => acc.reverse
termination_by structural bs _ => bs

private def basicAuth (userinfo : List Char) : Except String String := do
  let userinfo := if userinfo.contains ':' then userinfo else userinfo ++ [':']
  match credentialBytes userinfo [] with
  | some bs => return "Basic " ++ String.ofList (base64Chars bs [])
  | none => throw "invalid URL userinfo escape"

private def splitUserInfo (cs : List Char) : Except String (Option String × List Char) :=
  match List.span beforeUserInfo cs with
  | (user, '@' :: rest) => do
    let auth ← basicAuth user
    return (some auth, rest)
  | _ => .ok (none, cs)

private def defaultPort (tls : Bool) : Nat := if tls then 443 else 80

private def readHostPort (tls : Bool) (host : List Char) (suffix : List Char) :
    Except String (String × Nat) := do
  if host.isEmpty then throw "missing URL host"
  let port ←
    match suffix with
    | [] => .ok (defaultPort tls)
    | ':' :: digits =>
      match readDecimal Char.toNat digits 0 with
      | some port =>
        if 0 < port ∧ port ≤ 65535 then .ok port else .error "invalid URL port"
      | none => .error "invalid URL port"
    | _ => .error "invalid URL authority"
  return (String.ofList host, port)

private def readAuthority (tls : Bool) (cs : List Char) : Except String (String × Nat) :=
  match cs with
  | '[' :: tail =>
    match List.span (fun c => c != ']') tail with
    | (host, ']' :: rest) =>
      if host.all (fun c => c.isAlphanum || c == ':' || c == '.' || c == '%' || c == '-' || c == '_') then
        readHostPort tls host rest
      else .error "invalid URL host"
    | _ => .error "invalid bracketed URL host"
  | _ =>
    let (host, suffix) := List.span beforePort cs
    if host.all hostChar then readHostPort tls host suffix else .error "invalid URL host"

private def originTarget (rest : List Char) : String :=
  let cs := (List.span beforeFragment rest).1
  if cs.head? == some '/' then String.ofList cs else String.ofList ('/' :: cs)

private def originParts (tls : Bool) (url : String) (cs : List Char) : Except String HttpOrigin := do
  let (rawAuthority, rest) := List.span beforeTarget cs
  let (authorization, authority) ← splitUserInfo rawAuthority
  let (host, port) ← readAuthority tls authority
  let target := originTarget rest
  if target.toList.any (fun c => c.toNat < 32 || c.toNat == 127) then
    throw "invalid control character in URL"
  return ⟨tls, host, port, String.ofList authority, target, url, authorization⟩

def parseHttpOrigin (url : String) : Except String HttpOrigin :=
  match urlScheme url.toList with
  | some (tls, cs) => originParts tls url cs
  | none => .error "unsupported URL scheme"

private theorem targetStart (target : String) (h : targetText target) :
    ∃ cs, target.toList = '/' :: cs := by
  have hp : ['/'] <+: target.toList := by simpa using h.1
  obtain ⟨tail, ht⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨tail, ht.symm⟩

private theorem originTargetValid (target : String) (ht : targetText target) :
    originTarget target.toList = target := by
  have hclean : target.toList.all beforeFragment = true :=
    allOf targetChar beforeFragment _ ht.2 (fun c h => excludes targetChar c '#' h (by simp [targetChar, Char.isAlphanum, Char.isAlpha, Char.isUpper, Char.isLower, Char.isDigit]))
  obtain ⟨rest, hrest⟩ := targetStart target ht
  unfold originTarget
  rw [spanAll _ _ hclean]
  have hhead : (target.toList.head? == some '/') = true := by rw [hrest]; rfl
  rw [if_pos hhead]
  exact String.ofList_toList

private theorem validTargetControl (target : String) (ht : targetText target) :
    target.toList.any (fun c => c.toNat < 32 || c.toNat == 127) = false := by
  apply List.any_eq_false.mpr
  intro c hc
  have hchar : targetChar c = true := List.all_eq_true.mp ht.2 c hc
  have hmem : c.isAlphanum = true ∨ "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".contains c = true :=
    Bool.or_eq_true_iff.mp (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hchar).2
  have halnum : c.isAlphanum = true → 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≠ 127 := by
    intro h
    simp only [Char.isAlphanum, Char.isAlpha, Char.isUpper, Char.isLower, Char.isDigit,
      Bool.or_eq_true_iff, Bool.and_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    change ((65 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 90) ∨ (97 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 122)) ∨
      (48 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57) at h
    omega
  have hother : "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".contains c = true → 32 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≠ 127 := by
    intro h
    have hm : c ∈ "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".toList := by simpa using h
    exact List.all_eq_true.mp
      (show "/?-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@".toList.all (fun d => decide (32 ≤ d.toNat ∧ d.toNat ≠ 127)) = true
        from rfl) c hm |> of_decide_eq_true
  have h := hmem.elim halnum hother
  simp [Nat.not_lt.mpr h.1, h.2]

private theorem hostNonempty (host : String) (hh : hostText host) : host.toList ≠ [] := by
  intro h
  apply hh.1
  calc
    host = String.ofList host.toList := String.ofList_toList.symm
    _ = "" := by rw [h]

private theorem regularAuthority (tls : Bool) (host : String) (suffix : List Char)
    (hh : hostText host) (hs : stopped beforePort suffix) :
    readAuthority tls (host.toList ++ suffix) = readHostPort tls host.toList suffix := by
  have nonempty := hostNonempty host hh
  have hvalid : host.toList.all hostChar = true := hh.2
  have hspan := spanPrefix beforePort host.toList suffix
    (allOf hostChar beforePort _ hvalid (fun c h => excludes hostChar c ':' h rfl)) hs
  have hregular : ∀ rest, (host.toList ++ suffix) ≠ '[' :: rest := by
    intro rest he
    cases hl : host.toList with
    | nil => exact nonempty hl
    | cons x xs =>
      have hx : x = '[' := by
        rw [hl, List.cons_append] at he
        exact (List.cons.inj he).1
      rw [hl, hx] at hvalid
      cases hvalid
  unfold readAuthority
  split
  · rename_i rest hr
    exact (hregular rest hr).elim
  · simp only [hspan, hvalid, if_true]

private theorem readExplicit (tls : Bool) (host : String) (port : Nat) (hh : hostText host)
    (hl : 0 < port) (hu : port ≤ 65535) :
    readAuthority tls (host.toList ++ (':' :: (toString port).toList)) = .ok (host, port) := by
  rw [regularAuthority tls host (':' :: (toString port).toList) hh rfl]
  have hne : host.toList.isEmpty = false := by
    cases h : host.toList with
    | nil => exact (hostNonempty host hh h).elim
    | cons => rfl
  simp only [readHostPort, hne, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, reprRead, if_pos (show 0 < port ∧ port ≤ 65535 from ⟨hl, hu⟩)]
  change Except.ok (String.ofList host.toList, port) = _
  rw [String.ofList_toList]

private theorem readDefault (tls : Bool) (host : String) (hh : hostText host) :
    readAuthority tls host.toList = .ok (host, defaultPort tls) := by
  rw [show host.toList = host.toList ++ [] from (List.append_nil _).symm,
    regularAuthority tls host [] hh True.intro]
  have hne : host.toList.isEmpty = false := by
    cases h : host.toList with
    | nil => exact (hostNonempty host hh h).elim
    | cons => rfl
  simp only [readHostPort, hne, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  change Except.ok (String.ofList host.toList, defaultPort tls) = _
  rw [String.ofList_toList]

private theorem originPartsPlain (tls : Bool) (url authority : String) (rest : List Char)
    (host : String) (port : Nat) (ha : authority.toList.all beforeTarget = true)
    (hu : authority.toList.all beforeUserInfo = true) (hr : stopped beforeTarget rest)
    (hp : readAuthority tls authority.toList = .ok (host, port))
    (hc : (originTarget rest).toList.any (fun c => c.toNat < 32 || c.toNat == 127) = false) :
    originParts tls url (authority.toList ++ rest) =
      .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, originTarget rest, url, none⟩ := by
  unfold originParts
  rw [spanPrefix _ _ _ ha hr]
  simp only [splitUserInfo, spanAll _ _ hu]
  change (do
    let (h, p) ← readAuthority tls authority.toList
    if (originTarget rest).toList.any (fun c => c.toNat < 32 || c.toNat == 127) then
      throw "invalid control character in URL"
    pure (⟨tls, h, p, String.ofList authority.toList, originTarget rest, url, none⟩ : HttpOrigin)) = _
  simp only [hp, hc, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, String.ofList_toList]
  rfl

theorem parseHttpOriginPort : ∀ tls host port target, hostText host → 0 < port → port ≤ 65535 →
    targetText target →
    let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
    let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
    parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩ := by
  intro tls host port target hh hl hu ht
  dsimp only
  rw [parseHttpOrigin, String.toList_append, String.toList_append, List.append_assoc, urlSchemePrefix]
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  change originParts tls (httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target) (authority.toList ++ target.toList) = _
  have hac : authority.toList = host.toList ++ (':' :: (toString port).toList) := by
    simp only [authority, String.toList_append, List.append_assoc]
    rfl
  have hs : stopped beforeTarget target.toList := by
    obtain ⟨rest, hrest⟩ := targetStart target ht
    rw [hrest]
    rfl
  have hp : readAuthority tls authority.toList = .ok (host, port) := by
    rw [hac]
    exact readExplicit tls host port hh hl hu
  have ha : authority.toList.all beforeTarget = true := by
    rw [hac, List.all_append]
    simp only [allOf hostChar beforeTarget _ hh.2 (fun _ => hostBeforeTarget), List.all_cons,
      show beforeTarget ':' = true from rfl, reprAll _ digitsBeforeTarget port, Bool.true_and]
  have huser : authority.toList.all beforeUserInfo = true := by
    rw [hac, List.all_append]
    simp only [allOf hostChar beforeUserInfo _ hh.2 (fun c h => excludes hostChar c '@' h rfl),
      List.all_cons, show beforeUserInfo ':' = true from rfl, Bool.true_and,
      reprAll beforeUserInfo (fun n hn => digitAvoid n hn '@' (.inr (by decide))) port]
  have h := originTargetValid target ht
  rw [originPartsPlain _ _ _ _ host port ha huser hs hp (h.symm ▸ validTargetControl target ht), h]

theorem parseHttpOriginDefaultPort : ∀ tls host, hostText host →
    let url := httpScheme tls ++ host
    parseHttpOrigin url = .ok ⟨tls, host, if tls then 443 else 80, host, "/", url, none⟩ := by
  intro tls host hh
  dsimp only
  rw [parseHttpOrigin, String.toList_append, urlSchemePrefix]
  change originParts tls (httpScheme tls ++ host) host.toList = _
  have ha := allOf hostChar beforeTarget _ hh.2 (fun _ => hostBeforeTarget)
  have hu := allOf hostChar beforeUserInfo _ hh.2 (fun c h => excludes hostChar c '@' h rfl)
  have hroot : originTarget [] = "/" := rfl
  simpa only [List.append_nil, hroot, defaultPort] using
    originPartsPlain tls (httpScheme tls ++ host) host [] host (defaultPort tls) ha hu True.intro
      (readDefault tls host hh) rfl

private def cleanSegments (rev : List String) : List String → List String
  | [] => rev.reverse
  | s :: rest =>
    if s == "." then
      if rest.isEmpty then ("" :: rev).reverse else cleanSegments rev rest
    else if s == ".." then
      if rest.isEmpty then ("" :: rev.drop 1).reverse else cleanSegments (rev.drop 1) rest
    else cleanSegments (s :: rev) rest
termination_by structural parts => parts

private def normalizeRedirect (origin : HttpOrigin) : HttpOrigin :=
  if (((origin.target.splitOn "?").headD "").splitOn "/").all
      (fun s => s != "." && s != "..") then origin
  else
    let (path, query) := List.span (fun c => c != '?') origin.target.toList
    let parts := ((String.ofList path).splitOn "/").drop 1
    let target := "/" ++ String.intercalate "/" (cleanSegments [] parts) ++ String.ofList query
    {origin with target := target, url := httpScheme origin.tls ++ origin.authority ++ target}

private def relativeTarget (previous : String) (ref : List Char) : String :=
  let clean := (List.span beforeFragment ref).1
  let path := (List.span (fun c => c != '?') previous.toList).1
  match clean with
  | [] => previous
  | '/' :: _ => String.ofList clean
  | '?' :: _ => String.ofList (path ++ clean)
  | _ =>
    let dir := (path.reverse.dropWhile (fun c => c != '/')).reverse
    String.ofList (dir ++ clean)

def resolveLocation (previous : HttpOrigin) (location : String) : Except String HttpOrigin := do
  let ref := location.toList
  match urlScheme ref with
  | some (tls, rest) => return normalizeRedirect (← originParts tls location rest)
  | none =>
    match ref with
    | '/' :: '/' :: rest =>
      return normalizeRedirect (← parseHttpOrigin (httpScheme previous.tls ++ String.ofList rest))
    | _ =>
      let first := (List.span beforeTarget ref).1
      if first.contains ':' then
        throw "unsupported redirect scheme"
      let target := relativeTarget previous.target ref
      let next ← parseHttpOrigin (httpScheme previous.tls ++ previous.authority ++ target)
      return normalizeRedirect {next with authorization := previous.authorization}

theorem resolveLocationAbsolute : ∀ previous tls host port target, hostText host →
    0 < port → port ≤ 65535 → targetText target →
    (((target.splitOn "?").headD "").splitOn "/").all (fun s => s != "." && s != "..") = true →
    let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
    let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
    resolveLocation previous url = .ok ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩ := by
  intro previous tls host port target hh hl hu ht hpath
  dsimp only
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString port
  let url := httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target
  have hs : urlScheme url.toList = some (tls, authority.toList ++ target.toList) := by
    change urlScheme (httpScheme tls ++ authority ++ target).toList = _
    rw [String.toList_append, String.toList_append, List.append_assoc, urlSchemePrefix]
  have hp := parseHttpOriginPort tls host port target hh hl hu ht
  change parseHttpOrigin url = _ at hp
  rw [parseHttpOrigin, hs] at hp
  change originParts tls url (authority.toList ++ target.toList) = _ at hp
  change resolveLocation previous url = _
  rw [resolveLocation, hs]
  change (do
    let origin ← originParts tls url (authority.toList ++ target.toList)
    pure (normalizeRedirect origin)) = _
  rw [hp]
  change Except.ok (normalizeRedirect ⟨tls, host, port, authority, target, url, none⟩) = _
  simp only [normalizeRedirect, hpath, if_true]
  rfl

private def directAttempt (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String) : HttpAttempt :=
  ⟨origin.tls, o.insecure, origin.host, origin.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
    origin.target, origin.url, referer, origin.authorization, none, []⟩

private def connectTunnel (origin : HttpOrigin) (authorization : Option String) : Bytes :=
  let host := if origin.host.contains ':' then "[" ++ origin.host ++ "]" else origin.host
  let authority := host ++ ":" ++ toString origin.port
  let authLine := match authorization with
    | some auth => "Proxy-Authorization: " ++ auth ++ "\r\n"
    | none => ""
  bytes ("CONNECT " ++ authority ++ " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: " ++ authority ++ "\r\n" ++ authLine ++ "\r\n")

private def proxyAttempt (o : Options) (origin proxy : HttpOrigin)
    (referer : Option String) : HttpAttempt :=
  if origin.tls then
    ⟨true, o.insecure, proxy.host, proxy.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      origin.target, origin.url, referer, origin.authorization, none,
      connectTunnel origin proxy.authorization⟩
  else
    ⟨proxy.tls, o.insecure, proxy.host, proxy.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
      httpScheme false ++ origin.authority ++ origin.target, origin.url, referer,
      origin.authorization, proxy.authorization, []⟩

def prepareAttempt (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String) : HttpAttempt :=
  if o.proxy = "" then directAttempt o origin referer
  else
    match parseHttpOrigin o.proxy with
    | .ok proxy => proxyAttempt o origin proxy referer
    | .error _ =>
      match parseHttpOrigin (httpScheme false ++ o.proxy) with
      | .ok proxy => proxyAttempt o origin proxy referer
      | .error _ => directAttempt o origin referer

theorem prepareDirect : ∀ o origin referer, o.proxy = "" →
    prepareAttempt o origin referer =
      ⟨origin.tls, o.insecure, origin.host, origin.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
        origin.target, origin.url, referer, origin.authorization, none, []⟩ := by
  intro o origin referer h
  simp only [prepareAttempt, if_pos h, directAttempt]

theorem prepareProxy : ∀ o origin proxy referer, o.proxy ≠ "" →
    parseHttpOrigin o.proxy = .ok proxy → origin.tls = false → proxy.tls = false →
    proxy.authorization = none →
    prepareAttempt o origin referer =
      ⟨false, o.insecure, proxy.host, proxy.port, origin.host, origin.authority,
        httpScheme false ++ origin.authority ++ origin.target, origin.url, referer,
        origin.authorization, none, []⟩ := by
  intro o origin proxy referer hp hproxy hOrigin hTLS hAuth
  simp only [prepareAttempt, if_neg hp, hproxy, proxyAttempt, hOrigin, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
    hTLS, hAuth]

private def notCR (b : Byte) : Bool := b != byte 13
private def beforeStatusSpace (b : Byte) : Bool := b != byte 32
private def beforeColon (b : Byte) : Bool := b != byte 58
private def byteOWS (b : Byte) : Bool := b == byte 32 || b == byte 9
private def charOWS (c : Char) : Bool := c == ' ' || c == '\t'

private def trimEdges (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) : List α :=
  ((xs.dropWhile p).reverse.dropWhile p).reverse

private def parseStatusLine (line : Bytes) : Option Nat := do
  let rest ← (stripPrefix id (bytes "HTTP/1.1 ") line).orElse
    (fun () => stripPrefix id (bytes "HTTP/1.0 ") line)
  let code ← readDecimal UInt8.toNat (List.span beforeStatusSpace rest).1 0
  if 100 ≤ code ∧ code ≤ 999 then some code else none

private def parseLength (raw : Bytes) : Option Nat :=
  let digits := trimEdges byteOWS raw
  if digits.isEmpty then none else readDecimal UInt8.toNat digits 0

private structure Headers where
  location : Option String := none
  length : Option Nat := none
  chunked : Bool := false

private def fieldText (value : Bytes) : String :=
  String.ofList (trimEdges charOWS (LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode value))

private def lowerByte (b : Byte) : Byte :=
  let n := b.toNat
  if 65 ≤ n && n ≤ 90 then byte (n + 32) else b

private def addField (headers : Headers) (line : Bytes) : Except String Headers :=
  match List.span beforeColon line with
  | ([], _) | (_, []) => .error "malformed HTTP header"
  | (name, _ :: raw) =>
    let name := name.map lowerByte
    if name == bytes "content-length" then
      match parseLength raw with
      | none => .error "invalid Content-Length"
      | some n =>
        if headers.length.isSome && headers.length != some n then
          .error "conflicting Content-Length"
        else .ok {headers with length := some n}
    else if name == bytes "location" then
      .ok {headers with location := headers.location.orElse (fun () => some (fieldText raw))}
    else if name == bytes "transfer-encoding" then
      let parts := (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.lower (fieldText raw)).splitOn ","
      .ok {headers with chunked := ((parts.getLastD "").trimAscii.toString == "chunked")}
    else .ok headers

private inductive HeadState where
  | start
  | fields (status : Nat) (headers : Headers)

private def headStep (state : HeadState) (line : Bytes) :
    Except String (Sum HeadState (Nat × Headers)) :=
  match state with
  | .start =>
    match parseStatusLine line with
    | some status => .ok (.inl (.fields status {}))
    | none => .error "malformed HTTP status line"
  | .fields status headers =>
    match line with
    | [] => .ok (.inr (status, headers))
    | _ :: _ =>
      match addField headers line with
      | .ok headers => .ok (.inl (.fields status headers))
      | .error msg => .error msg

private def readHead : HeadState → Bytes → Bytes → Except String (Nat × Headers × Bytes)
  | _, _, [] => .error "unexpected EOF"
  | state, rev, b :: bs =>
    if notCR b then readHead state (b :: rev) bs
    else
      match bs with
      | [] => .error "unexpected EOF"
      | lf :: rest =>
        if lf == byte 10 then
          match headStep state rev.reverse with
          | .ok (.inl next) => readHead next [] rest
          | .ok (.inr (status, headers)) => .ok (status, headers, rest)
          | .error msg => .error msg
        else .error "malformed HTTP line ending"
termination_by structural _ _ input => input

private def hexSize : Bytes → Nat → Option Nat
  | [], acc => some acc
  | b :: bs, acc =>
    match hexValue (Char.ofNat b.toNat) with
    | some n => hexSize bs (16 * acc + n)
    | none => none
termination_by structural bs _ => bs

private def chunkFailure (rev : Bytes) (msg : String) : HttpBody := ⟨rev.reverse, some msg⟩

private def readChunks : Nat → Bytes → Bytes → HttpBody
  | 0, _, rev => chunkFailure rev "unexpected EOF"
  | fuel + 1, input, rev =>
    match LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.splitMark (bytes "\r\n") input with
    | none => chunkFailure rev "unexpected EOF"
    | some (line, rest) =>
      let size := (List.span (fun b => b != byte 59) line).1
      if size.isEmpty then chunkFailure rev "invalid chunk length"
      else match hexSize size 0 with
      | none => chunkFailure rev "invalid chunk length"
      | some 0 =>
        if LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.prefixBytes (bytes "\r\n") rest ||
            (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.splitMark (bytes "\r\n\r\n") rest).isSome then
          ⟨rev.reverse, none⟩
        else chunkFailure rev "unexpected EOF"
      | some n =>
        let chunk := rest.take n
        let rev := chunk.reverseAux rev
        if rest.length < n then chunkFailure rev "unexpected EOF"
        else
          match stripPrefix id (bytes "\r\n") (rest.drop n) with
          | some tail => readChunks fuel tail rev
          | none => chunkFailure rev "malformed chunk terminator"
termination_by structural fuel _ _ => fuel

private def responseBody (status : Nat) (headers : Headers) (rest : Bytes) : HttpBody :=
  if bodyAllowed status then
    if headers.chunked then readChunks rest.length rest []
    else match headers.length with
    | none => ⟨rest, none⟩
    | some n => ⟨rest.take n, if rest.length < n then some "unexpected EOF" else none⟩
  else ⟨[], none⟩

def decodeResponse (wire : Bytes) : Except String HttpResponse :=
  match readHead .start [] wire with
  | .error msg => .error msg
  | .ok (status, headers, rest) => .ok ⟨status, headers.location, responseBody status headers rest⟩

private theorem byteCode (n : Nat) (hn : n < 256) : (byte n).toNat = n :=
  Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn

private theorem byteAvoid (n m : Nat) (hn : n < 256) (hm : m < 256) (h : n ≠ m) :
    (byte n != byte m) = true := by
  have he : byte n ≠ byte m := by
    intro e
    apply h
    have hc := congrArg UInt8.toNat e
    rwa [byteCode n hn, byteCode m hm] at hc
  simp [he]

private theorem decBytesAvoid (m : Nat) (hm : m < 256) (hsep : m < 48 ∨ 58 ≤ m) (n : Nat) :
    (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n).all (fun b => b != byte m) = true :=
  decBytesAll _ (fun d hd => byteAvoid (48 + d) m (by omega) hm (by omega)) n

private theorem utf8BytesList (cs : List Char) :
    bytes (String.ofList cs) = cs.flatMap utf8Char := by
  change (cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar).toByteArray.data.toList = _
  simp [utf8Char]

private theorem utf8BytesText (s : String) : bytes s = s.toList.flatMap utf8Char := by
  have h : String.ofList s.toList = s := String.ofList_toList
  exact (congrArg bytes h.symm).trans (utf8BytesList s.toList)

private theorem decodeBytesText (s : String) : LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode (bytes s) = s.toList := by
  change LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode s.toByteArray.data.toList = _
  have h : String.ofList s.toList = s := String.ofList_toList
  simpa only [h] using LojitaCtx.Utf8.decodeOfList s.toList

private theorem decodePrefixedSpace (s : String) :
    LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode (byte 32 :: bytes s) = ' ' :: s.toList := by
  rw [← decodeBytesText]
  rfl

private theorem asciiByteNoCR (cs : List Char)
    (h : cs.all (fun c => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127) = true) :
    (cs.flatMap utf8Char).all notCR = true := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    obtain ⟨hc, hcs⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h
    obtain ⟨hl, hu⟩ := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc
    have hmin : 32 ≤ c.toNat := of_decide_eq_true hl
    have hmax : c.toNat < 127 := of_decide_eq_true hu
    have hutf : utf8Char c = [byte c.toNat] := by
      have hsmall : c.val.toNat ≤ 127 := show c.toNat ≤ 127 by omega
      simp only [utf8Char, String.utf8EncodeChar, if_pos hsmall]
      rfl
    have hcr : notCR (byte c.toNat) = true :=
      byteAvoid c.toNat 13 (by omega) (by decide) (by omega)
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons, hutf, List.singleton_append, List.all_cons, hcr, ih hcs, Bool.true_and]

private theorem asciiTextNoCR (s : String) (h : asciiReason s) : (bytes s).all notCR = true := by
  rw [utf8BytesText]
  exact asciiByteNoCR s.toList h

private theorem dropClean (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (h : xs.all (fun x => !p x) = true) :
    xs.dropWhile p = xs := by
  cases xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs =>
    have hp : (!p x) = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).1
    have hp' : p x = false := by simpa using hp
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, hp', Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

private theorem trimClean (p : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (h : xs.all (fun x => !p x) = true) :
    trimEdges p xs = xs := by
  have hr : xs.reverse.all (fun x => !p x) = true := by simpa using h
  simp only [trimEdges, dropClean p xs h, dropClean p xs.reverse hr, List.reverse_reverse]

private theorem digitsNonempty (fuel n : Nat) (c : Char) (cs : List Char) :
    ((Nat.toDigitsCore 10 fuel n (c :: cs)).map (fun d => byte d.toNat)).isEmpty = false := by
  induction fuel generalizing n c cs with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [Nat.toDigitsCore]
    split
    · rfl
    · exact ih _ _ _

private theorem decBytesNonempty (n : Nat) : (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n).isEmpty = false := by
  rw [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes, sandboxDigits, Nat.toDigitsCore]
  split
  · rfl
  · exact digitsNonempty n _ _ []

private theorem parseLengthGenerated (n : Nat) :
    parseLength (byte 32 :: LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n) = some n := by
  let ds := LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n
  have hall : ds.all (fun b => !byteOWS b) = true := by
    apply decBytesAll
    intro d hd
    rw [byteOWS, Bool.not_or]
    exact Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mpr
      ⟨byteAvoid (48 + d) 32 (by omega) (by decide) (by omega),
       byteAvoid (48 + d) 9 (by omega) (by decide) (by omega)⟩
  have htrim : trimEdges byteOWS (byte 32 :: ds) = ds := by
    change (((byte 32 :: ds).dropWhile byteOWS).reverse.dropWhile byteOWS).reverse = ds
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, show byteOWS (byte 32) = true from rfl, if_true]
    exact trimClean byteOWS ds hall
  simp only [parseLength, htrim, ds, decBytesNonempty, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, decBytesRead]

private theorem dropAgrees (p q : α → Bool) (xs : List α)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, p x = q x) : xs.dropWhile p = xs.dropWhile q := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hx := h x List.mem_cons_self
    have hxs : ∀ y ∈ xs, p y = q y := fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy)
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons, hx, ih hxs]

private theorem dropPreserves (p q : α → Bool) (xs : List α) (h : xs.all p = true) :
    (xs.dropWhile q).all p = true := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.dropWhile_cons]
    split
    · exact ih (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).2
    · exact h

private theorem fieldTextGenerated (loc : String) (h : asciiReason loc) :
    fieldText (byte 32 :: bytes loc) =
      String.ofList ((loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.dropWhile
        (fun c => c == ' ') |>.reverse) := by
  have htab : loc.toList.all (fun c => c != '\t') = true := by
    apply allOf (fun c : Char => 32 ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat < 127) _ _ h
    intro c hc
    apply notChar
    intro he
    subst c
    cases hc
  have agree : ∀ (xs : List Char), xs.all (fun c => c != '\t') = true →
      xs.dropWhile charOWS = xs.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ') := by
    intro xs hs
    apply dropAgrees
    intro c hc
    have hne : c ≠ '\t' := by simpa using List.all_eq_true.mp hs c hc
    simp [charOWS, hne]
  have hdrop := dropPreserves (fun c : Char => c != '\t') (fun c => c == ' ') loc.toList htab
  have hrev : (loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.all (fun c => c != '\t') = true := by
    simpa using hdrop
  simp only [fieldText, decodePrefixedSpace, trimEdges, List.dropWhile_cons,
    show charOWS ' ' = true from rfl, if_true, agree _ htab, agree _ hrev]

private theorem readHeadSkip (state : HeadState) (front tail rev : Bytes)
    (h : front.all notCR = true) :
    readHead state rev (front ++ tail) = readHead state (front.reverseAux rev) tail := by
  induction front generalizing rev with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b bs ih =>
    have hb : notCR b = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).1
    have hbs : bs.all notCR = true := (Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp h).2
    exact (show readHead state rev (b :: (bs ++ tail)) = readHead state (b :: rev) (bs ++ tail) by
      rw [readHead.eq_def]
      simp only [hb, if_true]).trans (ih (b :: rev) hbs)

private theorem readHeadLine (state : HeadState) (line tail : Bytes) (h : line.all notCR = true) :
    readHead state [] (line ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ tail)) =
      match headStep state line with
      | .ok (.inl next) => readHead next [] tail
      | .ok (.inr (status, headers)) => .ok (status, headers, tail)
      | .error msg => .error msg := by
  rw [readHeadSkip _ _ _ _ h]
  change readHead state line.reverse (byte 13 :: byte 10 :: tail) = _
  rw [readHead]
  simp only [show notCR (byte 13) = false from rfl, show (byte 10 == byte 10) = true from rfl,
    Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, List.reverse_reverse]

private def statusLine (status : Nat) (reason : String) : Bytes :=
  bytes "HTTP/1.1 " ++ (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status ++ (bytes " " ++ bytes reason))

private def lengthLine (n : Nat) : Bytes :=
  bytes "Content-Length: " ++ LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n

private def locationLine (loc : String) : Bytes := bytes "Location: " ++ bytes loc

private theorem statusLineOK (status : Nat) (reason : String) (hl : 200 ≤ status) (hu : status ≤ 999) :
    parseStatusLine (statusLine status reason) = some status := by
  have hp (rest : Bytes) :
      stripPrefix id (bytes "HTTP/1.1 ") (bytes "HTTP/1.1 " ++ rest) = some rest := rfl
  have hspace : bytes " " ++ bytes reason = byte 32 :: bytes reason := rfl
  have hd : (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status).all beforeStatusSpace = true :=
    decBytesAvoid 32 (by decide) (.inl (by decide)) status
  have hspan := spanPrefix beforeStatusSpace (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status)
    (byte 32 :: bytes reason) hd rfl
  unfold parseStatusLine statusLine
  rw [hp]
  change (do
    let code ← readDecimal UInt8.toNat
      (List.span beforeStatusSpace (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status ++ (bytes " " ++ bytes reason))).1 0
    if 100 ≤ code ∧ code ≤ 999 then some code else none) = _
  rw [hspace, hspan]
  change (do
    let code ← readDecimal UInt8.toNat (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status) 0
    if 100 ≤ code ∧ code ≤ 999 then some code else none) = _
  rw [decBytesRead]
  change (if 100 ≤ status ∧ status ≤ 999 then some status else none) = _
  rw [if_pos (show 100 ≤ status ∧ status ≤ 999 from ⟨by omega, hu⟩)]

private theorem statusLineClean (status : Nat) (reason : String) (h : asciiReason reason) :
    (statusLine status reason).all notCR = true := by
  have hd : (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes status).all notCR = true :=
    decBytesAvoid 13 (by decide) (.inl (by decide)) status
  simp only [statusLine, List.all_append, hd, asciiTextNoCR _ h,
    show (bytes "HTTP/1.1 ").all notCR = true from rfl, show (bytes " ").all notCR = true from rfl,
    Bool.true_and]

private theorem lengthLineClean (n : Nat) : (lengthLine n).all notCR = true := by
  have hd : (LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n).all notCR = true :=
    decBytesAvoid 13 (by decide) (.inl (by decide)) n
  simp only [lengthLine, List.all_append, hd,
    show (bytes "Content-Length: ").all notCR = true from rfl, Bool.true_and]

private theorem locationLineClean (loc : String) (h : asciiReason loc) :
    (locationLine loc).all notCR = true := by
  simp only [locationLine, List.all_append, asciiTextNoCR _ h,
    show (bytes "Location: ").all notCR = true from rfl, Bool.true_and]

private theorem statusStep (status : Nat) (reason : String) (hl : 200 ≤ status) (hu : status ≤ 999) :
    headStep .start (statusLine status reason) = .ok (.inl (.fields status {})) := by
  rw [headStep, statusLineOK status reason hl hu]

private theorem lengthStep (status n : Nat) :
    headStep (.fields status {}) (lengthLine n) = .ok (.inl (.fields status {length := some n})) := by
  have hadd : addField {} (lengthLine n) = .ok {length := some n} := by
    change (match parseLength (byte 32 :: LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.decBytes n) with
      | none => Except.error "invalid Content-Length"
      | some n => Except.ok ({length := some n} : Headers)) = _
    rw [parseLengthGenerated]
  change (match addField {} (lengthLine n) with
    | .ok headers => Except.ok (Sum.inl (HeadState.fields status headers))
    | .error msg => Except.error msg) = _
  rw [hadd]

private theorem connectionStep (status : Nat) (headers : Headers) :
    headStep (.fields status headers) (bytes "Connection: close") =
      .ok (.inl (.fields status headers)) := rfl

private theorem locationStep (status n : Nat) (loc : String) (h : asciiReason loc) :
    headStep (.fields status {length := some n}) (locationLine loc) =
      .ok (.inl (.fields status ⟨some (String.ofList ((loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.dropWhile
        (fun c => c == ' ') |>.reverse)), some n, false⟩)) := by
  change Except.ok (Sum.inl (HeadState.fields status
    {length := some n, location := some (fieldText (byte 32 :: bytes loc))})) = _
  rw [fieldTextGenerated loc h]

private def encodedHead (status : Nat) (reason : String) (n : Nat) (tail : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  statusLine status reason ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++
    (lengthLine n ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++
      (bytes "Connection: close" ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ tail)))))

private theorem scanEncodedHead (status : Nat) (reason : String) (n : Nat) (tail : Bytes)
    (hl : 200 ≤ status) (hu : status ≤ 999) (hr : asciiReason reason) :
    readHead .start [] (encodedHead status reason n tail) = readHead (.fields status {length := some n}) [] tail := by
  unfold encodedHead
  rw [readHeadLine _ _ _ (statusLineClean status reason hr), statusStep status reason hl hu]
  change readHead (.fields status {}) []
    (lengthLine n ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ (bytes "Connection: close" ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ tail)))) = _
  rw [readHeadLine _ _ _ (lengthLineClean n), lengthStep status n]
  change readHead (.fields status {length := some n}) [] (bytes "Connection: close" ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ tail)) = _
  rw [readHeadLine _ _ _ (show (bytes "Connection: close").all notCR = true from rfl),
    connectionStep]

private theorem scanBlankLine (status : Nat) (headers : Headers) (payload : Bytes) :
    readHead (.fields status headers) [] (bytes "\r\n" ++ payload) =
      .ok (status, headers, payload) := rfl

private theorem encodePlainShape (status : Nat) (reason : String) (payload : Bytes) :
    encodeHttpResp status reason [] payload =
      encodedHead status reason payload.length (bytes "\r\n" ++ payload) := by
  simp only [encodeHttpResp, LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.autoHeaderBytes, LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.hasHeader,
    LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.headerBytes, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
    encodedHead, statusLine, lengthLine, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem encodeLocationShape (status : Nat) (reason loc : String) (payload : Bytes) :
    encodeHttpResp status reason [("Location", loc)] payload =
      encodedHead status reason payload.length (locationLine loc ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ (bytes "\r\n" ++ payload))) := by
  have hlen : LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.hasHeader "Content-Length" [("Location", loc)] = false := by
    simp [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.hasHeader, LojitaCtx.FsSandbox.eqStr, LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.lower]
  have hconn : LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.hasHeader "Connection" [("Location", loc)] = false := by
    simp [LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.hasHeader, LojitaCtx.FsSandbox.eqStr, LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.lower]
  simp only [encodeHttpResp, LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.autoHeaderBytes, hlen, hconn,
    LojitaCtx.NetSandbox.headerBytes, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true,
    encodedHead, statusLine, lengthLine, locationLine, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
  rfl

private theorem framedBody (status : Nat) (location : Option String) (payload : Bytes) :
    responseBody status {length := some payload.length, location := location} payload =
      ⟨if bodyAllowed status then payload else [], none⟩ := by
  cases h : bodyAllowed status <;> simp [responseBody, h]

theorem decodePlainResponse : ∀ status reason payload, 200 ≤ status → status ≤ 999 →
    asciiReason reason →
    decodeResponse (encodeHttpResp status reason [] payload) =
      .ok ⟨status, none, ⟨if bodyAllowed status then payload else [], none⟩⟩ := by
  intro status reason payload hl hu hr
  rw [decodeResponse, encodePlainShape, scanEncodedHead _ _ _ _ hl hu hr, scanBlankLine]
  change Except.ok (⟨status, none,
    responseBody status {length := some payload.length} payload⟩ : HttpResponse) = _
  rw [framedBody]

theorem decodeLocationResponse : ∀ status reason loc payload, redirectStatus status = true →
    asciiReason reason → asciiReason loc →
    decodeResponse (encodeHttpResp status reason [("Location", loc)] payload) =
      .ok ⟨status, some (String.ofList ((loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.dropWhile
        (fun c => c == ' ') |>.reverse)), ⟨if bodyAllowed status then payload else [], none⟩⟩ := by
  intro status reason loc payload hs hr hloc
  have hmem : status ∈ [301, 302, 303, 307, 308] := by simpa only [redirectStatus, List.contains_iff_mem] using hs
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hmem
  have hl : 200 ≤ status := by omega
  have hu : status ≤ 999 := by omega
  rw [decodeResponse, encodeLocationShape, scanEncodedHead _ _ _ _ hl hu hr,
    readHeadLine _ _ _ (locationLineClean loc hloc), locationStep _ _ _ hloc]
  let locText := String.ofList ((loc.toList.dropWhile (fun c => c == ' ')).reverse.dropWhile
    (fun c => c == ' ') |>.reverse)
  change (match readHead (.fields status {length := some payload.length, location := some locText}) []
      (bytes "\r\n" ++ payload) with
    | .error msg => Except.error msg
    | .ok (status, headers, rest) => Except.ok (⟨status, headers.location, responseBody status headers rest⟩ : HttpResponse)) = _
  rw [scanBlankLine]
  change Except.ok (⟨status, some locText,
    responseBody status {length := some payload.length, location := some locText} payload⟩ : HttpResponse) = _
  rw [framedBody]

end Gen.T2.Gron.Http

import LojitaCtx.CharClass

def letterNumber (c : Char) : Bool :=
  ([(5870, 5872), (8544, 8578), (8581, 8584), (12295, 12295), (12321, 12329),
    (12344, 12346), (42726, 42735), (65856, 65908), (66369, 66369), (66378, 66378),
    (66513, 66517), (74752, 74862)] : List (Nat × Nat)).any
    (fun (low, high) => low ≤ c.toNat && c.toNat ≤ high)

def starts (c : Char) : Bool :=
  LojitaCtx.CharClass.alpha c || letterNumber c

def continues (c : Char) : Bool :=
  starts c

theorem startsLetter (c : Char) (h : LojitaCtx.CharClass.alpha c = true) :
    starts c = true := by
  simp [starts, h]

theorem startsLetterNumber (c : Char) (h : letterNumber c = true) :
    starts c = true := by
  simp [starts, h]

theorem continuesStart (c : Char) (h : starts c = true) : continues c = true := h

theorem excludesJoinControls (c : Char) (lower : 8204 ≤ c.toNat)
    (upper : c.toNat ≤ 8205) : continues c = false := by
  have code : c.toNat = 8204 ∨ c.toNat = 8205 := by omega
  rcases code with code | code
  · rw [show c = Char.ofNat 8204 from Char.toNat_inj.mp code]
    decide
  · rw [show c = Char.ofNat 8205 from Char.toNat_inj.mp code]
    decide
end Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder

def renderScalar : Scalar → String
  | .null => "null"
  | .boolean b => if b then "true" else "false"
  | .number n => n
  | .string s => quote true s

  | .array => "[]"

def jsonSpace (b : UInt8) : Bool := b == 32 || b == 9 || b == 10 || b == 13
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true

    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧

  root ++ String.intercalate "" (p.map (jsSegment alphabet))

  match a with
  | .scalar s => .scalar s
  | .array => .array []
  | .object => .object []

  | .scalar (.number s) => jsonNumber s
  | _ => True
def jsAssignment (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom) : String :=
  jsPath alphabet root p ++ " = " ++ renderAtom a ++ ";"

    (before after : String) : String :=
  jsPath alphabet root p ++ before ++ "=" ++ after ++ renderAtom a ++ ";"

inductive ReverseLine where
  | skip
  | record (assignment : Assignment)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)
inductive ValueLine where
  | skip
  | emit (value : Bytes)
  | reject

private def pathAlphabet (a : IdentifierAlphabet) : PathRead.IdentifierAlphabet :=
  ⟨a.starts, a.continues⟩

private def packSegment : Segment → PathRead.Segment
  | .key k => .key k
  | .index i => .index i

private def unpackSegment : PathRead.Segment → Segment
  | .key k => .key k
  | .index i => .index i

private def packScalar : Scalar → AtomRead.Scalar
  | .null => .null
  | .boolean b => .boolean b
  | .number n => .number n
  | .string s => .string s

private def unpackScalar : AtomRead.Scalar → Scalar
  | .null => .null
  | .boolean b => .boolean b
  | .number n => .number n
  | .string s => .string s

private def packAtom : Atom → AtomRead.Atom
  | .scalar s => .scalar (packScalar s)
  | .array => .array
  | .object => .object

private def unpackAtom : AtomRead.Atom → Atom
  | .scalar s => .scalar (unpackScalar s)
  | .array => .array
  | .object => .object

private inductive Statement where
  | record (root : String) (path : PathRead.Path) (atom : AtomRead.Atom)
  | reject (message : String)
  | badIndex (index : Int)

private def readStatement (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (line : Bytes) : Statement :=
  match PathRead.read (pathAlphabet alphabet) line with
  | .parsed root path tail =>
    match AtomRead.read tail with
    | .ok atom => .record root path atom
    | .error message => .reject message
  | .reject message => .reject message
  | .badIndex index => .badIndex index

private def observeValue : Atom → ValueLine
  | .array | .object => .skip
  | .scalar (.string s) => .emit (bytes s)
  | .scalar s => .emit (bytes (renderScalar s))

def reverseLine (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (line : Bytes) : ReverseLine :=
  if line.all jsonSpace then .skip
  else match readStatement alphabet line with
    | .record root path atom =>
      .record ⟨statementPath root (path.map unpackSegment), material (unpackAtom atom)⟩
    | .reject message => .reject message
    | .badIndex index => .badIndex index

def valueLine (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (line : Bytes) : ValueLine :=
  if line.contains 61 then
    if line.head? = some 32 then .reject
    else match readStatement alphabet line with
      | .record _ _ atom => observeValue (unpackAtom atom)
      | .reject _ | .badIndex _ => .reject
  else .skip

private theorem unpackPackedPath (p : Path) :
    (p.map packSegment).map unpackSegment = p := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s p ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, ih]
    cases s <;> rfl

private theorem packedIndexRange (p : Path)
    (h : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808) :
    ∀ i, PathRead.Segment.index i ∈ p.map packSegment → i < 9223372036854775808 := by
  intro i hi
  apply h i
  have hm : unpackSegment (PathRead.Segment.index i) ∈
      (p.map packSegment).map unpackSegment := List.mem_map.mpr ⟨_, hi, rfl⟩
  rw [unpackPackedPath] at hm
  exact hm

private theorem packedSegments (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (p : Path) :
    (p.map packSegment).map (PathRead.jsSegment (pathAlphabet alphabet)) =
      p.map (jsSegment alphabet) := by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons s p ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, ih]
    cases s <;> rfl

private theorem packedPathRender (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) :
    PathRead.jsPath (pathAlphabet alphabet) root (p.map packSegment) =
      jsPath alphabet root p := by
  simp only [PathRead.jsPath, jsPath, packedSegments]

private theorem unpackPackedAtom (a : Atom) : unpackAtom (packAtom a) = a := by
  cases a with
  | array | object => rfl
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl

private theorem packedAtomRender (a : Atom) : AtomRead.renderAtom (packAtom a) = renderAtom a := by
  cases a with
  | array | object => rfl
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl

private theorem packedAtomValid (a : Atom) : validAtom a → AtomRead.validAtom (packAtom a) := by
  cases a with
  | array | object => exact id
  | scalar s => cases s <;> exact id

private theorem bytesAppend (left right : String) :
    bytes (left ++ right) = bytes left ++ bytes right := by
  simp [bytes, String.toUTF8, String.append, ByteArray.append]

private theorem bytesOfList (cs : List Char) :
    bytes (String.ofList cs) = cs.flatMap utf8Char := by
  rw [← LojitaCtx.Utf8.encodeEq]
  rfl

private theorem nonSpaceByte (n : Nat) (hne : n ≠ 32) (hbound : n < 256) :
    UInt8.ofNat n ≠ 32 := by
  intro h
  have hn := congrArg UInt8.toNat h
  change n % 256 = 32 at hn
  exact hne ((Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hbound).symm.trans hn)

private theorem encodedCharHead (c : Char) (tail : Bytes) (hc : c ≠ ' ') :
    (utf8Char c ++ tail).head? ≠ some 32 := by
  have lead (n : Nat) (hne : n ≠ 32) (hbound : n < 256) (rest : Bytes) :
      ((UInt8.ofNat n :: rest) ++ tail).head? ≠ some 32 :=
    fun h => nonSpaceByte n hne hbound (Option.some.inj h)
  dsimp [utf8Char, String.utf8EncodeChar]
  split
  · rename_i h
    apply lead
    · intro hn
      apply hc
      change c.toNat = 32 at hn
      simpa only [hn] using (Char.ofNat_toNat c).symm
    · omega
  · split
    · apply lead <;> omega
    · split <;> apply lead <;> omega

private theorem identifierHead (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (tail : Bytes)
    (h : identifier alphabet root = true) :
    (bytes root ++ tail).head? ≠ some 32 := by
  cases hs : root.toList with
  | nil => simp [identifier, hs] at h
  | cons c cs =>
    have hc : c ≠ ' ' := by
      intro he
      simp [identifier, hs, he, startsIdentifier] at h
    have hbytes : bytes root = utf8Char c ++ cs.flatMap utf8Char := by
      calc
        bytes root = bytes (String.ofList root.toList) :=
          congrArg bytes (show String.ofList root.toList = root from String.ofList_toList).symm
        _ = _ := by rw [hs, bytesOfList] <;> rfl
    rw [hbytes, List.append_assoc]
    exact encodedCharHead c _ hc

private theorem defaultSpacing (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path)
    (a : Atom) :
    jsAssignmentWithSpaces alphabet root p a " " " " = jsAssignment alphabet root p a := by
  unfold jsAssignmentWithSpaces jsAssignment
  have hbefore : jsPath alphabet root p ++ " " ++ "=" = jsPath alphabet root p ++ " =" :=
    String.append_assoc
  have hafter : jsPath alphabet root p ++ " =" ++ " " = jsPath alphabet root p ++ " = " :=
    String.append_assoc
  rw [hbefore, hafter]

private theorem statementContainsEquals (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path)
    (a : Atom) (before after : String) (suffix : Bytes) :
    (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces alphabet root p a before after) ++ suffix).contains 61 = true := by
  simp only [jsAssignmentWithSpaces, bytesAppend, List.contains_append,
    show (bytes "=").contains 61 = true from rfl, Bool.or_true, Bool.true_or]

private theorem canonicalContainsEquals (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path)
    (a : Atom) : (bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root p a)).contains 61 = true := by
  simpa only [defaultSpacing, List.append_nil] using
    (statementContainsEquals alphabet root p a " " " " [])

private theorem nonblankOfEquals (line : Bytes) (h : line.contains 61 = true) :
    line.all jsonSpace = false := by
  cases ha : line.all jsonSpace with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    have hm : (61 : UInt8) ∈ line := by simpa using h
    have hn := (List.all_eq_true.mp ha) (61 : UInt8) hm
    exact Bool.noConfusion (show false = true from hn)

private theorem splitRendered (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom)
    (before after : String) (suffix : Bytes) :
    bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces alphabet root p a before after) ++ suffix =
      bytes (jsPath alphabet root p ++ before ++ "=") ++
        (bytes (after ++ renderAtom a ++ ";") ++ suffix) := by
  simp only [jsAssignmentWithSpaces, bytesAppend, List.append_assoc]

private theorem readRendered (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom)
    (before after : String) (suffix : Bytes) (hroot : identifier alphabet root = true)
    (hindex : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808)
    (hatom : validAtom a) (hbefore : before.toList.all (· == ' ') = true)
    (hafter : after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true) (hsuffix : suffix.contains 10 = false) :
    readStatement alphabet (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces alphabet root p a before after) ++ suffix) =
      .record root (p.map packSegment) (packAtom a) := by
  rw [splitRendered]
  have hpath := PathRead.readRendered (pathAlphabet alphabet) root (p.map packSegment) before
    (bytes (after ++ renderAtom a ++ ";") ++ suffix) hroot (packedIndexRange p hindex) hbefore
  rw [packedPathRender] at hpath
  have hvalue := AtomRead.readRendered (packAtom a) after suffix (packedAtomValid a hatom) hafter hsuffix
  rw [packedAtomRender] at hvalue
  simp only [readStatement, hpath, hvalue]

private theorem readCanonical (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom)
    (hroot : identifier alphabet root = true)
    (hindex : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808)
    (hatom : validAtom a) :
    readStatement alphabet (bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root p a)) =
      .record root (p.map packSegment) (packAtom a) := by
  simpa only [defaultSpacing, List.append_nil] using
    (readRendered alphabet root p a " " " " [] hroot hindex hatom rfl rfl rfl)

theorem reverseJSBlank (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (line : Bytes) (h : line.all jsonSpace = true) :
    reverseLine alphabet line = .skip := by
  simp [reverseLine, h]

theorem reverseJSStatement (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom)
    (before after : String) (suffix : Bytes) (hroot : identifier alphabet root = true)
    (hindex : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808)
    (hatom : validAtom a) (hbefore : before.toList.all (· == ' ') = true)
    (hafter : after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true) (hsuffix : suffix.contains 10 = false) :
    reverseLine alphabet (bytes (jsAssignmentWithSpaces alphabet root p a before after) ++ suffix) =
      .record ⟨statementPath root p, material a⟩ := by
  have hnonblank := nonblankOfEquals _ (statementContainsEquals alphabet root p a before after suffix)
  have hread := readRendered alphabet root p a before after suffix hroot hindex hatom hbefore hafter hsuffix
  simp only [reverseLine, hnonblank, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, hread, unpackPackedPath,
    unpackPackedAtom]

theorem valueNoEquals (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (line : Bytes) (h : line.contains 61 = false) :
    valueLine alphabet line = .skip := by
  simp only [valueLine, h, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]

theorem valueStatement (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root : String) (p : Path) (a : Atom)
    (hroot : identifier alphabet root = true)
    (hindex : ∀ i, Segment.index i ∈ p → i < 9223372036854775808)
    (hatom : validAtom a) :
    valueLine alphabet (bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root p a)) =
      match a with
      | .array | .object => .skip
      | .scalar (.string s) => .emit (bytes s)
      | .scalar v => .emit (bytes (renderScalar v)) := by
  have hhead : (bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root p a)).head? ≠ some 32 := by
    simp only [jsAssignment, jsPath, bytesAppend, List.append_assoc]
    exact identifierHead alphabet root _ hroot
  simp only [valueLine, if_pos (canonicalContainsEquals alphabet root p a), if_neg hhead,
    readCanonical alphabet root p a hroot hindex hatom, unpackPackedAtom, observeValue]
  cases a with
  | array | object => rfl
  | scalar s => cases s <;> rfl

theorem valueIndent (alphabet : IdentifierAlphabet) (root n : String)
    (_ : identifier alphabet root = true) (_ : jsonNumber n) :
    valueLine alphabet (bytes (" " ++ jsAssignment alphabet root [] (.scalar (.number n)))) =
      .reject := by
  rw [bytesAppend]
  change valueLine alphabet (32 :: bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root [] (.scalar (.number n)))) =
    .reject
  have he : (32 :: bytes (jsAssignment alphabet root [] (.scalar (.number n)))).contains 61 = true := by
    simp only [List.contains_cons, canonicalContainsEquals, Bool.or_true]
  rw [valueLine, if_pos he]
  rfl

end Gen.T2.Gron.Merge

def hex4 (upper : Bool) (n : Nat) : String :=
  String.ofList ([n / 4096 % 16, n / 256 % 16, n / 16 % 16, n % 16].map (hexDigit upper))
/-- Gron statement strings escape C0 and C1 controls. Reconstructed documents use JSON escaping. -/
def escapeChar (statement : Bool) (c : Char) : String :=
  match c with
  | '"' => "\\\""
  | '\\' => "\\\\"
  | '\t' => "\\t"
  | '\r' => "\\r"
  | '\n' => "\\n"
  | _ =>
    let n := c.toNat
    if n == 8 then "\\b"
    else if n == 12 then "\\f"
    else if n < 32 || n == 8232 || n == 8233 || (statement && 127 ≤ n && n ≤ 159) then
      "\\u" ++ hex4 statement n
    else String.singleton c
def escaped (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "" (s.toList.map (escapeChar statement))
def quote (statement : Bool) (s : String) : String :=
  "\"" ++ escaped statement s ++ "\""
inductive Scalar where
  | null
  | boolean (value : Bool)
  | number (lexeme : String)
  | string (value : String)
inductive Atom where
  | scalar (value : Scalar)
  | array
  | object
def renderScalar : Scalar → String
  | .null => "null"
  | .boolean b => if b then "true" else "false"
  | .number n => n
  | .string s => quote true s
def renderAtom : Atom → String
  | .scalar s => renderScalar s
  | .array => "[]"
  | .object => "{}"
def jsonDigits (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs ≠ [] ∧ ∀ c ∈ cs, c.isDigit = true
def jsonInteger (cs : List Char) : Prop :=
  cs = ['0'] ∨ ∃ c tail, cs = c :: tail ∧ 49 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 ∧
    ∀ d ∈ tail, d.isDigit = true
def jsonNumber (s : String) : Prop :=
  ∃ sign whole fraction exponent : List Char,
    s.toList = sign ++ whole ++ fraction ++ exponent ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonInteger whole ∧
    (fraction = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fraction = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds) ∧
    (exponent = [] ∨ ∃ e es ds, exponent = e :: (es ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
      (es = [] ∨ es = ['+'] ∨ es = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds)
def validAtom : Atom → Prop
  | .scalar (.number s) => jsonNumber s
  | _ => True

/-- Read the right-hand side through its terminator, preserving scalar lexemes. -/
axiom read : Bytes → Except String Atom
axiom readRendered : ∀ atom after suffix, validAtom atom →
  after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true → suffix.contains 10 = false →
  read (bytes (after ++ renderAtom atom ++ ";") ++ suffix) = .ok atom
end Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.AtomRead
