private theorem listBytes (cs : List Char) :
    bytes (String.ofList cs) = cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar := by
  change (cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar).toByteArray.data.toList = _
  simp

private def chunkChar (bs : Bytes) : Char :=
  match LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode bs with
  | [c] => if String.utf8EncodeChar c = bs then c else '\n'
  | _ => '\n'

private theorem chunkChar_encode (c : Char) :
    chunkChar (String.utf8EncodeChar c) = c := by
  have h := LojitaCtx.Utf8.decodeOfList [c]
  change LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode (bytes (String.ofList [c])) = [c] at h
  rw [listBytes] at h
  change LojitaCtx.Utf8.decode (String.utf8EncodeChar c ++ []) = [c] at h
  rw [List.append_nil] at h
  simp only [chunkChar, h, ite_true, eq_self]

private inductive UtfPending where
  | lead
  | more (remaining : Nat) (reversed : Bytes)

private def utfStep : UtfPending → UInt8 → UtfPending × Option Char
  | .lead, b =>
    let n := b.toNat
    if n < 128 then (.lead, some (Char.ofNat n))
    else if n < 224 then (.more 0 [b], none)
    else if n < 240 then (.more 1 [b], none)
    else (.more 2 [b], none)
  | .more 0 rev, b => (.lead, some (chunkChar (b :: rev).reverse))
  | .more (n + 1) rev, b => (.more n (b :: rev), none)

private def collectChar (s : UtfPending × List Char) (b : UInt8) : UtfPending × List Char :=
  let (state, next) := utfStep s.1 b
  (state, match next with
    | none => s.2
    | some c => c :: s.2)

private theorem byteValue {n : Nat} (h : n < 256) : (UInt8.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  change n % 256 = n
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h

private theorem collectEncoded (c : Char) (rev : List Char) :
    (String.utf8EncodeChar c).foldl collectChar (.lead, rev) = (.lead, c :: rev) := by
  have hchar := chunkChar_encode c
  unfold String.utf8EncodeChar at hchar ⊢
  dsimp only at hchar ⊢
  by_cases h₁ : c.val.toNat ≤ 127
  · rw [if_pos h₁]
    have hlt : c.val.toNat < 128 := by omega
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, collectChar, utfStep,
      byteValue (show c.val.toNat < 256 by omega), if_pos hlt]
    exact congrArg (fun ch => (UtfPending.lead, ch :: rev)) (Char.ofNat_toNat c)
  · rw [if_neg h₁] at hchar ⊢
    by_cases h₂ : c.val.toNat ≤ 2047
    · rw [if_pos h₂] at hchar ⊢
      have h : c.val.toNat / 64 % 32 < 32 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, collectChar, utfStep,
        byteValue (show c.val.toNat / 64 % 32 + 192 < 256 by omega),
        if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 64 % 32 + 192 < 128 by omega),
        if_pos (show c.val.toNat / 64 % 32 + 192 < 224 by omega)]
      exact congrArg (fun ch => (UtfPending.lead, ch :: rev)) hchar
    · rw [if_neg h₂] at hchar ⊢
      by_cases h₃ : c.val.toNat ≤ 65535
      · rw [if_pos h₃] at hchar ⊢
        have h : c.val.toNat / 4096 % 16 < 16 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
        simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, collectChar, utfStep,
          byteValue (show c.val.toNat / 4096 % 16 + 224 < 256 by omega),
          if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 4096 % 16 + 224 < 128 by omega),
          if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 4096 % 16 + 224 < 224 by omega),
          if_pos (show c.val.toNat / 4096 % 16 + 224 < 240 by omega)]
        exact congrArg (fun ch => (UtfPending.lead, ch :: rev)) hchar
      · rw [if_neg h₃] at hchar ⊢
        have h : c.val.toNat / 262144 % 8 < 8 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
        simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, collectChar, utfStep,
          byteValue (show c.val.toNat / 262144 % 8 + 240 < 256 by omega),
          if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 262144 % 8 + 240 < 128 by omega),
          if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 262144 % 8 + 240 < 224 by omega),
          if_neg (show ¬ c.val.toNat / 262144 % 8 + 240 < 240 by omega)]
        exact congrArg (fun ch => (UtfPending.lead, ch :: rev)) hchar

private theorem collectPrefix (cs : List Char) (rev : List Char) :
    (cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar).foldl collectChar (.lead, rev) =
      (.lead, cs.reverseAux rev) := by
  induction cs generalizing rev with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    change ((String.utf8EncodeChar c ++ cs.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar).foldl
      collectChar (.lead, rev)) = _
    rw [List.foldl_append, collectEncoded]
    exact ih (c :: rev)

private theorem collectAppend (bs : Bytes) (state : UtfPending) (left right : List Char) :
    bs.foldl collectChar (state, left ++ right) =
      let result := bs.foldl collectChar (state, left)
      (result.1, result.2 ++ right) := by
  induction bs generalizing state left with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b bs ih =>
    cases next : utfStep state b with
    | mk state' ch =>
      cases ch with
      | none =>
        simpa only [List.foldl_cons, collectChar, next] using ih state' left
      | some c =>
        simpa only [List.foldl_cons, collectChar, next, List.cons_append] using ih state' (c :: left)

private def rhsChars (bs : Bytes) : List Char :=
  (bs.foldl collectChar (.lead, [])).2.reverse

private theorem rhsChars_prefix (front : String) (suffix : Bytes) :
    rhsChars (bytes front ++ suffix) = front.toList ++ rhsChars suffix := by
  have h : bytes front = front.toList.flatMap String.utf8EncodeChar := by
    conv => lhs; rw [← String.ofList_toList (s := front)]
    exact listBytes _
  rw [h]
  simp only [rhsChars, List.foldl_append, collectPrefix]
  rw [List.reverseAux_eq, List.append_nil, ← List.nil_append front.toList.reverse, collectAppend]
  simp
end Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.AtomRead

private def skipExpSign : List Char → List Char
  | c :: cs => if c = '+' ∨ c = '-' then cs else c :: cs
  | [] => []

private def digitsOk (cs : List Char) : Bool :=
  !cs.isEmpty && cs.all Char.isDigit

private def exponentOk : List Char → Bool
  | [] => true
  | e :: cs =>
    if e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E' then digitsOk (skipExpSign cs) else false

private def fractionOk : List Char → Bool
  | c :: cs =>
    if c = '.' then
      match cs with
      | [] => false
      | digit :: ds => digit.isDigit && exponentOk (ds.dropWhile Char.isDigit)
    else exponentOk (c :: cs)
  | [] => true

private def integerOk : List Char → Bool
  | [] => false
  | c :: cs =>
    if c = '0' then fractionOk cs
    else c.isDigit && fractionOk (cs.dropWhile Char.isDigit)

private def numberOk : List Char → Bool
  | [] => false
  | c :: cs => integerOk (if c = '-' then cs else c :: cs)

private theorem digitBounds (c : Char) : c.isDigit = true ↔ 48 ≤ c.toNat ∧ c.toNat ≤ 57 := by
  change (decide (48 ≤ c.toNat) && decide (c.toNat ≤ 57)) = true ↔ _
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]

private theorem digitNe {c d : Char} (hc : c.isDigit = true) (hd : d.isDigit = false) :
    c ≠ d := fun h => by
  rw [h, hd] at hc
  cases hc

private theorem dropAll {p : Char → Bool} (cs rest : List Char) (h : ∀ c ∈ cs, p c = true) :
    (cs ++ rest).dropWhile p = rest.dropWhile p := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    have hc := h c (List.mem_cons_self)
    have hcs (d : Char) (hd : d ∈ cs) := h d (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hd))
    simpa only [List.cons_append, List.dropWhile_cons, hc, if_true] using ih hcs

private theorem exponentDigits (ds : List Char) (h : jsonDigits ds) :
    digitsOk ds = true ∧ skipExpSign ds = ds := by
  cases ds with
  | nil => exact (h.1 rfl).elim
  | cons d ds =>
    have hd := h.2 d (List.mem_cons_self)
    have plus := digitNe hd (d := '+') rfl
    have minus := digitNe hd (d := '-') rfl
    have all := List.all_eq_true.mpr h.2
    exact ⟨by simp [digitsOk, all], by simp [skipExpSign, plus, minus]⟩

private def Exponent (es : List Char) : Prop :=
  es = [] ∨ ∃ e sign ds, es = e :: (sign ++ ds) ∧ (e = 'e' ∨ e = 'E') ∧
    (sign = [] ∨ sign = ['+'] ∨ sign = ['-']) ∧ jsonDigits ds

private theorem exponentValid (cs : List Char) (h : Exponent cs) :
    exponentOk cs = true ∧ cs.dropWhile Char.isDigit = cs ∧ fractionOk cs = true := by
  rcases h with rfl | ⟨e, sign, ds, rfl, he, hsign, hd⟩
  · exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  have hds := exponentDigits ds hd
  have hsign' : skipExpSign (sign ++ ds) = ds := by
    rcases hsign with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hds.2
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have hdot : e ≠ '.' := by
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> decide
  have hdigit : e.isDigit = false := by
    rcases he with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  have hok : exponentOk (e :: (sign ++ ds)) = true := by
    simp only [exponentOk, if_pos he, hsign', hds.1]
  exact ⟨hok, by simp [List.dropWhile_cons, hdigit],
    by simpa only [fractionOk, if_neg hdot] using hok⟩

private def Fraction (fs : List Char) : Prop :=
  fs = [] ∨ ∃ ds, fs = '.' :: ds ∧ jsonDigits ds

private theorem fractionValid (fs es : List Char) (hf : Fraction fs) (he : Exponent es) :
    fractionOk (fs ++ es) = true ∧
    (fs ++ es).dropWhile Char.isDigit = fs ++ es := by
  have hexp := exponentValid es he
  rcases hf with rfl | ⟨ds, rfl, hd⟩
  · exact ⟨hexp.2.2, hexp.2.1⟩
  cases ds with
  | nil => exact (hd.1 rfl).elim
  | cons d ds =>
    have hds (x : Char) (hx : x ∈ ds) := hd.2 x (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hx))
    have hdrop := (dropAll ds es hds).trans hexp.2.1
    simp [List.cons_append, fractionOk, hd.2 d List.mem_cons_self, hdrop, hexp.1, List.dropWhile_cons]

private theorem numberValid (s : String) (h : jsonNumber s) : numberOk s.toList = true := by
  obtain ⟨sign, whole, fs, es, hlist, hsign, hw, hf, he⟩ := h
  have hrest := fractionValid fs es hf he
  have hint : integerOk (whole ++ (fs ++ es)) = true := by
    rcases hw with rfl | ⟨c, cs, rfl, hlo, hhi, hd⟩
    · exact hrest.1
    · have hc := (digitBounds c).mpr ⟨by omega, hhi⟩
      have hzero : c ≠ '0' := fun eq => by
        subst c
        exact (by decide : ¬ 49 ≤ ('0' : Char).toNat) hlo
      have hdrop := (dropAll cs (fs ++ es) hd).trans hrest.2
      simp only [List.cons_append, integerOk, hzero, if_false, hc, hdrop, hrest.1, Bool.and_self]
  rw [hlist]
  simp only [List.append_assoc]
  rcases hsign with rfl | rfl
  · simp only [List.nil_append]
    rcases hw with rfl | ⟨c, cs, rfl, hlo, hhi, _⟩
    · exact hint
    · have hc := (digitBounds c).mpr ⟨by omega, hhi⟩
      simpa only [List.cons_append, numberOk, digitNe hc (d := '-') rfl, if_false] using hint
  · exact hint

private def rhsSpace (c : Char) : Bool := c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\r'

private def bareChar (c : Char) : Bool := !(rhsSpace c || c == ';')

private def finish (rest : List Char) (atom : Atom) : Except String Atom :=
  match rest.dropWhile rhsSpace with
  | ';' :: _ => .ok atom
  | _ => .error "expected ';' after value"

private def splitBare : List Char → List Char → List Char × List Char
  | [], rev => (rev.reverse, [])
  | c :: cs, rev =>
    if bareChar c then splitBare cs (c :: rev) else (rev.reverse, c :: cs)
termination_by structural cs _ => cs

private def readBare (cs : List Char) : Except String Atom :=
  let (token, rest) := splitBare cs []
  if numberOk token then finish rest (.scalar (.number (String.ofList token)))
  else match token with
    | ['n', 'u', 'l', 'l'] => finish rest (.scalar .null)
    | ['f', 'a', 'l', 's', 'e'] => finish rest (.scalar (.boolean false))
    | ['t', 'r', 'u', 'e'] => finish rest (.scalar (.boolean true))
    | ['[', ']'] => finish rest .array
    | ['{', '}'] => finish rest .object
    | _ => .error "invalid value"

private theorem splitBare_prefix (cs rest rev : List Char) (h : ∀ c ∈ cs, bareChar c = true) :
    splitBare (cs ++ ';' :: rest) rev = (rev.reverse ++ cs, ';' :: rest) := by
  induction cs generalizing rev with
  | nil => simp [splitBare, bareChar, rhsSpace]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    have hc := h c (List.mem_cons_self)
    have hcs (d : Char) (hd : d ∈ cs) := h d (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hd))
    simpa only [List.cons_append, splitBare, hc, if_true, List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc,
      List.singleton_append, List.nil_append] using ih (c :: rev) hcs

private theorem numberChars (s : String) (h : jsonNumber s) (c : Char) (hc : c ∈ s.toList) :
    c.isDigit = true ∨ c ∈ ['-', '.', 'e', 'E', '+'] := by
  obtain ⟨sign, whole, fs, es, hlist, hsign, hw, hf, he⟩ := h
  rw [hlist] at hc
  simp only [List.mem_append] at hc
  rcases hc with ((hs | hw') | hf') | he'
  · rcases hsign with rfl | rfl
    · exact by cases hs
    · right
      simpa only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] using
        (Or.inl (List.mem_singleton.mp hs) : c = '-' ∨
          c = '.' ∨ c = 'e' ∨ c = 'E' ∨ c = '+')
  · left
    rcases hw with rfl | ⟨d, ds, rfl, hlo, hhi, hall⟩
    · rcases List.mem_singleton.mp hw' with rfl
      rfl
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw' with rfl | hc'
      · exact (digitBounds c).mpr ⟨by omega, hhi⟩
      · exact hall c hc'
  · rcases hf with rfl | ⟨ds, rfl, hd⟩
    · exact by cases hf'
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf' with rfl | hc'
      · exact Or.inr (by decide)
      · exact Or.inl (hd.2 c hc')
  · rcases he with rfl | ⟨e, sign, ds, rfl, hE, hs, hd⟩
    · exact by cases he'
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp he' with rfl | he'
      · rcases hE with rfl | rfl
        · exact Or.inr (by decide)
        · exact Or.inr (by decide)
      · rcases List.mem_append.mp he' with hs' | hd'
        · rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl
          · exact by cases hs'
          · rcases List.mem_singleton.mp hs' with rfl
            exact Or.inr (by decide)
          · rcases List.mem_singleton.mp hs' with rfl
            exact Or.inr (by decide)
        · exact Or.inl (hd.2 c hd')

private theorem numberCharProps {c : Char} (h : c.isDigit = true ∨ c ∈ ['-', '.', 'e', 'E', '+']) :
    rhsSpace c = false ∧ bareChar c = true ∧ c ≠ '"' := by
  rcases h with hd | hp
  · have space := digitNe hd (d := ' ') rfl
    have tab := digitNe hd (d := '\t') rfl
    have cr := digitNe hd (d := '\r') rfl
    have semi := digitNe hd (d := ';') rfl
    exact ⟨by simp [rhsSpace, space, tab, cr], by simp [bareChar, rhsSpace, space, tab, cr, semi],
      digitNe hd (d := '"') rfl⟩
  · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

private def shortEscape : Char → Option Char
  | '"' => some '"'
  | '\\' => some '\\'
  | '/' => some '/'
  | 'b' => some (Char.ofNat 8)
  | 'f' => some (Char.ofNat 12)
  | 'n' => some '\n'
  | 'r' => some '\r'
  | 't' => some '\t'
  | _ => none

private def hexValue (c : Char) : Option Nat :=
  let n := c.toNat
  if 48 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 57 then some (n - 48)
  else if 65 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 70 then some (n - 55)
  else if 97 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 102 then some (n - 87)
  else none

private inductive QuoteState where
  | text
  | escaped
  | hex (remaining : Nat) (value : Nat) (highSurrogate : Option Nat)
  | surrogateSlash (highSurrogate : Nat)
  | surrogateU (highSurrogate : Nat)

private def scanQuoted : List Char → QuoteState → List Char → Except String (String × List Char)
  | [], _, _ => .error "unterminated string"
  | c :: cs, state, rev =>
    match state with
    | .text =>
      if c = '"' then .ok (String.ofList rev.reverse, cs)
      else if c = '\\' then scanQuoted cs .escaped rev
      else if c.toNat < 32 then .error "unescaped control character"
      else scanQuoted cs .text (c :: rev)
    | .escaped =>
      if c = 'u' then scanQuoted cs (.hex 3 0 none) rev
      else
        match shortEscape c with
        | some d => scanQuoted cs .text (d :: rev)
        | none => .error "invalid string escape"
    | .hex remaining value high =>
      match hexValue c with
      | none => .error "invalid hexadecimal digit"
      | some nibble =>
        let n := 16 * value + nibble
        match remaining with
        | remaining + 1 => scanQuoted cs (.hex remaining n high) rev
        | 0 =>
          match high with
          | none =>
            if 55296 ≤ n ∧ n < 56320 then scanQuoted cs (.surrogateSlash n) rev
            else if 56320 ≤ n ∧ n < 57344 then .error "unpaired Unicode surrogate"
            else scanQuoted cs .text (Char.ofNat n :: rev)
          | some upper =>
            if 56320 ≤ n ∧ n < 57344 then
              let scalar := 65536 + (upper - 55296) * 1024 + (n - 56320)
              scanQuoted cs .text (Char.ofNat scalar :: rev)
            else .error "invalid Unicode surrogate pair"
    | .surrogateSlash upper =>
      if c = '\\' then scanQuoted cs (.surrogateU upper) rev
      else .error "missing low Unicode surrogate"
    | .surrogateU upper =>
      if c = 'u' then scanQuoted cs (.hex 3 0 (some upper)) rev
      else .error "missing low Unicode surrogate"
termination_by structural cs _ _ => cs

private theorem smallChar {n : Nat} (hn : n < 128) : (Char.ofNat n).toNat = n := by
  have hv : n.isValidChar := Or.inl (by omega)
  simp only [Char.ofNat, Char.ofNatAux, Char.toNat, hv, dif_pos]
  rfl

private theorem hexDigitValue (n : Nat) (hn : n < 16) :
    hexValue (hexDigit true n) = some n := by
  by_cases h : n < 10
  · have hval := smallChar (show 48 + n < 128 by omega)
    have hr : 48 ≤ 48 + n ∧ 48 + n ≤ 57 := by omega
    simp only [hexDigit, if_pos h, hexValue, hval, if_pos hr]
    exact congrArg some (by omega)
  · have hval := smallChar (show 55 + n < 128 by omega)
    have hr : 65 ≤ 55 + n ∧ 55 + n ≤ 70 := by omega
    have hnot : ¬ (48 ≤ 55 + n ∧ 55 + n ≤ 57) := by omega
    simp only [hexDigit, if_neg h, if_pos True.intro, hexValue, hval, if_neg hnot, if_pos hr]
    exact congrArg some (by omega)

private theorem joinHex (n : Nat) (h : n < 65536) :
    16 * (16 * (16 * (n / 4096 % 16) + n / 256 % 16) + n / 16 % 16) + n % 16 = n := by
  omega

private theorem scanHexEscape (n : Nat) (h : n < 55296) (rest rev : List Char) :
    scanQuoted (("\\u" ++ hex4 true n).toList ++ rest) .text rev =
      scanQuoted rest .text (Char.ofNat n :: rev) := by
  rw [String.toList_append]
  change scanQuoted ('\\' :: 'u' :: ((hex4 true n).toList ++ rest)) .text rev = _
  have hhi : ¬ (55296 ≤ n ∧ n < 56320) := by omega
  have hlo : ¬ (56320 ≤ n ∧ n < 57344) := by omega
  simp only [hex4, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, String.toList_ofList, List.cons_append,
    List.nil_append, scanQuoted, eq_self, if_true, if_neg (by decide : ('\\' : Char) ≠ '"'),
    hexDigitValue _ (Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)), Nat.mul_zero, Nat.zero_add, joinHex n (by omega),
    if_neg hhi, if_neg hlo]

private theorem scanOne (c : Char) (rest rev : List Char) :
    scanQuoted ((escapeChar true c).toList ++ rest) .text rev =
      scanQuoted rest .text (c :: rev) := by
  unfold escapeChar
  split
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rename_i nquote nslash ntab ncr nlf
    dsimp only
    split
    · rename_i h
      have hvalue : c.toNat = 8 := beq_iff_eq.mp h
      have hc := (congrArg Char.ofNat hvalue).symm.trans (Char.ofNat_toNat c)
      exact congrArg (fun x => scanQuoted rest .text (x :: rev)) hc
    · split
      · rename_i h
        have hvalue : c.toNat = 12 := beq_iff_eq.mp h
        have hc := (congrArg Char.ofNat hvalue).symm.trans (Char.ofNat_toNat c)
        exact congrArg (fun x => scanQuoted rest .text (x :: rev)) hc
      · split
        · rename_i h
          have hn : c.toNat < 55296 := by
            simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true, Bool.true_and, beq_iff_eq,
              decide_eq_true_eq] at h
            omega
          rw [scanHexEscape _ hn, Char.ofNat_toNat]
        · rename_i h
          have hn : ¬ c.toNat < 32 := by
            intro hlt
            apply h
            simp [hlt]
          simp only [String.toList_singleton, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, scanQuoted,
            if_neg nquote, if_neg nslash, if_neg hn]

private theorem escapedChars (s : String) :
    (escaped true s).toList = s.toList.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList) := by
  simp only [escaped, String.toList_intercalate, String.toList_empty, List.map_map,
    Function.comp_def, List.flatMap, List.intercalate]
  generalize s.toList.map (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList) = parts
  induction parts with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons part parts ih =>
    cases parts with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons next parts =>
      simpa [List.intersperse, List.flatten] using congrArg (part ++ ·) ih

private theorem scanContent (cs rest rev : List Char) :
    scanQuoted (cs.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList) ++ '"' :: rest) .text rev =
      .ok (String.ofList (rev.reverse ++ cs), rest) := by
  induction cs generalizing rev with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.flatMap_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil, scanQuoted, eq_self, if_true]
  | cons c cs ih =>
    change scanQuoted (((escapeChar true c).toList ++
      cs.flatMap (fun d => (escapeChar true d).toList)) ++ '"' :: rest) .text rev = _
    rw [List.append_assoc, scanOne, ih]
    simp [List.reverse_cons, List.append_assoc]

private def readValue : List Char → Except String Atom
  | [] => .error "expected value"
  | c :: cs =>
    if c = '"' then do
      let (value, rest) ← scanQuoted cs .text []
      finish rest (.scalar (.string value))
    else readBare (c :: cs)

/-- Read the right-hand side through its terminator, preserving scalar lexemes. -/
def read (input : Bytes) : Except String Atom :=
  readValue ((rhsChars input).dropWhile rhsSpace)

private theorem readNumber_rendered (s : String) (rest : List Char) (h : jsonNumber s) :
    readValue ((s.toList ++ ';' :: rest).dropWhile rhsSpace) =
      .ok (.scalar (.number s)) := by
  have hn := numberValid s h
  have props (c : Char) (hc : c ∈ s.toList) := numberCharProps (numberChars s h c hc)
  have hsplit := splitBare_prefix s.toList rest [] (fun c hc => (props c hc).2.1)
  have hbare : readBare (s.toList ++ ';' :: rest) = .ok (.scalar (.number s)) := by
    simp only [readBare, hsplit, List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, hn, if_true,
      String.ofList_toList]
    rfl
  cases hcs : s.toList with
  | nil =>
    rw [hcs] at hn
    cases hn
  | cons c cs =>
    have hm : c ∈ s.toList := by
      rw [hcs]
      exact List.mem_cons_self
    have hs := props c hm
    simpa only [hcs, List.cons_append, List.dropWhile_cons, hs.1, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
      readValue, if_neg hs.2.2] using hbare

private theorem readString_rendered (s : String) (rest : List Char) :
    readValue (((quote true s).toList ++ ';' :: rest).dropWhile rhsSpace) =
      .ok (.scalar (.string s)) := by
  simp only [quote, String.toList_append, escapedChars, List.append_assoc]
  let encoded := s.toList.flatMap (fun c => (escapeChar true c).toList)
  change (do
    let (value, afterQuote) ← scanQuoted (encoded ++ '"' :: ';' :: rest) .text []
    finish afterQuote (.scalar (.string value))) = _
  have h := scanContent s.toList (';' :: rest) []
  simp only [List.reverse_nil, List.nil_append, String.ofList_toList] at h
  change scanQuoted (encoded ++ '"' :: ';' :: rest) .text [] = _ at h
  rw [h]
  rfl

private theorem readToken_rendered (atom : Atom) (rest : List Char) (h : validAtom atom) :
    readValue (((renderAtom atom).toList ++ ';' :: rest).dropWhile rhsSpace) = .ok atom := by
  cases atom with
  | array => rfl
  | object => rfl
  | scalar atom =>
    cases atom with
    | null => rfl
    | boolean b => cases b <;> rfl
    | number s => exact readNumber_rendered s rest h
    | string s => exact readString_rendered s rest

theorem readRendered (atom : Atom) (after : String) (suffix : Bytes) (valid : validAtom atom)
    (spaces : after.toList.all (· == ' ') = true) (_ : suffix.contains 10 = false) :
    read (bytes (after ++ renderAtom atom ++ ";") ++ suffix) = .ok atom := by
  have afterSpace (c : Char) (hc : c ∈ after.toList) : rhsSpace c = true := by
    have eq : c = ' ' := beq_iff_eq.mp (List.all_eq_true.mp spaces c hc)
    subst c
    rfl
  simp only [read, rhsChars_prefix, String.toList_append, List.append_assoc]
  change readValue ((after.toList ++ ((renderAtom atom).toList ++ ';' :: rhsChars suffix)).dropWhile
    rhsSpace) = _
  rw [dropAll _ _ afterSpace]
  exact readToken_rendered atom _ valid

private theorem escapedSurrogateAndSemicolon :
    read (bytes " \"a;\\\"\\uD83D\\uDE00\\/\";") = .ok (.scalar (.string "a;\"😀/")) := rfl

private theorem trailingInvalidBytes :
    read (bytes "-1.25E+03;" ++ [255, 128]) = .ok (.scalar (.number "-1.25E+03")) := rfl

private theorem leadingZero : read (bytes "01;") = .error "invalid value" := rfl

private theorem missingTerminator :
    read (bytes "\"abc\"") = .error "expected ';' after value" := rfl
end Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.AtomRead

private theorem test' (n : Nat) (h : n < 256) : (UInt8.ofNat n).toNat = n := by rw [UInt8.toNat_ofNat, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt h]

import LojitaCtx.World

namespace Gen.T2.Gron.Values

open LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open LojitaCtx.PosixChannel (evalScanner)
open LojitaCtx.PosixChannel (runScannerFrom)

def stripCR (line : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  if line.getLast? == some 13 then line.dropLast else line

def valuesLimit : Nat := 65536

structure ValueScan where
  rev : Bytes
  size : Nat

def valuesScanner : ByteScanner ValueScan (Option (Except Unit Bytes)) where
  init := ⟨[], 0⟩
  onByte s b :=
    if b = 10 then
      .done (some (.ok (stripCR s.rev.reverse)))
    else
      let size := s.size + 1
      if valuesLimit ≤ size then .done (some (.error ()))
      else .more ⟨b :: s.rev, size⟩
  onEOF s :=
    if s.rev.isEmpty then none else some (.ok (stripCR s.rev.reverse))

def valuesInput (ch : InChan) : ReadOutcome (Option (Except Unit Bytes)) × InChan :=
  evalScanner valuesScanner ch

private theorem runShortPrefix (line tail rev : Bytes) (n : Nat) (closed waited : Bool)
    (hNo : line.contains 10 = false) (hLen : n + line.length < valuesLimit) :
    runScannerFrom valuesScanner ⟨rev, n⟩ (line ++ tail) closed waited =
      runScannerFrom valuesScanner ⟨line.reverseAux rev, n + line.length⟩ tail closed waited := by
  induction line generalizing rev n with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b line ih =>
    have hParts : b ≠ (10 : UInt8) ∧ line.contains 10 = false := by
      simpa only [List.contains_cons, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] using hNo
    have hLength : n + (b :: line).length = (n + 1) + line.length := by
      simp only [List.length_cons]
      omega
    rw [hLength] at hLen ⊢
    have hContinue : ¬ valuesLimit ≤ n + 1 := by omega
    have hStep : valuesScanner.onByte ⟨rev, n⟩ b = .more ⟨b :: rev, n + 1⟩ := by
      simp [valuesScanner, hParts.1, hContinue]
    rw [List.cons_append, runScannerFrom, hStep]
    exact ih (b :: rev) (n + 1) hParts.2 hLen

private theorem valuesInput_prefix (line tail : Bytes) (closed waited : Bool)
    (hNo : line.contains 10 = false) (hLen : line.length < valuesLimit) :
    valuesInput ⟨line ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ =
      runScannerFrom valuesScanner ⟨line.reverse, line.length⟩ tail closed waited := by
  change runScannerFrom valuesScanner ⟨[], 0⟩ (line ++ tail) closed waited =
    runScannerFrom valuesScanner ⟨line.reverse, line.length⟩ tail closed waited
  simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using
    runShortPrefix line tail [] 0 closed waited hNo (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hLen)

theorem valuesNewline : ∀ line tail closed waited,
    line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
    valuesInput ⟨line ++ (10 :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
      (.emit (some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) := by
  intro line tail closed waited hNo hLen
  rw [valuesInput_prefix line (10 :: tail) closed waited hNo hLen, runScannerFrom]
  simp [valuesScanner]

theorem valuesTooLong : ∀ headBytes tail closed waited,
    headBytes.contains 10 = false → headBytes.length = valuesLimit →
    valuesInput ⟨headBytes ++ tail, closed, waited⟩ =
      (.emit (some (.error ())), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩) := by
  intro headBytes tail closed waited hNo hLen
  have hSplit : ∃ pre last, headBytes = pre ++ [last] := by
    cases hRev : headBytes.reverse with
    | nil =>
      have hNil : headBytes = [] := by
        simpa only [List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_nil] using congrArg List.reverse hRev
      have hPos : 0 < valuesLimit := by decide
      simp only [hNil, List.length_nil] at hLen
      omega
    | cons last rev =>
      refine ⟨rev.reverse, last, ?_⟩
      simpa only [List.reverse_reverse, List.reverse_cons] using congrArg List.reverse hRev
  obtain ⟨pre, last, rfl⟩ := hSplit
  have hParts : pre.contains 10 = false ∧ last ≠ (10 : UInt8) := by
    simpa only [List.contains_append, List.contains_cons, List.contains_nil,
      Bool.or_false, Bool.or_eq_false_iff, beq_eq_false_iff_ne] using hNo
  have hAtLimit : pre.length + 1 = valuesLimit := by simpa using hLen
  have hUnderLimit : pre.length < valuesLimit := by omega
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  change valuesInput ⟨pre ++ (last :: tail), closed, waited⟩ =
    (.emit (some (.error ())), ⟨tail, closed, waited⟩)
  rw [valuesInput_prefix pre (last :: tail) closed waited hParts.1 hUnderLimit, runScannerFrom]
  simp [valuesScanner, hParts.2, hAtLimit]

theorem valuesOpen : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
    valuesInput ⟨line, false, waited⟩ = (.wouldBlock, ⟨[], false, true⟩) := by
  intro line waited hNo hLen
  simpa only [List.append_nil, runScannerFrom] using
    valuesInput_prefix line [] false waited hNo hLen

theorem valuesEnd : ∀ line waited, line.contains 10 = false → line.length < valuesLimit →
    valuesInput ⟨line, true, waited⟩ =
      (.ended (if line.isEmpty then none else some (.ok (stripCR line))), ⟨[], true, waited⟩) := by
  intro line waited hNo hLen
  have hPrefix := valuesInput_prefix line [] true waited hNo hLen
  rw [List.append_nil] at hPrefix
  rw [hPrefix, runScannerFrom]
  simp [valuesScanner]

structure Written where

  stderr : Bytes := []

inductive Phase where

  | stream (style : Style) (index : Nat) (scanner : Bytes)
  | reverse (config : Config) (environment : Environment) (format : StatementFormat) (reverseBytes : Bytes)
  | values (scanner : ValueScan)
  | stopped (status : Fin 7)
structure Change where
  next : Phase
  written : Written
def unchanged (p : Phase) : Change := ⟨p, {}⟩
def stop (o : Observation) : Change := ⟨.stopped o.status, ⟨o.stdout, o.stderr⟩⟩
def result (p : Phase) : Sum Phase ExitCode :=
  match p with
  | .stopped n => .inr n.val
  | _ => .inl p
def finishInput (c : Config) (e : Environment) (i : ByteInput) : Change :=
  stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T2.Gron.executeBytes c.invocation e i))
def stdinStart (c : Config) (e : Environment) : Change :=
  match c.command with
  | .forwardOne => unchanged (.one c.style Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.init)
  | .forwardLines =>
    ⟨.stream c.style 0 LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamStart c.style, []⟩⟩
  | .ungron =>
    let format := if (optionsOf c.invocation).json then .json else .javascript
    unchanged (.reverse c e format [])
  | .values => unchanged (.values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init)
  | _ => finishInput c e (.one [])
def oneReply (s : Style) (decoded : Except String Json) : Change :=
  stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T1.Gron.forwardOne s decoded))
def streamReply (s : Style) (i : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeJson (Gen.T2.Gron.linePayload line) with
  | .ok j =>
    let p := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .stream s (i + 1) LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init
    ⟨p, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamValue s i j, []⟩⟩
  | .error reason =>
    stop ⟨3, [], bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.streamError (.decode reason) ++ "\n")⟩
def valuesReply (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match token with
  | none | some (.error _) => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some (.ok line) =>
    let p := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init
    match Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line with
    | .skip => unchanged p
    | .emit v => ⟨p, ⟨v ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private def scannedLine (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeJson (Decode.payload line) with
  | .ok j =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .stream style (index + 1) LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init
    ⟨next, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamValue style index j, []⟩⟩
  | .error reason =>
    stop ⟨3, [], bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.streamError (.decode reason) ++ "\n")⟩

private theorem scannedLineRule (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedLine style index line atEOF = streamReply style index line atEOF := by
  unfold scannedLine
  rw [Decode.payloadRule]
  rfl

private def scannedValue (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match token with
  | none | some (.error _) => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some (.ok line) =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init
    match Merge.valueLine KeyOrder.starts KeyOrder.continues line with
    | .skip => unchanged next
    | .emit value => ⟨next, ⟨value ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private theorem scannedValueRule (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedValue token atEOF = valuesReply token atEOF := by
  rcases token with _ | (_ | line)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have starts : KeyOrder.starts = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts := funext KeyOrder.startsRule
    have continues : KeyOrder.continues = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues := funext KeyOrder.continuesRule
    rw [scannedValue, valuesReply, Merge.valueLineRule, starts, continues]
    generalize h : Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine
      ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts, Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues⟩ line = parsed
    have equivalent : Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line =
        match parsed with
        | .skip => .skip
        | .emit value => .emit value
        | .reject => .reject := by
      rw [← h]
      rfl
    rw [equivalent]
    cases parsed <;> rfl

def byteChange : Phase → Byte → Change
  | .one style scan, b =>
    match Decode.advance Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner scan b with
    | .pending s => unchanged (.one style s)
    | .ready decoded => oneReply style decoded
  | .stream style index scan, b =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onByte scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
    | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | .done (some line) => scannedLine style index line false
  | .reverse c e format rev, b => unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev))
  | .values scan, b =>
    match Values.advance scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
    | .done token => scannedValue token false
  | .stopped code, _ => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem byteOne : ∀ style scan b, byteChange (.one style scan) b =
  match Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.one style s)
  | .done decoded => oneReply style decoded := by
  intro style scan b
  rw [byteChange, Decode.advanceRule]
  cases Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onByte scan b <;> rfl
theorem byteStream : ∀ style index scan b, byteChange (.stream style index scan) b =
  match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
  | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | .done (some line) => streamReply style index line false := by
  intro style index scan b
  simp only [byteChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem byteReverse : ∀ c e format rev b, byteChange (.reverse c e format rev) b =
  unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev)) := fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem byteValues : ∀ scan b, byteChange (.values scan) b =
  match Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
  | .done token => valuesReply token false := by
  intro scan b
  simp only [byteChange, Values.advanceRule, scannedValueRule]
theorem byteStopped : ∀ code b, byteChange (.stopped code) b = unchanged (.stopped code) :=
  fun _ _ => rfl

def eofChange : Phase → Change
  | .one style scan => oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan)
  | .stream style index scan =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
    | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | some line => scannedLine style index line true
  | .reverse c e format rev => finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse)
  | .values scan => scannedValue (Values.finish scan) true
  | .stopped code => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem eofOne : ∀ style scan, eofChange (.one style scan) =
  oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan) := fun _ _ => rfl
theorem eofStream : ∀ style index scan, eofChange (.stream style index scan) =
  match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
  | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some line => streamReply style index line true := by
  intro style index scan
  simp only [eofChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem eofReverse : ∀ c e format rev, eofChange (.reverse c e format rev) =
  finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse) := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem eofValues : ∀ scan, eofChange (.values scan) =
  valuesReply (Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onEOF scan) true := by
  intro scan
  simp only [eofChange, Values.finishRule, scannedValueRule]
theorem eofStopped : ∀ code, eofChange (.stopped code) = unchanged (.stopped code) :=
  fun _ => rfl

private def finished : Phase → Bool
  | .stopped _ => true
  | _ => false

private def Written.pushReversed (acc output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverseAux acc.stdout, output.stderr.reverseAux acc.stderr⟩
private def Written.reverse (output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverse, output.stderr.reverse⟩

private theorem writtenReversePush (acc output : Written) :
    (acc.pushReversed output).reverse = acc.reverse.append output := by
  simp only [Written.pushReversed, Written.reverse, Written.append, List.reverseAux_eq,
    List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse]

private theorem writtenReverseEmpty : ({} : Written).reverse = {} := rfl

private theorem writtenEmptyAppend (output : Written) : ({} : Written).append output = output :=
  rfl

private theorem writtenAppendAssoc (a b c : Written) :
    (a.append b).append c = a.append (b.append c) := by
  simp only [Written.append, List.append_assoc]

private def chunkFrom (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) : Bytes → Change
  | [] => ⟨phase, rev.reverse⟩
  | b :: bs =>
    let first := byteChange phase b
    let nextRev := rev.pushReversed first.written
    if finished first.next then ⟨first.next, nextRev.reverse⟩
    else chunkFrom first.next nextRev bs
termination_by structural bs => bs

private theorem chunkFromPrefix (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase rev bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, rev.reverse.append later.written⟩ := by
  induction bs generalizing phase rev with
  | nil => simp only [chunkFrom, Written.append, Written.reverse, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [chunkFrom]
    dsimp only
    split
    · simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]
    · rw [ih (byteChange phase b).next (rev.pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written),
        ih (byteChange phase b).next (({} : Written).pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written)]
      simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend, writtenAppendAssoc]

private theorem chunkFromInitial (phase : Phase) (output : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, output.append later.written⟩ := by
  simpa only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend] using
    chunkFromPrefix phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs

def chunkChange (phase : Phase) (bs : Bytes) : Change := chunkFrom phase {} bs
theorem chunkEmpty : ∀ phase, chunkChange phase [] = unchanged phase := fun _ => rfl
theorem chunkCons : ∀ phase b bs, chunkChange phase (b :: bs) =
  let first := byteChange phase b
  match first.next with
  | .stopped _ => first
  | _ =>
    let later := chunkChange first.next bs
    ⟨later.next, first.written.append later.written⟩ := by
  intro phase b bs
  unfold chunkChange
  rw [chunkFrom]
  dsimp only
  generalize byteChange phase b = first
  obtain ⟨next, output⟩ := first
  cases next <;> simp only [finished, if_true, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true, chunkFromInitial,
    writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]

def envFile (c : Config) (e : Environment) (path : String) (read : Sum FsError Bytes) : Change :=
  match read with
  | .inl error =>
    let input := Gen.T2.Gron.acquiredFile path error
    match input with
    | .readError _ =>
      if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e else finishInput c e input
    | _ => finishInput c e input
  | .inr data =>
    if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
    else finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) data)
theorem permissionReadResult : ∀ c e path,
  envFile c e path (.inl .fsPermissionDenied) =
    finishInput c e (.openError path "permission denied") := fun _ _ _ => rfl
def httpBody (c : Config) (e : Environment) (body : HttpBody) : Change :=
  if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
  else
    match body.readError with
    | none => finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) body.payload)
    | some reason =>
      match c.command with
      | .forwardOne =>
        match (Gen.T2.Gron.oneInput (openPipe body.payload)).1 with
        | .emit decoded => oneReply c.style decoded
        | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)
      | .forwardLines =>
        let rs := Gen.T2.Gron.streamRecords body.payload ++ [.error (LineError.read reason)]
        stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T1.Gron.forwardLines c.style rs))
      | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)

end Gen.T3.Gron

    match Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line with
    | .skip => unchanged p
    | .emit v => ⟨p, ⟨v ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private def scannedLine (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeJson (Decode.payload line) with
  | .ok j =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .stream style (index + 1) LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init
    ⟨next, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamValue style index j, []⟩⟩
  | .error reason =>
    stop ⟨3, [], bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.streamError (.decode reason) ++ "\n")⟩

private theorem scannedLineRule (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedLine style index line atEOF = streamReply style index line atEOF := by
  unfold scannedLine
  rw [Decode.payloadRule]
  rfl

private def scannedValue (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match token with
  | none | some (.error _) => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some (.ok line) =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init
    match Merge.valueLine KeyOrder.starts KeyOrder.continues line with
    | .skip => unchanged next
    | .emit value => ⟨next, ⟨value ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private theorem scannedValueRule (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedValue token atEOF = valuesReply token atEOF := by
  rcases token with _ | (_ | line)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have starts : KeyOrder.starts = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts := funext KeyOrder.startsRule
    have continues : KeyOrder.continues = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues := funext KeyOrder.continuesRule
    rw [scannedValue, valuesReply, Merge.valueLineRule, starts, continues]
    generalize h : Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine
      ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts, Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues⟩ line = parsed
    let convert : Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.ValueLine → Gen.T2.Gron.ValueLine
      | .skip => .skip
      | .emit value => .emit value
      | .reject => .reject
    have equivalent : Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line = convert parsed :=
      (show Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line =
        convert (Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine
          ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts, Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues⟩ line) from rfl).trans
        (congrArg convert h)
    rw [equivalent]
    cases parsed <;> rfl

def byteChange : Phase → Byte → Change
  | .one style scan, b =>
    match Decode.advance Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner scan b with
    | .pending s => unchanged (.one style s)
    | .ready decoded => oneReply style decoded
  | .stream style index scan, b =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onByte scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
    | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | .done (some line) => scannedLine style index line false
  | .reverse c e format rev, b => unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev))
  | .values scan, b =>
    match Values.advance scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
    | .done token => scannedValue token false
  | .stopped code, _ => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem byteOne : ∀ style scan b, byteChange (.one style scan) b =

  | .more s => unchanged (.one style s)
  | .done decoded => oneReply style decoded := by
  intro style scan b
  rw [byteChange, Decode.advanceRule]
  cases Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onByte scan b <;> rfl

  | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
  | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | .done (some line) => streamReply style index line false := by
  intro style index scan b
  simp only [byteChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem byteReverse : ∀ c e format rev b, byteChange (.reverse c e format rev) b =
  unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev)) := fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem byteValues : ∀ scan b, byteChange (.values scan) b =
  match Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
  | .done token => valuesReply token false := by
  intro scan b
  have step : Values.advance scan b = Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onByte scan b :=
    Values.advanceRule scan b
  simp only [byteChange, step, scannedValueRule] <;> rfl

def eofChange : Phase → Change
  | .one style scan => oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan)
  | .stream style index scan =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
    | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | some line => scannedLine style index line true
  | .reverse c e format rev => finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse)
  | .values scan => scannedValue (Values.finish scan) true
  | .stopped code => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem eofOne : ∀ style scan, eofChange (.one style scan) =
  oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan) := fun _ _ => rfl
theorem eofStream : ∀ style index scan, eofChange (.stream style index scan) =
  match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
  | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some line => streamReply style index line true := by
  intro style index scan
  simp only [eofChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem eofReverse : ∀ c e format rev, eofChange (.reverse c e format rev) =
  finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse) := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem eofValues : ∀ scan, eofChange (.values scan) =
  valuesReply (Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onEOF scan) true := by
  intro scan
  have finish : Values.finish scan = Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onEOF scan :=
    Values.finishRule scan
  simp only [eofChange, finish, scannedValueRule]
theorem eofStopped : ∀ code, eofChange (.stopped code) = unchanged (.stopped code) :=
  fun _ => rfl

private def finished : Phase → Bool
  | .stopped _ => true
  | _ => false

private def Written.pushReversed (acc output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverseAux acc.stdout, output.stderr.reverseAux acc.stderr⟩
private def Written.reverse (output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverse, output.stderr.reverse⟩

private theorem writtenReversePush (acc output : Written) :
    (acc.pushReversed output).reverse = acc.reverse.append output := by
  simp only [Written.pushReversed, Written.reverse, Written.append, List.reverseAux_eq,
    List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse]

private theorem writtenReverseEmpty : ({} : Written).reverse = {} := rfl

private theorem writtenEmptyAppend (output : Written) : ({} : Written).append output = output :=
  rfl

private theorem writtenAppendAssoc (a b c : Written) :
    (a.append b).append c = a.append (b.append c) := by
  simp only [Written.append, List.append_assoc]

private def chunkFrom (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) : Bytes → Change
  | [] => ⟨phase, rev.reverse⟩
  | b :: bs =>
    let first := byteChange phase b
    let nextRev := rev.pushReversed first.written
    if finished first.next then ⟨first.next, nextRev.reverse⟩
    else chunkFrom first.next nextRev bs
termination_by structural bs => bs

private theorem chunkFromPrefix (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase rev bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, rev.reverse.append later.written⟩ := by
  induction bs generalizing phase rev with
  | nil => simp only [chunkFrom, Written.append, Written.reverse, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [chunkFrom]
    split
    · simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]
    · rw [ih (byteChange phase b).next (rev.pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written),
        ih (byteChange phase b).next (({} : Written).pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written)]
      simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend, writtenAppendAssoc]

private theorem chunkFromInitial (phase : Phase) (output : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, output.append later.written⟩ := by
  simpa only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend] using
    chunkFromPrefix phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs

def chunkChange (phase : Phase) (bs : Bytes) : Change := chunkFrom phase {} bs
theorem chunkEmpty : ∀ phase, chunkChange phase [] = unchanged phase := fun _ => rfl
theorem chunkCons : ∀ phase b bs, chunkChange phase (b :: bs) =
  let first := byteChange phase b
  match first.next with
  | .stopped _ => first
  | _ =>
    let later := chunkChange first.next bs
    ⟨later.next, first.written.append later.written⟩ := by
  intro phase b bs
  unfold chunkChange
  rw [chunkFrom]
  dsimp only
  generalize byteChange phase b = first
  obtain ⟨next, output⟩ := first
  cases next <;> simp only [finished, if_true, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true, chunkFromInitial,
    writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]

def envFile (c : Config) (e : Environment) (path : String) (read : Sum FsError Bytes) : Change :=
  match read with
  | .inl error =>
    let input := Gen.T2.Gron.acquiredFile path error
    match input with
    | .readError _ =>
      if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e else finishInput c e input
    | _ => finishInput c e input
  | .inr data =>
    if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
    else finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) data)
theorem permissionReadResult : ∀ c e path,
  envFile c e path (.inl .fsPermissionDenied) =
    finishInput c e (.openError path "permission denied") := fun _ _ _ => rfl
def httpBody (c : Config) (e : Environment) (body : HttpBody) : Change :=
  if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
  else
    match body.readError with
    | none => finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) body.payload)
    | some reason =>
      match c.command with
      | .forwardOne =>
        match (Gen.T2.Gron.oneInput (openPipe body.payload)).1 with
        | .emit decoded => oneReply c.style decoded
        | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)
      | .forwardLines =>
        let rs := Gen.T2.Gron.streamRecords body.payload ++ [.error (LineError.read reason)]
        stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T1.Gron.forwardLines c.style rs))
      | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)

def timeSample (w : SimWorld) : Nat × SimWorld :=
  let r := LojitaCtx.Clock.readMonoMs w.clock
  (r.1, {w with clock := r.2})
def requestAt (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Sum NetError Bytes × SimWorld :=
  let req := Gen.T2.Gron.requestBytes a
  let r := evalNetExchange a.tls (a.tls && a.insecure) a.host a.port req timeout w.net
  (r.1, {w with net := r.2})
def urlTail (url : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "://" ((url.splitOn "://").drop 1)
def authorityText (url : String) : String :=
  String.ofList ((urlTail url).toList.takeWhile (fun c => c != '/' && c != '?' && c != '#'))
def stripUserInfo (url : String) : String :=
  let raw := authorityText url
  let host := (raw.splitOn "@").getLastD ""
  if raw == host then url else
    (url.splitOn "://").headD "" ++ "://" ++ host ++ String.ofList ((urlTail url).toList.drop raw.length)
def redirectReferer (prev next : HttpOrigin) : Option String :=
  if prev.tls && !next.tls then none else some (stripUserInfo prev.url)
def parseDiagnostic (url detail : String) : String :=
  "parse " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag url ++ ": " ++ detail
def invalidOrigin (url reason : String) : String :=
  match reason with
  | "missing URL host" =>
    Gen.T2.Gron.getError (String.ofList (url.toList.takeWhile (· != ':')) ++ ":")
      "http: no Host in request URL"
  | "invalid bracketed URL host" => parseDiagnostic url "missing ']' in host"
  | "invalid URL port" =>
    let authority := authorityText (stripUserInfo url)
    let portText := ":" ++ (authority.splitOn ":").getLastD ""
    parseDiagnostic url ("invalid port " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag portText ++ " after host")
  | _ => parseDiagnostic url reason
def invalidReply (a : HttpAttempt) (wire : Bytes) (reason : String) : String :=
  let detail := if reason == "malformed HTTP status line" then
    let line := (wire.takeWhile (· != 13)).takeWhile (· != 10)
    "net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response " ++
      Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag (decodeUtf8Lossy line)
  else reason
  Gen.T2.Gron.getError a.url detail
inductive Hop where
  | completed (body : Except String HttpBody)
  | redirect (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
def responseAt (a : HttpAttempt) (prev : HttpOrigin) (left : Nat) (wire : Bytes) : Hop :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeResponse wire with
  | .error why => .completed (.error (invalidReply a wire why))
  | .ok response =>
    match Gen.T2.Gron.redirectTarget response with
    | none => .completed (.ok response.body)
    | some location =>
      if left = 0 then .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError location "stopped after 10 redirects"))
      else
        match Gen.T2.Gron.resolveLocation prev location with
        | .error why =>
          .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError prev.url
            ("failed to parse Location header " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag location ++ ": " ++ why)))
        | .ok next => .redirect next (redirectReferer prev next)
def httpHop (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Hop × SimWorld :=
  let a := Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer
  let (r, w') := requestAt a timeout w
  match r with
  | .inl failure => (.completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.exchangeFailure a failure)), w')
  | .inr wire => (responseAt a origin left wire, w')
def localDeadline (origin : HttpOrigin) : String :=
  Gen.T2.Gron.getError origin.url "context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"

def afterRedirect (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Except String HttpBody × SimWorld :=
  let (now, w') := timeSample w
  if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
  else
    let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer left (deadline - now) w'
    match hop with
    | .completed r => (r, w'')
    | .redirect next nextReferer =>
      match left with
      | 0 => (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"), w'')
      | remaining + 1 => afterRedirect o next nextReferer deadline remaining w''
termination_by structural left

theorem redirectLast : ∀ o origin referer deadline w,
  afterRedirect o origin referer deadline 0 w =
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
    else
      let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer 0 (deadline - now) w'
      match hop with
      | .completed r => (r, w'')
      | .redirect next _ => (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"), w'') :=
  by
    intro o origin referer deadline w
    rw [afterRedirect.eq_def]
theorem redirectStep : ∀ o origin referer deadline left w,
  afterRedirect o origin referer deadline (left + 1) w =
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
    else
      let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer (left + 1) (deadline - now) w'
      match hop with
      | .completed r => (r, w'')
      | .redirect next nextReferer => afterRedirect o next nextReferer deadline left w'' :=
  by
    intro o origin referer deadline left w
    rw [afterRedirect.eq_def]

def httpAt (o : Options) (url : String) (w : SimWorld) : Except String HttpBody × SimWorld :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | .error reason => (.error (invalidOrigin url reason), w)
  | .ok origin =>
    let timeout := Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) timeout w'
    match hop with
    | .completed r => (r, w'')
    | .redirect next referer =>
      afterRedirect o next referer (now + timeout) (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 2) w''
def FetchCaps : List Cap := [.clockCap, .netCap]
def fetchSubCli : CapSub FetchCaps CliCaps :=
  capSubCons clockInCli (capSubCons netInCli capSubNil)

private def clockInFetch : CapMem .clockCap FetchCaps := .here
private def netSubFetch : CapSub [.netCap] FetchCaps :=
  capSubCons (.there .here) capSubNil

private def originError (url reason : String) : String :=
  match reason with
  | "missing URL host" =>
    Gen.T2.Gron.getError (String.ofList (url.toList.takeWhile (· != ':')) ++ ":")
      "http: no Host in request URL"
  | "invalid bracketed URL host" => Diagnostic.parseError url "missing ']' in host"
  | "invalid URL port" =>
    let authority := authorityText (stripUserInfo url)
    let portText := ":" ++ (authority.splitOn ":").getLastD ""
    Diagnostic.parseError url ("invalid port " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag portText ++ " after host")
  | _ => Diagnostic.parseError url reason

private theorem originErrorRule (url reason : String) :
    originError url reason = invalidOrigin url reason := by
  have same : Diagnostic.parseError url = parseDiagnostic url :=
    funext (fun detail => Diagnostic.parseErrorRule url detail)
  unfold originError invalidOrigin
  rw [same]

private def requestW (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Sum NetError Bytes) :=
  liftWorld netSubFetch
    (Http.exchange ⟨a.tls, a.insecure, a.host, a.port, a.serverName, a.tunnel, Gen.T2.Gron.requestBytes a⟩
      timeout)

private theorem requestWRun (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (requestW a timeout) w = requestAt a timeout w := by
  rw [requestW, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.liftWorldPreservesRun, Http.exchangeObserved] <;> rfl

private def httpHopW (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps Hop :=
  let a := Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer
  mapWorld (fun
    | .inl failure => .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.exchangeFailure a failure))
    | .inr wire => responseAt a origin left wire) (requestW a timeout)

private theorem httpHopWRun (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (httpHopW o origin referer left timeout) w = httpHop o origin referer left timeout w := by
  rw [httpHopW, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.mapWorldRun, requestWRun, httpHop]
  generalize requestAt (Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer) timeout w = exchanged
  obtain ⟨response, _⟩ := exchanged
  cases response <;> rfl

private theorem clockInFetchRun (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (nowMonoW clockInFetch) w = timeSample w := rfl

private def redirectW (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Except String HttpBody) :=
  worldBind (nowMonoW clockInFetch) fun now =>
    if deadline ≤ now then .pure (.error (localDeadline origin))
    else
      worldBind (httpHopW o origin referer left (deadline - now)) fun
        | .completed response => .pure response
        | .redirect next nextReferer =>
          match left with
          | 0 => .pure (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"))
          | remaining + 1 => redirectW o next nextReferer deadline remaining
termination_by structural left

private theorem redirectWRun (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (redirectW o origin referer deadline left) w = afterRedirect o origin referer deadline left w := by
  induction left generalizing origin referer w with
  | zero =>
    rw [redirectW, redirectLast, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    by_cases expired : deadline ≤ now
    · simp only [if_pos expired, runWorldPure]
    · simp only [if_neg expired, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, httpHopWRun]
      generalize httpHop o origin referer 0 (deadline - now) w' = exchanged
      obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
      cases hop <;> rfl
  | succ remaining ih =>
    rw [redirectW, redirectStep, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    by_cases expired : deadline ≤ now
    · simp only [if_pos expired, runWorldPure]
    · simp only [if_neg expired, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, httpHopWRun]
      generalize httpHop o origin referer (remaining + 1) (deadline - now) w' = exchanged
      obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
      cases hop with
      | completed r => rfl
      | redirect next nextReferer => exact ih next nextReferer w''

def fetch (o : Options) (url : String) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Except String HttpBody) :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | .error reason => .pure (.error (originError url reason))
  | .ok origin =>
    let timeout := Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs
    worldBind (nowMonoW clockInFetch) fun now =>
      worldBind (httpHopW o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) timeout) fun
        | .completed r => .pure r
        | .redirect next referer =>
          redirectW o next referer (now + timeout) (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 2)

theorem fetchObserved : ∀ o url w, runWorldPure (fetch o url) w = httpAt o url w := by
  intro o url w
  simp only [fetch, httpAt]
  cases Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | error reason => simp only [originErrorRule, runWorldPure]
  | ok origin =>
    simp only [LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun, httpHopWRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    dsimp only
    generalize httpHop o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs w' = exchanged
    obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
    cases hop with
    | completed r => rfl
    | redirect next referer => exact redirectWRun o next referer _ _ w''

theorem fetchLifted : ∀ o url w,
  runWorldPure (liftWorld fetchSubCli (fetch o url)) w = httpAt o url w := by
  intro o url w
  rw [LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.liftWorldPreservesRun, fetchObserved]

end Gen.T3.Gron

axiom valueLineRule : ∀ starts continues line,
