    match Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine ⟨starts, continues⟩ line with
    | .skip => .skip
    | .emit value => .emit value
    | .reject => .reject
end Gen.T3.Gron.Merge
import Gen.T2.Gron.Values
namespace Gen.T3.Gron.Values
open LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open Gen.T2.Gron.Values (ValueScan)
axiom advance : ValueScan → Byte → ScanDecision ValueScan (Option (Except Unit Bytes))
axiom finish : ValueScan → Option (Except Unit Bytes)
axiom advanceRule : ∀ state b, advance state b = Gen.T2.Gron.Values.valuesScanner.onByte state b
axiom finishRule : ∀ state, finish state = Gen.T2.Gron.Values.valuesScanner.onEOF state
end Gen.T3.Gron.Values
import LojitaCtx.World
namespace Gen.T3.Gron.Http
open LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
structure Request where
  tls : Bool
  insecure : Bool
  host : String
  port : Nat
  serverName : String
  tunnel : Bytes
  wire : Bytes
axiom exchange : Request → Nat → WorldProg [.netCap] (Sum NetError Bytes)
axiom exchangeObserved : ∀ request timeout w,
  runWorldPure (exchange request timeout) w =
    let r := evalNetExchange request.tls (request.tls && request.insecure)
      request.host request.port request.wire timeout w.net
    (r.1, {w with net := r.2})
end Gen.T3.Gron.Http

drafts.source:
import Gen.T2.Gron
import LojitaCtx.Cli
import LojitaCtx.PosixChannel
import LojitaCtx.WorldLaws
import LojitaCtx.ToolLaws
import LojitaCtx.HttpLaws
import Gen.T3.Gron.Diagnostic
import Gen.T3.Gron.KeyOrder
import Gen.T3.Gron.Decode
import Gen.T3.Gron.Merge
import Gen.T3.Gron.Values
import Gen.T3.Gron.Http

namespace Gen.T3.Gron
open LojitaCtx.Blueprint LojitaCtx.Terminal LojitaCtx.World
open Gen.T1.Gron (Options Invocation Command Source Style Environment Observation Json LineError)
open Gen.T2.Gron (Launch Config ByteInput StatementFormat JsonScan ValueScan HttpOrigin HttpAttempt HttpBody)

def launchPort : PortLift Launch SimWorld :=
  ⟨fun w => ⟨w.env.progName, w.env.args⟩⟩
def environmentAt (w : SimWorld) : Environment :=
  ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.alphabet, w.stdio.stdout.isTTY,
    lookupEnvVar "TERM" w.env.envVars, lookupEnvVar "NO_COLOR" w.env.envVars⟩
def configurationAt (w : SimWorld) : Config :=
  let e := environmentAt w
  Gen.T2.Gron.configure (launchPort.project w) e.stdoutIsTTY e.term e.noColor

def dispatchWorld (w : SimWorld) : Command := Gen.T2.Gron.dispatch (launchPort.project w)
theorem dispatchVertical :
  Commutes₁ launchPort (keepPort Command) (fun _ => True) Eq Gen.T2.Gron.dispatch dispatchWorld :=
  fun _ _ => rfl
theorem configuredCommand : ∀ w, (configurationAt w).command = dispatchWorld w := by
  intro w
  simp only [configurationAt, Gen.T2.Gron.configureRule, dispatchWorld]
  split <;> rfl

def optionsOf : Invocation → Options
  | .parsed o _ => o
  | _ => {}
structure Written where
  stdout : Bytes := []
  stderr : Bytes := []
def Written.append (a b : Written) : Written := ⟨a.stdout ++ b.stdout, a.stderr ++ b.stderr⟩
inductive Phase where
  | one (style : Style) (scanner : JsonScan)
  | stream (style : Style) (index : Nat) (scanner : Bytes)
  | reverse (config : Config) (environment : Environment) (format : StatementFormat) (reverseBytes : Bytes)
  | values (scanner : ValueScan)
  | stopped (status : Fin 7)
structure Change where
  next : Phase
  written : Written
def unchanged (p : Phase) : Change := ⟨p, {}⟩
def stop (o : Observation) : Change := ⟨.stopped o.status, ⟨o.stdout, o.stderr⟩⟩
def result (p : Phase) : Sum Phase ExitCode :=
  match p with
  | .stopped n => .inr n.val
  | _ => .inl p
def finishInput (c : Config) (e : Environment) (i : ByteInput) : Change :=
  stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T2.Gron.executeBytes c.invocation e i))
def stdinStart (c : Config) (e : Environment) : Change :=
  match c.command with
  | .forwardOne => unchanged (.one c.style Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.init)
  | .forwardLines =>
    ⟨.stream c.style 0 LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamStart c.style, []⟩⟩
  | .ungron =>
    let format := if (optionsOf c.invocation).json then .json else .javascript
    unchanged (.reverse c e format [])
  | .values => unchanged (.values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init)
  | _ => finishInput c e (.one [])
def oneReply (s : Style) (decoded : Except String Json) : Change :=
  stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T1.Gron.forwardOne s decoded))
def streamReply (s : Style) (i : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeJson (Gen.T2.Gron.linePayload line) with
  | .ok j =>
    let p := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .stream s (i + 1) LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init
    ⟨p, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamValue s i j, []⟩⟩
  | .error reason =>
    stop ⟨3, [], bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.streamError (.decode reason) ++ "\n")⟩
def valuesReply (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match token with
  | none | some (.error _) => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some (.ok line) =>
    let p := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init
    match Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line with
    | .skip => unchanged p
    | .emit v => ⟨p, ⟨v ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private def scannedLine (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeJson (Decode.payload line) with
  | .ok j =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .stream style (index + 1) LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.init
    ⟨next, ⟨Gen.T1.Gron.streamValue style index j, []⟩⟩
  | .error reason =>
    stop ⟨3, [], bytes (Gen.T1.Gron.streamError (.decode reason) ++ "\n")⟩

private theorem scannedLineRule (style : Style) (index : Nat) (line : Bytes) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedLine style index line atEOF = streamReply style index line atEOF := by
  unfold scannedLine
  rw [Decode.payloadRule]
  rfl

private def scannedValue (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) : Change :=
  match token with
  | none | some (.error _) => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some (.ok line) =>
    let next := if atEOF then .stopped 0 else .values Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.init
    match Merge.valueLine KeyOrder.starts KeyOrder.continues line with
    | .skip => unchanged next
    | .emit value => ⟨next, ⟨value ++ [10], []⟩⟩
    | .reject => stop ⟨5, [], (Gen.T2.Gron.valueError line).toBytes⟩

private theorem scannedValueRule (token : Option (Except Unit Bytes)) (atEOF : Bool) :
    scannedValue token atEOF = valuesReply token atEOF := by
  rcases token with _ | (_ | line)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have starts : KeyOrder.starts = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts := funext KeyOrder.startsRule
    have continues : KeyOrder.continues = Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues := funext KeyOrder.continuesRule
    rw [scannedValue, valuesReply, Merge.valueLineRule, starts, continues]
    generalize h : Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine
      ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts, Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues⟩ line = parsed
    let convert : Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.ValueLine → Gen.T2.Gron.ValueLine
      | .skip => .skip
      | .emit value => .emit value
      | .reject => .reject
    have equivalent : Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line = convert parsed :=
      (show Gen.T2.Gron.valueLine line =
        convert (Gen.T2.Gron.Merge.valueLine
          ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.starts, Gen.T2.Gron.KeyOrder.continues⟩ line) from rfl).trans
        (congrArg convert h)
    rw [equivalent]
    cases parsed <;> rfl

def byteChange : Phase → Byte → Change
  | .one style scan, b =>
    match Decode.advance Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner scan b with
    | .pending s => unchanged (.one style s)
    | .ready decoded => oneReply style decoded
  | .stream style index scan, b =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onByte scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
    | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | .done (some line) => scannedLine style index line false
  | .reverse c e format rev, b => unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev))
  | .values scan, b =>
    match Values.advance scan b with
    | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
    | .done token => scannedValue token false
  | .stopped code, _ => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem byteOne : ∀ style scan b, byteChange (.one style scan) b =
  match Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.one style s)
  | .done decoded => oneReply style decoded := by
  intro style scan b
  rw [byteChange, Decode.advanceRule]
  cases Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onByte scan b <;> rfl
theorem byteStream : ∀ style index scan b, byteChange (.stream style index scan) b =
  match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.stream style index s)
  | .done none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | .done (some line) => streamReply style index line false := by
  intro style index scan b
  simp only [byteChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem byteReverse : ∀ c e format rev b, byteChange (.reverse c e format rev) b =
  unchanged (.reverse c e format (b :: rev)) := fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem byteValues : ∀ scan b, byteChange (.values scan) b =
  match Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onByte scan b with
  | .more s => unchanged (.values s)
  | .done token => valuesReply token false := by
  intro scan b
  have step : Values.advance scan b = Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onByte scan b :=
    Values.advanceRule scan b
  simp only [byteChange, step, scannedValueRule] <;> rfl
theorem byteStopped : ∀ code b, byteChange (.stopped code) b = unchanged (.stopped code) :=
  fun _ _ => rfl

def eofChange : Phase → Change
  | .one style scan => oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan)
  | .stream style index scan =>
    match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
    | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
    | some line => scannedLine style index line true
  | .reverse c e format rev => finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse)
  | .values scan => scannedValue (Values.finish scan) true
  | .stopped code => unchanged (.stopped code)

theorem eofOne : ∀ style scan, eofChange (.one style scan) =
  oneReply style (Gen.T2.Gron.jsonScanner.onEOF scan) := fun _ _ => rfl
theorem eofStream : ∀ style index scan, eofChange (.stream style index scan) =
  match LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.lineScanner.onEOF scan with
  | none => unchanged (.stopped 0)
  | some line => streamReply style index line true := by
  intro style index scan
  simp only [eofChange, scannedLineRule]
theorem eofReverse : ∀ c e format rev, eofChange (.reverse c e format rev) =
  finishInput c e (.reverse format rev.reverse) := fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
theorem eofValues : ∀ scan, eofChange (.values scan) =
  valuesReply (Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onEOF scan) true := by
  intro scan
  have finish : Values.finish scan = Gen.T2.Gron.valuesScanner.onEOF scan :=
    Values.finishRule scan
  simp only [eofChange, finish, scannedValueRule]
theorem eofStopped : ∀ code, eofChange (.stopped code) = unchanged (.stopped code) :=
  fun _ => rfl

private def finished : Phase → Bool
  | .stopped _ => true
  | _ => false

private def Written.pushReversed (acc output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverseAux acc.stdout, output.stderr.reverseAux acc.stderr⟩
private def Written.reverse (output : Written) : Written :=
  ⟨output.stdout.reverse, output.stderr.reverse⟩

private theorem writtenReversePush (acc output : Written) :
    (acc.pushReversed output).reverse = acc.reverse.append output := by
  simp only [Written.pushReversed, Written.reverse, Written.append, List.reverseAux_eq,
    List.reverse_append, List.reverse_reverse]

private theorem writtenReverseEmpty : ({} : Written).reverse = {} := rfl

private theorem writtenEmptyAppend (output : Written) : ({} : Written).append output = output :=
  rfl

private theorem writtenAppendAssoc (a b c : Written) :
    (a.append b).append c = a.append (b.append c) := by
  simp only [Written.append, List.append_assoc]

private def chunkFrom (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) : Bytes → Change
  | [] => ⟨phase, rev.reverse⟩
  | b :: bs =>
    let first := byteChange phase b
    let nextRev := rev.pushReversed first.written
    if finished first.next then ⟨first.next, nextRev.reverse⟩
    else chunkFrom first.next nextRev bs
termination_by structural bs => bs

private theorem chunkFromPrefix (phase : Phase) (rev : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase rev bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, rev.reverse.append later.written⟩ := by
  induction bs generalizing phase rev with
  | nil => simp only [chunkFrom, Written.append, Written.reverse, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil]
  | cons b bs ih =>
    simp only [chunkFrom]
    split
    · simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]
    · rw [ih (byteChange phase b).next (rev.pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written),
        ih (byteChange phase b).next (({} : Written).pushReversed (byteChange phase b).written)]
      simp only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend, writtenAppendAssoc]

private theorem chunkFromInitial (phase : Phase) (output : Written) (bs : Bytes) :
    chunkFrom phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs =
      let later := chunkFrom phase {} bs
      ⟨later.next, output.append later.written⟩ := by
  simpa only [writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend] using
    chunkFromPrefix phase (({} : Written).pushReversed output) bs

def chunkChange (phase : Phase) (bs : Bytes) : Change := chunkFrom phase {} bs
theorem chunkEmpty : ∀ phase, chunkChange phase [] = unchanged phase := fun _ => rfl
theorem chunkCons : ∀ phase b bs, chunkChange phase (b :: bs) =
  let first := byteChange phase b
  match first.next with
  | .stopped _ => first
  | _ =>
    let later := chunkChange first.next bs
    ⟨later.next, first.written.append later.written⟩ := by
  intro phase b bs
  unfold chunkChange
  rw [chunkFrom]
  dsimp only
  generalize byteChange phase b = first
  obtain ⟨next, output⟩ := first
  cases next <;> simp only [finished, if_true, if_false, Bool.false_eq_true, chunkFromInitial,
    writtenReversePush, writtenReverseEmpty, writtenEmptyAppend]

def envFile (c : Config) (e : Environment) (path : String) (read : Sum FsError Bytes) : Change :=
  match read with
  | .inl error =>
    let input := Gen.T2.Gron.acquiredFile path error
    match input with
    | .readError _ =>
      if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e else finishInput c e input
    | _ => finishInput c e input
  | .inr data =>
    if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
    else finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) data)
theorem permissionReadResult : ∀ c e path,
  envFile c e path (.inl .fsPermissionDenied) =
    finishInput c e (.openError path "permission denied") := fun _ _ _ => rfl
def httpBody (c : Config) (e : Environment) (body : HttpBody) : Change :=
  if c.command = .values then stdinStart c e
  else
    match body.readError with
    | none => finishInput c e (Gen.T2.Gron.byteInput c.command (optionsOf c.invocation) body.payload)
    | some reason =>
      match c.command with
      | .forwardOne =>
        match (Gen.T2.Gron.oneInput (openPipe body.payload)).1 with
        | .emit decoded => oneReply c.style decoded
        | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)
      | .forwardLines =>
        let rs := Gen.T2.Gron.streamRecords body.payload ++ [.error (LineError.read reason)]
        stop (Gen.T1.Gron.observe (Gen.T1.Gron.forwardLines c.style rs))
      | _ => finishInput c e (.readError reason)

def timeSample (w : SimWorld) : Nat × SimWorld :=
  let r := LojitaCtx.Clock.readMonoMs w.clock
  (r.1, {w with clock := r.2})
def requestAt (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Sum NetError Bytes × SimWorld :=
  let req := Gen.T2.Gron.requestBytes a
  let r := evalNetExchange a.tls (a.tls && a.insecure) a.host a.port req timeout w.net
  (r.1, {w with net := r.2})
def urlTail (url : String) : String :=
  String.intercalate "://" ((url.splitOn "://").drop 1)
def authorityText (url : String) : String :=
  String.ofList ((urlTail url).toList.takeWhile (fun c => c != '/' && c != '?' && c != '#'))
def stripUserInfo (url : String) : String :=
  let raw := authorityText url
  let host := (raw.splitOn "@").getLastD ""
  if raw == host then url else
    (url.splitOn "://").headD "" ++ "://" ++ host ++ String.ofList ((urlTail url).toList.drop raw.length)
def redirectReferer (prev next : HttpOrigin) : Option String :=
  if prev.tls && !next.tls then none else some (stripUserInfo prev.url)
def parseDiagnostic (url detail : String) : String :=
  "parse " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag url ++ ": " ++ detail
def invalidOrigin (url reason : String) : String :=
  match reason with
  | "missing URL host" =>
    Gen.T2.Gron.getError (String.ofList (url.toList.takeWhile (· != ':')) ++ ":")
      "http: no Host in request URL"
  | "invalid bracketed URL host" => parseDiagnostic url "missing ']' in host"
  | "invalid URL port" =>
    let authority := authorityText (stripUserInfo url)
    let portText := ":" ++ (authority.splitOn ":").getLastD ""
    parseDiagnostic url ("invalid port " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag portText ++ " after host")
  | _ => parseDiagnostic url reason
def invalidReply (a : HttpAttempt) (wire : Bytes) (reason : String) : String :=
  let detail := if reason == "malformed HTTP status line" then
    let line := (wire.takeWhile (· != 13)).takeWhile (· != 10)
    "net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response " ++
      Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag (decodeUtf8Lossy line)
  else reason
  Gen.T2.Gron.getError a.url detail
inductive Hop where
  | completed (body : Except String HttpBody)
  | redirect (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
def responseAt (a : HttpAttempt) (prev : HttpOrigin) (left : Nat) (wire : Bytes) : Hop :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.decodeResponse wire with
  | .error why => .completed (.error (invalidReply a wire why))
  | .ok response =>
    match Gen.T2.Gron.redirectTarget response with
    | none => .completed (.ok response.body)
    | some location =>
      if left = 0 then .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError location "stopped after 10 redirects"))
      else
        match Gen.T2.Gron.resolveLocation prev location with
        | .error why =>
          .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError prev.url
            ("failed to parse Location header " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag location ++ ": " ++ why)))
        | .ok next => .redirect next (redirectReferer prev next)
def httpHop (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Hop × SimWorld :=
  let a := Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer
  let (r, w') := requestAt a timeout w
  match r with
  | .inl failure => (.completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.exchangeFailure a failure)), w')
  | .inr wire => (responseAt a origin left wire, w')
def localDeadline (origin : HttpOrigin) : String :=
  Gen.T2.Gron.getError origin.url "context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)"

def afterRedirect (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) (w : SimWorld) : Except String HttpBody × SimWorld :=
  let (now, w') := timeSample w
  if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
  else
    let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer left (deadline - now) w'
    match hop with
    | .completed r => (r, w'')
    | .redirect next nextReferer =>
      match left with
      | 0 => (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"), w'')
      | remaining + 1 => afterRedirect o next nextReferer deadline remaining w''
termination_by structural left

theorem redirectLast : ∀ o origin referer deadline w,
  afterRedirect o origin referer deadline 0 w =
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
    else
      let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer 0 (deadline - now) w'
      match hop with
      | .completed r => (r, w'')
      | .redirect next _ => (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"), w'') :=
  by
    intro o origin referer deadline w
    rw [afterRedirect.eq_def]
theorem redirectStep : ∀ o origin referer deadline left w,
  afterRedirect o origin referer deadline (left + 1) w =
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    if deadline ≤ now then (.error (localDeadline origin), w')
    else
      let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin referer (left + 1) (deadline - now) w'
      match hop with
      | .completed r => (r, w'')
      | .redirect next nextReferer => afterRedirect o next nextReferer deadline left w'' :=
  by
    intro o origin referer deadline left w
    rw [afterRedirect.eq_def]

def httpAt (o : Options) (url : String) (w : SimWorld) : Except String HttpBody × SimWorld :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | .error reason => (.error (invalidOrigin url reason), w)
  | .ok origin =>
    let timeout := Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs
    let (now, w') := timeSample w
    let (hop, w'') := httpHop o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) timeout w'
    match hop with
    | .completed r => (r, w'')
    | .redirect next referer =>
      afterRedirect o next referer (now + timeout) (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 2) w''
def FetchCaps : List Cap := [.clockCap, .netCap]
def fetchSubCli : CapSub FetchCaps CliCaps :=
  capSubCons clockInCli (capSubCons netInCli capSubNil)

private def clockInFetch : CapMem .clockCap FetchCaps := .here
private def netSubFetch : CapSub [.netCap] FetchCaps :=
  capSubCons (.there .here) capSubNil

private def originError (url reason : String) : String :=
  match reason with
  | "missing URL host" =>
    Gen.T2.Gron.getError (String.ofList (url.toList.takeWhile (· != ':')) ++ ":")
      "http: no Host in request URL"
  | "invalid bracketed URL host" => Diagnostic.parseError url "missing ']' in host"
  | "invalid URL port" =>
    let authority := authorityText (stripUserInfo url)
    let portText := ":" ++ (authority.splitOn ":").getLastD ""
    Diagnostic.parseError url ("invalid port " ++ Gen.T2.Gron.quoteFlag portText ++ " after host")
  | _ => Diagnostic.parseError url reason

private theorem originErrorRule (url reason : String) :
    originError url reason = invalidOrigin url reason := by
  have same : Diagnostic.parseError url = parseDiagnostic url :=
    funext (fun detail => Diagnostic.parseErrorRule url detail)
  unfold originError invalidOrigin
  rw [same]

private def requestW (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Sum NetError Bytes) :=
  liftWorld netSubFetch
    (Http.exchange ⟨a.tls, a.insecure, a.host, a.port, a.serverName, a.tunnel, Gen.T2.Gron.requestBytes a⟩
      timeout)

private theorem requestWRun (a : HttpAttempt) (timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (requestW a timeout) w = requestAt a timeout w := by
  rw [requestW, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.liftWorldPreservesRun]
  let request : Http.Request :=
    ⟨a.tls, a.insecure, a.host, a.port, a.serverName, a.tunnel, Gen.T2.Gron.requestBytes a⟩
  change runWorldPure (Http.exchange request timeout) w = requestAt a timeout w
  cases tls : a.tls with
  | false =>
    obtain ⟨halfClose, exchanged⟩ := Http.plainExchange request timeout tls
    rw [exchanged]
    simp only [tcpExchangeW, runWorldPure, stepWorldPure, request, requestAt, tls, Bool.false_and]
  | true =>
    rw [Http.tlsExchange request timeout tls]
    simp only [tlsExchangeW, runWorldPure, stepWorldPure, request, requestAt, tls, Bool.true_and]

private def httpHopW (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps Hop :=
  let a := Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer
  mapWorld (fun
    | .inl failure => .completed (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.exchangeFailure a failure))
    | .inr wire => responseAt a origin left wire) (requestW a timeout)

private theorem httpHopWRun (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (left timeout : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (httpHopW o origin referer left timeout) w = httpHop o origin referer left timeout w := by
  rw [httpHopW, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.mapWorldRun, requestWRun, httpHop]
  generalize requestAt (Gen.T2.Gron.prepareAttempt o origin referer) timeout w = exchanged
  obtain ⟨response, _⟩ := exchanged
  cases response <;> rfl

private theorem clockInFetchRun (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (nowMonoW clockInFetch) w = timeSample w := rfl

private def redirectW (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Except String HttpBody) :=
  worldBind (nowMonoW clockInFetch) fun now =>
    if deadline ≤ now then .pure (.error (localDeadline origin))
    else
      worldBind (httpHopW o origin referer left (deadline - now)) fun
        | .completed response => .pure response
        | .redirect next nextReferer =>
          match left with
          | 0 => .pure (.error (Gen.T2.Gron.getError next.url "stopped after 10 redirects"))
          | remaining + 1 => redirectW o next nextReferer deadline remaining
termination_by structural left

private theorem redirectWRun (o : Options) (origin : HttpOrigin) (referer : Option String)
    (deadline left : Nat) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (redirectW o origin referer deadline left) w = afterRedirect o origin referer deadline left w := by
  induction left generalizing origin referer w with
  | zero =>
    rw [redirectW, redirectLast, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    by_cases expired : deadline ≤ now
    · simp only [if_pos expired, runWorldPure]
    · simp only [if_neg expired, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, httpHopWRun]
      generalize httpHop o origin referer 0 (deadline - now) w' = exchanged
      obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
      cases hop <;> rfl
  | succ remaining ih =>
    rw [redirectW, redirectStep, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    by_cases expired : deadline ≤ now
    · simp only [if_pos expired, runWorldPure]
    · simp only [if_neg expired, LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, httpHopWRun]
      generalize httpHop o origin referer (remaining + 1) (deadline - now) w' = exchanged
      obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
      cases hop with
      | completed r => rfl
      | redirect next nextReferer => exact ih next nextReferer w''

def fetch (o : Options) (url : String) : WorldProg FetchCaps (Except String HttpBody) :=
  match Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | .error reason => .pure (.error (originError url reason))
  | .ok origin =>
    let timeout := Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs
    worldBind (nowMonoW clockInFetch) fun now =>
      worldBind (httpHopW o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) timeout) fun
        | .completed r => .pure r
        | .redirect next referer =>
          redirectW o next referer (now + timeout) (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 2)

theorem fetchObserved : ∀ o url w, runWorldPure (fetch o url) w = httpAt o url w := by
  intro o url w
  simp only [fetch, httpAt]
  cases Gen.T2.Gron.parseHttpOrigin url with
  | error reason => simp only [originErrorRule, runWorldPure]
  | ok origin =>
    simp only [LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, clockInFetchRun, httpHopWRun]
    generalize timeSample w = sample
    obtain ⟨now, w'⟩ := sample
    dsimp only
    generalize httpHop o origin none (Gen.T2.Gron.redirectLimit - 1) Gen.T2.Gron.httpTimeoutMs w' = exchanged
    obtain ⟨hop, w''⟩ := exchanged
    cases hop with
    | completed r => rfl
    | redirect next referer => exact redirectWRun o next referer _ _ w''

theorem fetchLifted : ∀ o url w,
  runWorldPure (liftWorld fetchSubCli (fetch o url)) w = httpAt o url w := by
  intro o url w
  rw [LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.liftWorldPreservesRun, fetchObserved]

def beginAt (w : SimWorld) : Change × SimWorld :=
  let e := environmentAt w
  let c := configurationAt w
  match c.source with
  | none => (finishInput c e (.one []), w)
  | some .stdin => (stdinStart c e, w)
  | some (.file path) => (envFile c e path (readVirtualFile path w.fs), w)
  | some (.http url) =>
    let (r, w') := httpAt (optionsOf c.invocation) url w
    match r with
    | .error message => (finishInput c e (.fetchError message), w')
    | .ok body => (httpBody c e body, w')
def appendWritten (output : Written) (w : SimWorld) : SimWorld :=
  {w with stdio := {w.stdio with
    stdout := LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.writeOut output.stdout w.stdio.stdout,
    stderr := LojitaCtx.PosixChannel.writeOut output.stderr w.stdio.stderr}}
def eventChange : Event CliCaps → Phase → Change
  | ⟨_, .evStdinBytes bs⟩, p => chunkChange p bs
  | ⟨_, .evStdinEOF⟩, p => eofChange p
  | _, p => unchanged p
def traceFrom : List (Event CliCaps) → Phase → SimWorld → Sum Phase ExitCode × SimWorld
  | [], p, w => (.inl p, w)
  | ev :: tail, p, w =>
    let change := eventChange ev p
    let w' := appendWritten change.written w
    match result change.next with
    | .inl p' => traceFrom tail p' w'
    | .inr status => (.inr status, w')
termination_by structural events _ _ => events
def inputEvents (ch : InChan) : List (Event CliCaps) :=
  let data := if ch.pending.isEmpty then [] else [Event.mkEvent stdioInCli (.evStdinBytes ch.pending)]
  if ch.closed then data ++ [Event.mkEvent stdioInCli .evStdinEOF] else data

def State : Type := Phase
def stateView : State → Phase := id

private def emitW {A : Type} (change : Change) (next : Phase → A) : WorldProg CliCaps A :=
  worldSeq (writeStdoutW stdioInCli change.written.stdout)
    (worldSeq (writeStderrW stdioInCli change.written.stderr) (.pure (next change.next)))

private theorem emitWRun {A : Type} (change : Change) (next : Phase → A) (w : SimWorld) :
    runWorldPure (emitW change next) w = (next change.next, appendWritten change.written w) :=
  rfl

private def startW (launch : Launch) (e : Environment) : WorldProg CliCaps State :=
  let c := Gen.T2.Gron.configure launch e.stdoutIsTTY e.term e.noColor
  match c.source with
  | none => emitW (finishInput c e (.one [])) id
  | some .stdin => emitW (stdinStart c e) id
  | some (.file path) =>
    worldBind (readFileW fsInCli path) fun read => emitW (envFile c e path read) id
  | some (.http url) =>
    worldBind (liftWorld fetchSubCli (fetch (optionsOf c.invocation) url)) fun
      | .error message => emitW (finishInput c e (.fetchError message)) id
      | .ok body => emitW (httpBody c e body) id

private def initializeW : WorldProg CliCaps State := do
  let name ← getProgNameW envInCli
  let args ← getArgsW envInCli
  let tty ← isTTYStdoutW stdioInCli
  let term ← lookupEnvW envInCli "TERM"
  let noColor ← lookupEnvW envInCli "NO_COLOR"
  startW ⟨name, args⟩ ⟨Gen.T2.Gron.alphabet, tty, term, noColor⟩

def app : ReactiveApp CliCaps State where
  init := initializeW
  onStep ev state := emitW (eventChange ev (stateView state)) result

def runView : Sum State ExitCode → Sum Phase ExitCode
  | .inl s => .inl (stateView s)
  | .inr code => .inr code

private theorem runViewRule (r : Sum State ExitCode) : runView r = r := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem initialized : ∀ w : SimWorld,
  let actual := runWorldPure app.init w
  let expected := beginAt w
  (stateView actual.1, actual.2) =
    (expected.1.next, appendWritten expected.1.written expected.2) := by
  intro w
  change runWorldPure (startW (launchPort.project w) (environmentAt w)) w = _
  unfold startW beginAt configurationAt
  dsimp only
  generalize Gen.T2.Gron.configure (launchPort.project w) (environmentAt w).stdoutIsTTY
    (environmentAt w).term (environmentAt w).noColor = c
  cases c.source with
  | none => exact emitWRun _ id w
  | some source =>
    cases source with
    | stdin => exact emitWRun _ id w
    | file path =>
      change runWorldPure (emitW (envFile c (environmentAt w) path (readVirtualFile path w.fs)) id) w = _
      exact emitWRun _ id w
    | http url =>
      rw [LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.runWorldPureBind, fetchLifted]
      dsimp only
      generalize httpAt (optionsOf c.invocation) url w = fetched
      obtain ⟨body, w'⟩ := fetched
      cases body <;> exact emitWRun _ id w'

theorem stepped : ∀ (w : SimWorld) (ev : Event CliCaps) (s : State),
  let actual := runWorldPure (app.onStep ev s) w
  let expected := eventChange ev (stateView s)
  (runView actual.1, actual.2) = (result expected.next, appendWritten expected.written w) := by
  intro w ev s
  simp only [runViewRule]
  exact emitWRun (eventChange ev (stateView s)) result w

private theorem stepsRun (events : List (Event CliCaps)) (p : Phase) (w : SimWorld) :
    runReactiveSteps app p events w = traceFrom events p w := by
  induction events generalizing p w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons ev tail ih =>
    have step := stepped w ev p
    simp only [runViewRule, stateView, id] at step
    change runWorldPure (app.onStep ev p) w =
      (result (eventChange ev p).next, appendWritten (eventChange ev p).written w) at step
    simp only [runReactiveSteps, traceFrom, step]
    cases result (eventChange ev p).next with
    | inl next => exact ih next _
    | inr code => rfl

theorem observed : ∀ (w : SimWorld) (events : List (Event CliCaps)),
  let actual := runReactivePure app events w
  let expected := beginAt w
  (runView actual.1, actual.2) =
    traceFrom events expected.1.next (appendWritten expected.1.written expected.2) := by
  intro w events
  have init := initialized w
  change runWorldPure app.init w = _ at init
  simp only [runViewRule, runReactivePure, init]
  exact stepsRun events _ _

private theorem httpPreserves (o : Options) (url : String) (w : SimWorld) :
    (httpAt o url w).2.tty = w.tty ∧ (httpAt o url w).2.fs = w.fs := by
  rw [← fetchObserved]
  refine ⟨LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.progPreservesTty ?_ (fetch o url) w,
    LojitaCtx.WorldLaws.progPreservesFs ?_ (fetch o url) w⟩
  all_goals
    intro present
    change CapMem _ [.clockCap, .netCap] at present
    cases present with
    | there rest =>
      cases rest with
      | there missing => nomatch missing

private theorem beginPreserves (w : SimWorld) :
    (beginAt w).2.tty = w.tty ∧ (beginAt w).2.fs = w.fs := by
  unfold beginAt
  dsimp only
  cases (configurationAt w).source with
  | none => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | some source =>
    cases source with
    | stdin => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    | file path => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    | http url =>
      dsimp only
      have same := httpPreserves (optionsOf (configurationAt w).invocation) url w
      generalize httpAt (optionsOf (configurationAt w).invocation) url w = fetched at same ⊢
      obtain ⟨body, _⟩ := fetched
      cases body <;> exact same

private theorem tracePreserves (events : List (Event CliCaps)) (p : Phase) (w : SimWorld) :
    (traceFrom events p w).2.tty = w.tty ∧ (traceFrom events p w).2.fs = w.fs := by
  induction events generalizing p w with
  | nil => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons ev tail ih =>
    simp only [traceFrom]
    cases result (eventChange ev p).next with
    | inl next => exact ih next (appendWritten (eventChange ev p).written w)
    | inr code => exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

theorem preservesTerminalAndFiles : ∀ (w : SimWorld) (events : List (Event CliCaps)),
  let final := (runReactivePure app events w).2
  final.tty = w.tty ∧ final.fs = w.fs := by
  intro w events
  dsimp only
  rw [congrArg Prod.snd (observed w events)]
  have started := beginPreserves w
  have traced := tracePreserves events (beginAt w).1.next (appendWritten (beginAt w).1.written (beginAt w).2)
  exact ⟨traced.1.trans started.1, traced.2.trans started.2⟩

theorem observedChannel : ∀ (w : SimWorld) (ch : InChan),
  let actual := runReactivePure app (inputEvents ch) w
  let expected := beginAt w
  (runView actual.1, actual.2) =
    traceFrom (inputEvents ch) expected.1.next (appendWritten expected.1.written expected.2) :=
  fun w ch => observed w (inputEvents ch)
end Gen.T3.Gron
